data.jd_text:
Ignite School is expanding with the opening of a new purpose\-built
 **Pre\-K to Grade 1 campus** 
 located adjacent to our existing campus in Dubai. The new campus is currently under construction and is scheduled to open for the
 **2027/28 academic year** 
 .
 



 The appointed
 **School Director / Principal** 
 will join Ignite School during the
 **2026/27 academic year** 
 and will play a key leadership role in preparing the new campus for a successful opening. Working closely with the
 **Board of Trustees, KHDA, and the existing school leadership team** 
 , the Director will ensure that all regulatory, operational, staffing, and educational requirements are completed in line with approved standards and timelines.
 



 This role offers a unique opportunity for an experienced and visionary educational leader to help establish the culture, systems, policies, and learning environment of a new early years and elementary campus from its inception.
 



 The new
 **820\-seat campus** 
 has been designed to provide a modern, student\-centered learning environment that supports inquiry, collaboration, creativity, and early childhood development. Facilities will include dedicated learning spaces, specialist teaching areas, a parent and staff café, and extensive outdoor play and exploration areas.
 



**Role Overview** 




**The School Director / Principal will be responsible for the overall strategic direction, leadership, management, and efficient operation of the new campus. The role includes ensuring KHDA compliance, leading operational readiness, supporting student recruitment and enrolment growth, overseeing staff planning and recruitment, and ensuring a smooth transition for students, families, and staff into the new facility.** 




**As the KHDA\-nominated Principal, the Director will serve as the main point of contact for KHDA communications, compliance matters, inspections, and regulatory visits. The Director will also be ultimately accountable for the campus’s health, safety, wellbeing, standards, performance, and continuous improvement.** 




**Key Responsibilities** 




**New Campus Development and Opening Readiness** 



* Lead the planning and preparation required for the successful opening of the new Pre\-K to Grade 1 campus.
* Work closely with the Board of Trustees and KHDA to ensure all regulatory requirements are met.
* Develop, adapt, and implement campus policies, procedures, systems, and operational readiness plans.
* Support the transition of staff, students, and families to the new campus.
* Oversee student recruitment, admissions planning, and enrolment growth for the new campus.
* Ensure the campus is fully prepared across academic, operational, staffing, compliance, facilities, and parent communication areas.



**Strategic Leadership and School Management** 



* Lead the implementation of the school’s mission, vision, and approved education plan.
* Provide clear strategic direction and ensure effective organizational management.
* Monitor school performance through key performance indicators and improvement targets.
* Ensure high standards in teaching, learning, student wellbeing, safeguarding, and operational delivery.
* Promote a positive, inclusive, and culturally respectful school environment.
* Maintain a strong focus on Emirati culture, Arabic language, Islamic values, and UAE national priorities.



**KHDA Compliance and Regulatory Accountability** 



* Serve as the KHDA\-nominated Principal on the school’s Educational Services Permit.
* Act as the main point of contact for KHDA communications, inspections, visits, and compliance matters.
* Ensure all school records are accurate, updated, and available to KHDA when required.
* Ensure full compliance with KHDA, UAE regulatory requirements, safeguarding standards, health and safety expectations, and internal school policies.
* Oversee the implementation of policies related to admissions, health and safety, inclusion, wellbeing, safeguarding, curriculum, assessment, teaching, complaints, and student support.



**Teaching, Learning, and Student Outcomes** 



* Ensure high\-quality teaching, learning, and educational provision across the campus.
* Monitor student progress, achievement, wellbeing, and engagement.
* Ensure the needs of all students are met, including Emirati students, students of determination, high\-performing students, and students requiring additional support.
* Lead the continuous improvement of curriculum delivery, assessment practices, and learning outcomes.
* Support the development of a child\-centered learning environment that promotes inquiry, creativity, collaboration, and early childhood development.



**Parent Partnership and Community Engagement** 



* Build strong, positive relationships with parents and the wider school community.
* Promote effective communication between the Director’s office, families, staff, and stakeholders.
* Lead parent engagement initiatives, meetings, events, and service recovery discussions when required.
* Use parent feedback, surveys, and evaluation data to support timely school improvement.
* Strengthen parent satisfaction, loyalty, and student re\-registration.



**Operational and Financial Management** 



* Ensure effective use of school resources to support educational and operational priorities.
* Manage campus operations in line with approved budgets and school expectations.
* Support enrolment targets, re\-registration, fee collection, and efficient resource allocation.
* Monitor facilities, health and safety, and service quality to ensure a safe and high\-quality school environment.
* Identify operational challenges and allocate resources effectively to support school success.



**Staffing, Performance, and Human Resources** 



* Lead the recruitment and appointment of suitably qualified staff in line with KHDA and school requirements.
* Support the formation and development of the campus leadership and administrative teams.
* Oversee staff performance management, probation reviews, annual evaluations, and professional development.
* Promote staff retention, accountability, professionalism, and continuous improvement.
* Manage staff\-related matters in line with school HR policies, including performance concerns, disciplinary matters, grievances, and allegations against staff.



**School Improvement and Accreditation** 



* Lead the development and implementation of the School Improvement Plan.
* Support DSIB inspection readiness and continuous progress toward strong inspection outcomes.
* Contribute to maintaining and strengthening NEASC accreditation standards.
* Use data, feedback, and evaluation outcomes to drive measurable improvement.
* Ensure improvement actions are followed up, monitored, and completed to a high standard.



**Candidate Profile** 



* **The ideal candidate will be an experienced educational leader with a strong background in early years and elementary education, school start\-up or campus development, American curriculum leadership, and UAE regulatory compliance. The candidate should demonstrate strong strategic thinking, excellent communication, sound judgment, operational discipline, and the ability to build trust with staff, parents, students, regulators, and the wider school community.**

We are an international technology group and traditional family business with over 14,000 employees in 40 countries. Creating Confidence is our path to success. Trust is the basis of our co\-operation within G\+D.
   

  

 The whole world trusts us when it comes to physical or digital currencies. We increase the security and efficiency of the cash cycle in collaboration with central banks and the entire currency industry. As the market leader in advanced currency management, would you like to join us in shaping the future of payments?
   

  

**Scope and Purpose:**
* The Service Account Delivery Manager is responsible for overseeing and managing all service\-related aspects from the implementation, to the maintenance\-phase of G\+D Solution projects, providing input in regards to service delivery to other project stakeholders in the offer phase, ensuring service readiness, supporting a seamless hand\-over of the customer solution to the service delivery engine to ensure a smooth start the service operation with the site acceptance and overseeing the delivery in the after sales phase.
* This role is critical in defining the service delivery strategy that complements the overall project objectives, managed by the Service Offer Manager and Solution Project Manager. The Service Account Delivery Manager ensures that the services are implemented and meet the highest standards of quality and efficiency, ultimately enhancing customer satisfaction and project success.
* The role requires close collaboration with Service and Solution Sales.


**Roles \& Responsibilities:**
* Offer Phase: Service Delivery Model Definition: Develop and define a comprehensive service delivery model tailored to the project's specific needs and customer requirements. Providing input for service related costing. Collaborate with Service Offer Manager in Service Sales to ensure alignment between the service models, service pricing and the overall project deliverables. 3rd Party Service Supplier and Service Subcontractor Selection: Directing requirements for a supplier selection to ensure timely delivery of services and compliance with contractual terms in cooperation with the regional Subcontractor Manager. Identify and evaluate potential subcontractors who can meet the project's service requirements in alignment with the 3rd Party Service Product Manager and the regional Subcontractor Manager. Support the selection process, owned by Purchasing department, based on criteria such as capability, cost, quality, and reliability.
* Implementation Phase: Backup Service Related Tasks: Interface Management for all service related aspects between onsite teams (Field Service) and remote teams (Care Center, Service Sales, Service Backbone Operation) during the buildup phase. Initiating back\-to\-back agreements with suppliers according to the defined service delivery model for each solution element. Establish delivery processes based on decided legal setup for Order Management, 3rd Party services, Training and adaptation services in cooperation with Service Backbone Operation, leveraging standard wherever possible. Assure optimized service inventories in cooperation with Service Backbone Operation Subcontractor Contract Creation: Providing technical input for drafting and finalizing contracts with selected subcontractors, ensuring all service specifications and quality standards are clearly defined. Work closely with 3rd Party Service Product Manager, regional Subcontractor Manager, Legal and Purchasing department to ensure contracts are comprehensive and protect the interests of the organization. Ramp\-up of Service Employees: Oversee the recruitment and onboarding process for service team members. Ensure that service teams are appropriately staffed to meet project demands and timelines. Trainings for Service Employees: Identify skill gaps and develop training programs to enhance the competencies of service employees (internal and external), leveraging the G\+D Training Curriculum wherever possible. Coordinate and oversee the execution of training sessions, ensuring that all service employees are equipped with the necessary skills and knowledge. Trainings for Customers: Identify training needs for customers. Coordinate and oversee the execution of training sessions, ensuring that the customer is trained for all relevant components. Leverage the G\+D Training Curriculum and Global Training infrastructure wherever possible. Coordination of Installation Related Tasks: Coordinate, plan and manage the installation of the G\+D Solution in close alignment with the Solution Project Manager. Oversee the onsite service teams to ensure that installations are completed on time and meet all quality standards. Site Acceptance Related Tasks: Ensure the successful transition from project to maintenance phase for all service related tasks. Manage the handover of responsibilities from the solution to the service team Reporting and Documentation: Maintain comprehensive documentation of all service processes and adjustments made during implementation phase. Provide input to project reports on service status, challenges, and achievements. Feedback and Improvement: Plan and conduct with reached SAT (Site Acceptance Test) the project closure process including the required lessons\-learned activities.
* Warranty and after warranty phase Service Initialization: Monitoring the closure of open items from project phase to completely hand\-over the solution into a maintenance phase. Assist the Field Service, Support and Backbone Operation teams during Hyper Care phase. Implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service quality and customer satisfaction. Performance Management: Coordination of all activities needed to deliver committed service scope with high performance. Customer Management: Interface to the customer for technical discussions. Manage customer escalations and drive timely solution deliveries using the entire backup organization. Single Point of Contact: Overall coordination of delivering committed scope with respective delivery units (Field Service, Support, Training, Repair, Order Management, Adaptation) Contract Renewal: Support Service Sales during contract negotiation and renewal phase Setting Up and providing Service Fulfillment and commercial related Contract reporting based on committed scope Key Performance Indicators \- KPI (generic), individual targets will be agreed yearly Financials (To succeed financially, what should we deliver to our stakeholders?) Target Margin per annum overachieved \[%] \+ \[€] Operational (To satisfy our shareholders and customers, what business processes should we excel at?) Project completion within scope, timeline and quality Field Service and Support Delivery – Global KPIs Customer Satisfaction (To achieve our vision, how should we appear to our customers?) Successful Site Acceptance (SAT) Customer Satisfaction (C\-SAT) Index


**Requirements:**
* Personality / Skills / Professional Qualification \& Experience
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, or a related field
* Certification in Project Management
* Ability to lead and manage teams, to administer relationships as well as influence and manage subcontractors and suppliers effectively
* 10\+ years experienced in Automation systems and projects and technically proficient in Automation systems
* Proven track record in setting up services in complex, multi\-OEM projects \>5 years of experience in managing service delivery teams, including subcontractor selection, and contract management
* Extensive experience in dealing with customers and suppliers, including handling escalations and negotiations
* Ability to provide input on technical requirements and service specifications to meet service concept designs, cooperating with procurement, legal and sales teams
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate activities to deliver high service performance consistently
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to interact with customers, team members, and other stakeholders
* Fluency in written and spoken English and French

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**About Us**
 We are the real estate subsidiary of a well\-established, diversified business group with interests across multiple industries in the GCC. Our business focuses on the development, ownership, and management of a diverse portfolio of residential, commercial, mixed\-use, and retail real estate assets. With capabilities spanning the full real estate lifecycle—from project development and construction to leasing, property management, and asset operations—we are committed to delivering high\-quality developments and creating long\-term value for our stakeholders.
   

  

 As we continue to expand our portfolio and strengthen our market presence, we are seeking an accomplished Finance Director to lead our finance function and play a pivotal role in shaping the company’s financial strategy and supporting sustainable growth.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Finance Director will provide overall financial leadership, governance, and strategic direction across the organization. Reporting to senior executive management, you will drive financial performance, capital efficiency, and disciplined investment decision\-making across a diversified real estate portfolio.
   

  

 You will oversee both development and operational real estate assets, ensuring strong financial control across project delivery, leasing operations, property management, and investment activities. This role requires a strong combination of strategic vision, technical finance expertise, and hands\-on leadership within a complex real estate environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Financial Strategy \& Leadership
   

  

* Lead financial planning, forecasting, and performance management across the business.
* Support executive leadership in evaluating investments, acquisitions, and development opportunities.
* Provide financial insights to drive profitability, capital efficiency, and long\-term value creation.


 Development \& Asset Finance
   

  

* Oversee financial management of development projects from acquisition through completion and stabilization.
* Manage project budgets, cash flows, escrow accounts, and contractor/consultant payments.
* Monitor financial performance across leasing, property management, and retail assets.


 Treasury \& Funding
   

  

* Manage liquidity, cash flow planning, and banking relationships.
* Lead negotiations for project finance, banking facilities, refinancing, and restructuring.


 Financial Planning \& Analysis
   

  

* Lead budgeting, forecasting, and long\-term financial planning.
* Develop financial models and feasibility studies for new developments and investments.


 Commercial \& Investment Support
   

  

* Review and support negotiation of key commercial contracts and agreements.
* Provide financial input into investment structuring and strategic decision\-making.


 Governance \& Controls
   

  

* Ensure compliance with IFRS and internal control frameworks.
* Oversee audits, statutory reporting, and financial governance processes.
* Strengthen financial policies, systems, and controls across the organization.


 Leadership \& Team Development
   

  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing finance team.
* Build strong finance capability across development and operational business units.
* Foster a culture of accountability, performance, and continuous improvement.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Economics; professional qualification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, CMA) preferred.
* 15\+ years of progressive finance experience, ideally within real estate development and asset management.
* Strong experience in development finance, including project cash flows, escrow structures, and contractor payment processes.
* Strong financial modelling, feasibility analysis, and investment evaluation skills.
* Experience across both development and operational real estate portfolios, including leasing, property management, and retail assets.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience in contract review and investment decision support.


 Why Join Us?
   

  

 Join a leading real estate company within a diversified group, where you will play a key role in shaping financial strategy, enabling major developments, and driving long\-term value creation across a growing portfolio.
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

 Role Level: Not Applicable Work Type: Full\-Time Country: United Arab Emirates City: Dubai Company Website: https://www.qureos.com/ Job Function: Finance Company Industry/
   

  

 Sector: IT Services and IT Consulting

**About ARADA** 




 ARADA is one of the UAE's leading master developers, dedicated to creating communities that inspire, enrich, and engage. Since its launch in 2017, ARADA has delivered award\-winning residential, retail, hospitality, education, and wellness destinations across the UAE. Driven by innovation, quality, and customer experience, ARADA is committed to building vibrant communities that enhance the lives of residents, visitors, and businesses alike.
 



 As we continue our growth journey, we are looking for an experienced and results\-driven
 **Senior Project Manager** 
 to join our Development team in Dubai. This role is instrumental in delivering high\-profile mixed\-use, residential, hospitality, retail, and commercial developments, ensuring projects are executed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.
 



  





**Role Purpose** 




 The Senior Project Manager will lead the end\-to\-end execution of development projects from design development through procurement, construction, handover, and close\-out. Working closely with internal stakeholders, consultants, contractors, and authorities, the successful candidate will ensure the successful delivery of projects aligned with ARADA's strategic objectives, quality expectations, and commercial goals.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 Project Leadership
 


* Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and successful delivery of assigned development projects.
* Manage projects through all development phases including design, authority approvals, procurement, construction, testing \& commissioning, handover, and defects liability period.
* Develop and maintain detailed project execution plans, schedules, budgets, and risk registers.
* Monitor project performance against agreed milestones and implement corrective actions where required.



 Design \& Development Management
 


* Coordinate with the Design Management team to ensure designs meet project objectives, regulatory requirements, cost targets, and construction feasibility.
* Review consultant deliverables to ensure quality, completeness, and alignment with project briefs.
* Drive value engineering initiatives while maintaining design intent and customer experience.



 Construction Management

 This is a senior creative leadership role responsible for elevating brands across every touchpoint, maintaining world\-class creative standards, and developing innovative campaigns aligned with luxury real estate and branded residence positioning.

data.jd_text:
**About Faux Consultancy.** 




 Founded in 2011, Faux is the Middle East’s leading Public Relations and Events Consultancy, working in partnership with global brands and the region’s most exciting independent concepts. Based in Dubai and working actively across the whole of the GCC, Faux is a trusted on\-the\-ground partner for brands focused on amplifying their visibility and commercial success in the region. Faux’s client divisions focus solely on Fashion and Beauty, spanning the luxury and niche sectors. This sharp focus, along with the agency’s legacy of over a decade of innovative brand representation, allows for a level of experience and insight that is unmatched. We are committed to providing the most qualitative, thoughtful and effective representation for our brands.
 



  





 The Account Director is a central leadership role within Faux, spanning key pillars of strategic development and project implementation for both local and international clients. Working in direct collaboration with the Senior Management team, this is a position that involves engagement in both day\-to\-day Account Direction and team management, as well as high\-level strategic planning and the opportunity to be involved in Business Development.
 



  





 Overseeing a portfolio of Beauty brands, the Account Director is responsible for leading a team of employees in the successful management and representation of their ‘team portfolio’, ensuring a qualitative approach to Public Relations in the GCC, and achieving certain KPIs associated with the accounts.
 



 The Account Director ensures that best\-practice standards are always in place, from strategy development through to campaign execution, and enjoys a level of autonomy in the management of their ‘working group’ to best utilise and develop the talents of their team.
 



  





 This role requires significant industry experience in a similar Senior PR position, working specifically across Beauty clients, preferably with experience or insight into the GCC Market. The ideal candidate for this role will have a strong sense of self\-direction and a desire to take on a top leadership role within a market\-leading, fast\-paced and dynamic agency.
 



  





 Innovation, professionalism, and a qualitative approach to Public Relations lie at the heart of Faux's approach to client representation, and these qualities will be reflected in the successful candidate, in terms of their previous success and future goals.
 



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* Development and implementation of innovative and effective GCC\-wide strategies for PR clients, spanning Press, Influencer, VIP and CRM Relations
* Leadership of a dedicated team within the company, providing structure, mentorship and guidance to ensure smooth workflow and delivery
* Securing qualitative, high\-value PR coverage and other results in line with allocated KPIs, always aiming to exceed targets
* Demonstrate strong leadership skills, including allocation of tasks, mentoring of direct reports, and providing clear, critical feedback
* Responsibility for the successful delivery of organic and commercial PR projects carried out on behalf of clients, including planning, implementation, and post\-activity analysis
* Work in partnership with the Faux Events team to effectively plan and host events, activations, and other concepts for agency clients
* Provide active contribution to the business development goals of the agency, participating in the development and presentation of pitches for new business
* Maintain a strong awareness of industry trends, talents, and other movements, to provide the best possible insight to clients, GCC\-wide
* Planning and negotiation of commercial talent and media deals on behalf of clients, including advertorials, ambassadorship deals, and paid campaigns
* Local content creation: show expertise and ease in handling production and post\-production of localised campaigns, which are specifically targeted to the GCC market
* Daily budget management, including the responsible planning, spending, and tracking of client budgets
* Team management to ensure the accurate data gathering, analysis and client reporting are carried out within the provided deadlines
* Active contribution to the development of a positive workplace culture, collaborating and sharing suggestions with Senior Management on ways to best motivate and reward the team.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS** 




  




* A bachelor's or master’s degree in public relations, communications or other relevant discipline
* **At least 8 years of PR industry experience, including in the role of Public Relations / Communications Manager, specifically in the Beauty industry**
* **At least 3 years in a similar role or as a Senior PR Manager, specifically in the Beauty industry**
* **A strong media and influencer network across the GCC is an essential requirement**
* Proven leadership skills, with the ability to confidently guide, motivate and manage a team
* A creative thinker who values innovation, bringing to the table fresh ideas and strategies
* Proven success in a previous senior PR role, including the securing of high\-value coverage and the generation of market\-leading ideas
* Excellent regional networks with the leading press, influencers, stylists and celebrities
* A positive and engaged attitude to relationship development in the region
* An awareness and understanding of regional market nuances, and their impact on Beauty brand management
* A keen interest in social media trends and a keen interest in staying ahead of the curve, always to nourish our clients with fresh concepts and locally relevant and time\-sensitive social listening ideas
* Strong multi\-tasking and organisational skills, to thrive in a fast\-paced agency environment where many projects are carried out in parallel
* High level of organisation and experience in complex workflow management, with the ability to hit strict deadlines and KPIs
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into engaging stories
* Ad\-hoc regional and international travel will be required.

 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective
data.jd_text:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



 We are seeking a highly driven self\-starter with exceptional program\-level delivery experience to join Anaplan in UAE. This is a rare, high\-impact opportunity to lay the groundwork and shape the success of our most strategic enterprise customers across the Middle East.
 



 At Anaplan, we are redefining how businesses plan and make decisions through our cutting\-edge Connected Planning platform, powered by our unique deterministic calculation engine and advanced AI capabilities. In this role, you will be at the forefront of this transformation.
 



 You will bring a proven track record of leading complex, high\-stakes implementations—ideally within Supply Chain, Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A), or Workforce Planning. Thriving at the intersection of delivery and strategic advisory, you will scope, negotiate, manage escalations, and serve as an indispensable partner to both customer and internal stakeholders. From C\-level executives to daily end\-users, you will excel at influencing decisions and cementing your status as a trusted advisor.
 



 This is a hands\-on leadership position tailor\-made for a delivery expert who can seamlessly orchestrate multiple enterprise programs, ensure strict adherence to budget and scope, and expertly pivot to recover projects that have drifted off track.
 



**Your Impact (What You’ll Do)** 



* **Drive Delivery Excellence:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end Anaplan deployments alongside internal teams and external partners, establishing robust governance, ensuring precise scoping, and proactively uncovering hidden assumptions.
* **Be the Strategic Anchor:** 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for delivery, building alignment with customer stakeholders ranging from operational leads up to the C\-suite.
* **Master Complex Programs:** 
 Navigate intricate, multi\-faceted programs, ensuring flawless delivery while expertly balancing scope, risk, budget, and resourcing.
* **Accelerate Decision\-Making:** 
 Anticipate bottlenecks and drive critical project decisions across design, testing, timelines, and organizational change management.
* **Build Consensus:** 
 Leverage top\-tier negotiation skills to resolve conflicts, maintain project momentum, and unite diverse teams behind a shared goal.
* **Champion Excellence:** 
 Advocate for and implement the "Anaplan Way" methodology, ensuring the delivery of scalable, highly intuitive, and user\-friendly solutions.
* **Deliver Transparency:** 
 Provide clear, actionable reporting on project status and overall portfolio health to both internal leadership and external stakeholders.



**Your DNA (What You Bring)** 



* **Enterprise Expertise:** 
 Demonstrable history of exemplary program or project management across complex, large\-scale enterprise initiatives.
* **Agile Mastery:** 
 Deep, hands\-on experience in Agile project delivery methodologies—this is essential for driving our fast\-paced implementations.
* **Turnaround Architect:** 
 Proven ability to recover and realign complex projects led by partners or vendors. We are looking for a track record of delivering—and rescuing—large\-scale projects under tight timelines and budgets.
* **Executive Influence:** 
 Exceptional customer engagement and communication skills, characterized by the ability to negotiate, influence senior leadership, and confidently act as a trusted strategic advisor.
* **Domain Knowledge (Bonus):** 
 While not strictly essential, domain expertise in Supply Chain, FP\&A, or Workforce Planning will highly differentiate your application.



**Why Join Us?** 
 As the first Principal Solution Implementation Manager in the region, you won't just be managing projects; you will be building a legacy. You'll work with industry\-defining AI and planning technology, partner with the world's leading brands, and have a tangible impact on how global enterprises operate.
 



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

data.jd_text:
**Posted on the Senna Private Equity Careers Network.**
**Overview**
 This Senior Project Manager role is based in Dubai, UAE, and sits within the project management function of a real estate company. The position carries direct accountability for the end\-to\-end delivery of multi\-disciplined real estate projects on behalf of clients, spanning planning, design, construction, occupancy, and closeout. The successful candidate will lead experienced project teams, manage complex stakeholder relationships, and ensure that budget, schedule, quality, and risk objectives are met across each engagement.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Manage all facets of project management — budget, schedule, procurement, quality, and risk — across individual real estate projects from inception through closeout.
* Interface directly with clients to define project requirements; prepare scope of work, resource plans, cost estimates, budgets, cash flow projections, work plan schedules, milestones, quality controls, and risk registers.
* Read, interpret, and apply standards to complex project documents including contracts, agreements, leases, work letters, project charters, surveys, and architectural drawings.
* Identify and qualify project delivery resources; conduct requests for proposals, lead bid analysis, facilitate evaluation interviews, and recommend appointments to clients.
* Lead and provide direction to multi\-disciplined project delivery teams, guiding them toward defined project goals.
* Implement and maintain a structured communication plan, including regular meetings, written reports, and meeting minutes, to keep clients and project teams consistently informed.
* Ensure project documentation governance aligns with company and client requirements; maintain data integrity, accuracy, and timely coordination of all project records.
* Track project progress against approved goals, budgets, and timelines; report on status and variances; develop and execute action plans to address deviations.
* Manage change control processes — assess change requests, evaluate impacts on scope, budget, schedule, quality, and risk, secure client approvals, and issue change orders accordingly.
* Identify complex project risks, lead constructability reviews, and develop and implement risk mitigation and contingency plans.
* Apply understanding of business context — including business cases, economic implications, and risk — to project management decisions.
* Analyse inputs from the wider team and make recommendations with direct impact on project and business outcomes.


**Skills \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree (BA, BS, BEng, or BArch) in a technical discipline from an accredited university.
* Minimum of five years of directly relevant experience in the UAE.
* Demonstrated prior experience managing multi\-disciplined project teams in a similar senior role.
* PMP certification is required.
* MRICS designation is preferred.
* Full professional fluency in English, both written and verbal; Arabic or additional languages are advantageous.
* Valid UAE driver's licence.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings.
* Working knowledge of MS Project, lease structures, construction contracts, and construction practices.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills; ability to solve complex problems and evaluate multiple options in ambiguous situations.
* Ability to comprehend, analyse, and interpret complex business and contractual documents.
* In\-depth knowledge of financial terms and principles; ability to forecast, prepare, and manage budgets and conduct financial analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce reports and deliver persuasive presentations to senior stakeholders and client groups.
* Proven ability to motivate, influence, and negotiate effectively with key team members, senior management, and clients.


 Why This Role Stands Out
   

  

* Direct client\-facing accountability on complex, high\-value real estate projects across the UAE market.
* Opportunity to lead experienced, multi\-disciplined teams on projects spanning the full real estate lifecycle.
* A full\-time, permanent position within a structured and established real estate company operating in one of the world's most active real estate markets.

data.jd_text:
**Senior Technical Project Manager – Thermal Generation** 




**Project Development and New Technologies, AMEA** 









**Objective** 




  





 The Senior Technical Project Manager (STPM) \- Thermal Generation Projects and New Technologies leads the technical development of large power projects and supports the decarbonization initiatives of the thermal generation fleet in Asia, Middle East and Africa region (AMEA). The STPM will be responsible for supporting the extensions of PPAs of existing thermal assets, development of greenfield thermal power projects (OCGT and CCGT), asset decarbonization initiatives and projects, assessment of new technologies in collaboration with the ENGIE Group Research and Innovation ecosystem, and management of third party engineering consultants. S/he may from time to time also be involved in Hydrogen and Battery Energy Storage projects.
 



  





**Job responsibility** 




  





**Technical Project Management (Thermal Generation Greenfield Projects and Extensions)** 



* Provides the technical definition of the project and manages the selection of technologies, specifications, configuration, performance analysis, availability, outages, and evaluation of innovative technology solutions.
* Assure safety operability and maintainability is careful considered in new plant designs.
* Manages/Reviews all project related studies during bidding/development phase till hand\-over to execution: pre\-feasibility studies (if any), feasibility studies (if any), ESIA studies…
* Leads the technical development and documentation of the contractual agreements during development/bidding and negotiation stage: EPC, PPA, electricity connection agreement, LTPRA, LTSA, O\&M Contracts etc...
* Contributes to the technical qualification of EPC Contractors
* Manages the main equipment supplier’s selection with the EPC contractor.
* Animates and manages several technical review meetings with the EPC contractor to optimize the plant design.
* Manages the technical mark up and proposed deviations (if any) of bidding documents.
* In narrow coordination with Procurement proposes and defines technical\-commercial optimizations with the contractor(s).
* In narrow coordination with the PMO team prepares the technical related part of the project execution and operation.
* In narrow coordination with the PMO team prepares all Construction technical and O\&M related documents for the proposal/bid: EPC Term sheet and/or EPC Contract, O\&M Term Sheet and/or contract, OM organization chart, including Guarantees and testing procedures, O\&M philosophy...
* Based on technical assumptions develop the CAPEX and OPEX cost for the project.
* Liaises with the lenders and the Lender's Engineer for the establishment of their due diligence report prior to Financial Close.
* Ensures detail coordination with all internal stakeholders: BD, Construction, Operation, Legal, Finance and Procurement teams
* Contributes to the internal approval process (for Bid submission including Construction, Technical and O\&M) until Financial Close. Ensures adequate internal reviews.
* Support the negotiations with the contractors.
* Punctually provides support to construction and operation activities.
* Prepares the technical hand\-over for execution stage.
* Ensures experience capitalization and REX integration.



  





**New Technologies and Decarbonisation Lead** 



* Acts as a SPOC for the ENGIE Group Research \& Innovation (R\&I) programmes and community
* Leads on implementation of decarbonisation initiatives or projects and supports other team members with decarbonisation topics
* Maintains a technology watch
* Fosters the innovation culture by coordinating and animating knowledge sharing



**Lead on Engagement of Third\-Party Engineering Consultants** 



* Keeps a market watch on engineering consultants (technical advisors)
* Leads the qualification, tendering, selection and management of technical consultants: Bid Technical Advisor, Owners’ Engineer, Lenders’ Technical Advisors, ESIA Consultant… on various AMEA projects



**Qualification/Experience** 



* Engineering degree, with a minimum of 15 years of experience.
* Experience in projects technical development.
* Experience in bid preparation.
* Experience in thermal power generation projects (preferably CCGT).
* Excellent capability in interpreting and optimising power plant design and performance; experience using Thermoflow software is a plus.
* Good understanding of thermal generation decarbonisation technologies, including renewable gases, CCUS…
* Experience in engaging and working with engineering consulting firms.
* Experience in preparing and negotiating contractual documents: WPA, PPA, PWPA, EPC, EPCM, subcontractors, O\&M, LTSA, LTPRA, consultants’ contracts...
* Experienced in interfacing with BD team, legal team, finance team, construction team, operation team.
* Experience in managing and coordinating research and innovation programmes will be an advantage.
* Experience in desalination will be an advantage.
* Experience within ENGIE Group will be an advantage.



**Character and Skills** 



* Pro\-active, autonomous, taking ownership of issues and drive to resolve them
* Organized and rigorous
* Strong analytical, communication and presentation skills
* Able to collaborate effectively with multiple stakeholders from different backgrounds
* Languages: fluent English. Arab or French will be an advantage.



  





  





 ENGIE group is a global reference in low\-carbon energy and services. Together with our 96,000 employees, our customers, partners and stakeholders, we are committed to accelerate the transition towards a carbon\-neutral world, through reduced energy consumption and more environmentally friendly solutions. Inspired by our purpose (“raison d’être”), we reconcile economic performance with a positive impact on people and the planet, building on our key businesses (gas, renewable energy, services) to offer competitive solutions to our customers.
 



 ENGIE’s Business Unit for the Asia Middle East and Africa (AMEA) region is headquartered in Dubai. The region has activities in large scale power generation, water desalination, district cooling, energy solutions and renewables including green hydrogen, wind and solar. We act throughout the value chain: strategy, design, engineering, energy\-efficient asset construction, digital platforms, operations management, financing syndication and outcome assurance. And, by using globally leading technologies, we create innovative energy and smart solutions that help to make the world a better place.

data.jd_text:
At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
   

  

 From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants International (LCI) is an autonomous business within Lummus Technology that provides technical, environmental \& social and management consulting services worldwide. We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants is looking for a Business Development Director to grow the company into the area of technical and management consulting in the energy industry – offshore and onshore oil \& gas, LNG, pipelines, power generation and transmission, as well as refining and petrochemicals. This role will be expected to help grow the consulting practice area in the fields of oil\& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization and will primarily entail growing relationships with the financial community and project developers. Assignments require a high level of experience and ability to focus quickly on important issues.
   

  

 The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.
   

  

**Position**
 The Business Development Director will be expected to grow and lead a new consulting practice area in the fields of Oil \& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization. The group VP and the Leadership Team should have contacts and skills to help him achieve this goal. An international focus is expected. Areas of skill and knowledge should include knowledge of project financing, capex benchmarking analysis, O\&M practices and costs, M\&A support, due diligence and strategy development. The candidate will be expected to lead and participate in advisory assignments, conduct business development, and manage his/her practice business area and interface with Lummus Consultants’ senior management. Additional business areas may be identified based upon the candidate’s personal history and strengths and interests.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
* Grow Lummus Consultants’ business – in cooperation with the existing business heads. His growth strategy should be heavily focused on technical solutions but with a broad business perspective beyond traditional due diligence assignments.
* Develop a business plan to capitalize on existing talents and resources within Lummus Consultants and Lummus Technology; the candidate’s strengths; and market opportunities.
* Grow name recognition of Lummus Consultants in all Energy industry segments (with assistance from the Lummus Communication team and other internal resources).
* Carry out business development, marketing, and proposal preparation efforts and lead Key Account Management teams efforts.
* Lead or participate in consulting project work.
* Prepare clear and concise written reports on assignments, develop conclusions and present clear and precise written and verbal results to clients.
* Expand the Lummus Consulting practice area (globally), consistent with the business plan – identify gaps in skills and potential recruits.
* Achieve objectives with minimal oversight.
* Management of the P\&L forecast by close collaboration with his supervisor and finance.
* Report to Senior Director of Lummus Consultants in Dubai office.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required**
* Strong leadership abilities and excellent interpersonal skills
* Strong communicator with excellent written and oral communication skills
* Must have a high degree of self\-motivation and energy
* Must have proven ability to manage business forecasting, short and long term projection
* Capability of earning respect from the team and capable of influencing others without authority
* Excellent professional image/presentation
* Knowledge of many cultures/international style
* Strong commercial savvy and negotiating skills
* Interest in being knowledgeable in all services offerings in Lummus Consultants portfolio
* Ability to work well with finance partners.
* Must have a strong balance of technical and commercial capabilities.


**Basic Qualifications**
* A degree\-educated Engineer; MBA is a plus but not required.
* The candidate should have at least 20 years relevant professional experience.
* Prior experience with an owner/operator or major engineering company and/or consultancy.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including ability to write clear and concise reports in English.
* The candidate should have strong interpersonal skills and be comfortable conversing with clients and senior management
* Demonstrated management and project management skills


**Office Location and Travel:**
* Dubai office. Relocation is not being offered.
* Job\-related travel (business trips usually requiring less than a two\-week duration; often just one or two days) which includes international travel to financial institutions in London, is an important part of the work. Time away from the office may average 10 to 30 percent of work hours.


 Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future. We license process technologies in clean fuels, renewables, petrochemicals, polymers, gas processing and supply lifecycle services, catalysts, proprietary equipment and digitalization to customers worldwide.

**About Jumeirah** 




 Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 29 properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and the brand is now renowned worldwide for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels and exclusive residences. From the contemporary Maldivian island paradise at Jumeirah Olhahali Island to the art\-inspired Jumeirah Capri Palace in Italy and the modern twist on a British classic at Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London, the brand has become synonymous with warm and generous service and the ability to craft distinctive and purposeful experiences that bring joy to guests from across the world.
 



  





  





**About Madinat Jumeirah** 




 Set along a two\-kilometre stretch of private coastline, Madinat Jumeirah is a beachfront resort comprising four distinctive hotels. Each offers uninterrupted views of the Arabian Gulf and the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab, with experiences ranging from the contemporary elegance of Jumeirah Al Naseem to the majestic Arabesque charm of Jumeirah Al Qasr. Guests can also enjoy the serene waterfront setting of Jumeirah Mina Al Salam and the secluded Arabian houses of Jumeirah Dar Al Masyaf. Together, they form a one\-of\-a\-kind destination rooted in Arabian luxury hospitality.  to

data.jd_text:
Due to the continuing success and growth of our AESG team, a fantastic opportunity has opened up at our award\-winning Specialist Consultancy, Engineering and Advisory Firm.
   

  

 We are headquartered in London, Riyadh, Singapore and Dubai, Cape Town, Cairo \& Sydney working throughout the Middle East, Europe and Asia. Our areas of expertise are represented in four core verticals: Building Engineering, Planning and Infrastructure, Strategy and Advisory and Commissioning, Handover and Asset Management.
   

  

 We pride ourselves in being leaders in the industry in each of the services that we offer. We have one of the largest dedicated team with decades of cumulative experience in sustainable design, fire and life safety, cost management, façade engineering, commissioning, building performance, waste management, environmental consultancy, carbon management and acoustics.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 AESG is seeking an experienced BIM Manager with deep expertise in data center and mission critical facility design to join our Mission Critical department. Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead BIM implementation, coordination, and delivery across diverse data center projects throughout the EMEA region, as well as occasional building services projects including hotels, offices, and commercial developments.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in BIM processes and digital design delivery with proven experience managing complex multidisciplinary coordination for hyperscale data center operators. This role requires hands\-on involvement in model production, team supervision, and technical delivery, while acting as the Lead Appointed Party under ISO 19650 for assigned projects.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Act as Lead Appointed Party for BIM delivery in accordance with ISO 19650, with formal authority to accept, reject, or delay information deliveries that do not meet agreed standards and client Exchange Information Requirements (EIR)
* Develop and maintain project\-level BIM Execution Plans (BEPs), Master Information Delivery Plans (MIDP), and review/approve Task Information Delivery Plans (TIDP) submitted by design disciplines
* Establish and manage Common Data Environment (CDE) structures using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360, including project setup, access control, folder structures, workflow configuration, status codes, and information containers (Work in Progress, Shared, Published, Archive)
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, chairing clash detection reviews, coordination meetings, and issue resolution sessions with architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, civil, and specialist disciplines
* Enforce BIM standards, protocols, and quality control procedures, ensuring compliance with ISO 19650, BSRIA BG6 guidance for MEP, hyperscaler\-specific requirements and client specifications
* Supervise and mentor project BIM teams on Revit best practices, family creation, parametric modeling, and workflow optimization, while maintaining hands\-on involvement in complex modeling tasks
* Manage COBie\-compliant asset data structuring and delivery for facilities management handover, supporting construction phase information delivery and digital twin integration
* Prepare and deliver BIM coordination reports, clash reports, design validation summaries, model quality audits, and lessons learned documentation
* Support business development through BIM capability presentations, technical demonstrations, and proposal preparation
* Identify and escalate BIM delivery risks early, implementing structured risk management procedures


**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
* 5\+ years progressive experience as BIM Manager, BIM Coordinator, or senior BIM role with significant focus on data center and mission critical facilities
* Proven application of ISO 19650 on live projects, including experience as Lead Appointed Party or within ISO 19650\-compliant frameworks, with working knowledge of EIR, BEP, MIDP, TIDP documentation
* Demonstrated expertise delivering projects for hyperscale operators (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) with deep understanding of their Revit templates, family libraries, naming conventions, and coordination workflows
* Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (Architecture, Structure, MEP) including parametric modeling, family creation, phasing, worksets, design options, view templates, and advanced scheduling, with hands\-on modeling experience
* Expert\-level experience with Common Data Environments (CDE) including Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) / BIM 360 administration, and strong expertise in Navisworks for 3D coordination, clash detection, and 4D sequencing
* Practical experience with COBie asset data structuring and familiarity with BSRIA BG6 Building Services BIM guidance
* Proven track record delivering data center projects across design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and EPC frameworks, coordinating mechanical, electrical, architectural, structural, civil, and specialist disciplines (fire protection, security, telecom)
* Significant experience with projects in GCC and broader EMEA region, with understanding of regional BIM maturity levels, local codes, and stakeholder dynamics
* Strong technical background in building services engineering with ability to read and interpret architectural and engineering drawings, understand construction methods, building systems, and MEP coordination requirements
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with ability to explain technical BIM concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and lead coordination meetings
* Proactive, structured approach with demonstrated ability to manage delivery risk and hold authority to challenge non\-compliant information
* Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline; professional certifications (Autodesk Certified Professional, buildingSMART certifications) preferred


**Desired Skills \& Attributes**
* Advanced BIM tools: Dynamo for Revit automation, Solibri for model checking, Bluebeam for PDF coordination, digital twin platforms for operational handover
* Point cloud processing and scan\-to\-BIM workflows for existing facility documentation
* Computational design and visual scripting (Dynamo, Grasshopper) for design automation
* Sustainable design coordination experience (LEED, BREEAM, ESTIDAMA) and energy modeling integration (IES VE, IES Apache, DesignBuilder)
* Data center\-specific BIM knowledge: hot/cold aisle modeling, cable tray routing for high\-density power, precision cooling coordination, raised floor systems, structured cabling infrastructure
* Federated model coordination strategies, including coordination sequencing, trade\-specific clash priorities, and progressive coordination approaches
* 4D scheduling integration (Navisworks Timeliner, Synchro) for construction sequencing visualization
* Understanding of data center monitoring systems (DCIM, EPMS, BMS) and BIM coordination with operational systems
* Experience supporting construction phase information delivery and commissioning coordination
* Mentoring capabilities with experience guiding junior BIM coordinators and modelers
* Project management skills including planning, resource allocation, and progress tracking
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in fast\-paced environments while maintaining quality standards


**What We Offer**
* Clear career progression with increasing leadership responsibilities as the department and BIM maturity expand
* Exposure to diverse mission critical projects across EMEA, working with leading hyperscaler operators and regional data center developers
* Direct reporting to Head of Mission Critical with significant autonomy to shape BIM processes, standards, and digital design delivery
* Hands\-on involvement with cutting\-edge data center projects including campus\-scale developments, high\-density AI infrastructure, and liquid cooling implementations
* Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience
* Professional development opportunities including training, industry conferences, and certifications

* Ensure effective merchandise and inventory management, including stock availability, pricing consistency, waste reduction, and minimization of shrinkage.
* Partner with Merchandising and Department Heads to maintain attractive product displays, efficient stock replenishment, and timely delivery of merchandise.
* Oversee supermarket service functions, including asset maintenance, hygiene, health \& safety compliance, and adherence to customer service standards.

* At Majid Al Futtaim, we’re on a mission to create great moments, to spread happiness, to build, experiences that stay in our memories for a lifetime. We’re proud to say that over the past 27 years, we have built a reputation as a regional market leader in what we do. Join us!

data.jd_text:
**Process Safety Management Specialist / Senior PSE** 




 The Process Safety Management (PSM) Specialist reports to the Head of Health \& Safety and supports the effective implementation of process safety management across the Generation International (GI) fleet.
 



 Working closely with the Process Safety manager, this role focuses on supporting the development of local PSM champions, coordinating process safety network activities, and facilitating hazard identification and risk analysis to help mitigate risks across assets. The role will contribute to training delivery, performance monitoring, incident investigations, and sharing lessons learned to drive continuous improvement.
 



 The position is based in Dubai, with frequent travel across the GI perimeter, including GCC, KSA, Africa, Chile, Peru, Mexico, Canada, and Australia to support site activities.
 



  





**Role Details** 



* **Reporting to:** 
 Head of Health and Safety, Generation International
* **Location:** 
 Dubai
* **Travel:** 
 \~70% across international sites
* **Employment Type:** 
 Permanent, Full\-Time



  





**Key Activities and Responsibilities** 




**Strategic** 



* Support the implementation and enhancement of process safety management practices across the GI fleet
* Contribute to the development of the fleet risk profile and support mitigation action tracking
* Assist in promoting process safety awareness across regions, countries, and asset teams
* Share process safety knowledge and lessons learned across the organization
* Encourage collaboration and knowledge exchange between sites and business units



  





**Operational** 



* Support compliance with Engie Group Rules, standards, and procedures (including GR09 H\&S in Industrial Projects and GEN PSM Fundamentals)
* Coordinate and contribute to process safety network meetings, reporting, and data sharing
* Participate in or support Process Hazard Risk Assessments (PHRA), including BowTie workshops and reviews
* Assist with tracking and close\-out of actions arising from risk assessments and audits
* Support implementation of hazard identification and risk assessment processes, including Safety Critical Elements (SCEs)
* Participate in safety reviews (HAZID, HAZOP, audits, inspections) across O\&M and project sites
* Support project teams in meeting process safety requirements throughout the project lifecycle
* Maintain and update process safety documentation to ensure accuracy and alignment with site conditions
* Contribute to incident investigations and root cause analysis (e.g., TapRoot methodology)
* Ensure timely reporting of Process Safety Events (PSEs) in the One Safety Tool (OST)



  





**Organisational** 



* Support the development and rollout of PSM training programs and materials
* Contribute to competency development of site teams and PSM champions
* Assist in setting and tracking process safety objectives and KPIs



  





**Planning \& Performance Monitoring** 



* Support the maintenance of process safety dashboards and KPIs
* Monitor process safety performance and highlight trends or areas for improvement
* Assist in identifying and tracking corrective and preventive actions



  





**Decision Making** 



* Provide input into project safety reviews and derogation requests
* Participate in investigation teams for process safety events
* Escalate key risks and support mitigation planning



  





**Collaboration** 



* Work closely with asset PSM champions and support their development
* Collaborate with Industrial Projects H\&S teams and site management
* Promote sharing of process safety knowledge across all levels of the organization



  





**Leadership \& Contribution** 



* Act as a key contributor to process safety initiatives within GI
* Support awareness campaigns and training delivery
* Participate actively in safety reviews, audits, and investigations
* Contribute to a strong process safety culture across the organization



  





**Required Qualifications** 




**Education** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, or a related field
* NEBOSH Certificate in Process Safety Management (or equivalent) preferred



  





**Experience** 



* **6–8 years’ experience** 
 in process safety, industrial safety, or related fields
* Experience in power generation, energy, or industrial environments is advantageous
* Exposure to hazard analysis techniques (e.g., HAZOP, BowTie) preferred



  





**Knowledge \& Skills** 



* Understanding of industrial processes and associated risks
* Familiarity with process safety management systems and standards
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities
* Good communication skills with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders
* Ability to support training delivery and knowledge sharing
* Basic incident investigation and root cause analysis skills
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across geographies

data.jd_text:
**Some brands sell products.** 




**We help shape decisions that change lives.** 




  





 Every day, 24 million measurements are taken on a seca device somewhere in the world. In hospitals in Tokyo, clinics in São Paulo, GP practices in Hamburg. The data that flows from those moments helps doctors, nurses, and specialists make decisions that matter — sometimes routine, sometimes life\-changing.
 



  





 We are not a tech startup. We are not a challenger brand reinventing ourselves every 18 months. We are a 185\-year\-old family business with the discipline of a world market leader, the curiosity of engineers who still love what they build, and a marketing team that thinks in campaigns — not content calendars.
 



  





**And we have one open seat.** 




  





**What this role actually is:** 




 As
 **Senior Creative \- Campaign Art Direction (m/f/d)** 
 you will be a central creative force behind our international campaigns across Medical and Fitness — two demanding, visually distinct segments, both requiring the kind of strategic depth and executional craft that only comes from real agency experience.
 



  





 This is not a production role. This is not a "make it beautiful" role. This is a thinking\-and\-making role, where concept and execution are inseparable and where the quality of the idea is just as accountable as the quality of the layout.
 



  





 You will join an international team at our
 **office in Dubai, UAE** 
 and work closely with our Global Marketing and Creative teams at our headquarters in Hamburg, Germany inside our inhouse creative studio — structured and resourced like an agency, embedded in one of the most internationally active Health Tech companies in the world. Working closely with and under the creative direction of our Head of Creative, you will develop campaigns from brief to delivery across digital\-first formats: landing pages, paid social, display, video, and interactive platforms. You bring the craft, the concept discipline, and the drive to see an idea through without needing someone to push it. What you do not bring is the ego of someone who needs to run the room.
 



  





**What you will be responsible for:** 



* Developing campaign concepts from strategic brief to final execution — under creative direction, but with genuine ownership of your work
* Executing the visual language of integrated campaigns across digital, social, and where relevant, linear formats including trade fair and print
* Creating and art directing digital experiences: landing pages, UI concepts, interactive campaign formats
* Maintaining creative quality across global rollouts adapted for up to 16 international markets and languages
* Collaborating directly with Marketing and Product Management, with the professionalism to represent the creative work clearly and confidently



  





**What you bring:** 



* Minimum 10 years of experience in advertising or brand communications, with a substantial part of that in an agency environment
* A portfolio that demonstrates both conceptual strength and executional mastery — campaigns you conceived and built, not just approved
* Deep expertise in Figma and Adobe CC; you work in the tools, not around them
* Proven experience in digital campaign production: landing pages, paid social, motion graphics
* Experience in Medical, Health Tech, or Fitness marketing is a significant advantage — you understand that this audience demands precision, not flair for its own sake
* Fluent English, written and spoken — our campaigns are global, our briefs are often in English, and your presentations will be too
* Linear advertising experience (TV, OOH, AV) is a bonus, not a barrier
* The maturity to thrive within a defined creative direction while still bringing your own strong point of view to every brief



  





**What we offer:** 




 We will skip the part about the coffee and the fruit basket. You have read that before. What we can offer that most can not: the creative ambition of an agency environment, inside a company with genuine market authority, a 185\-year legacy that is not a limitation but a creative challenge, and a product portfolio that genuinely affects human health. Your work will reach healthcare professionals across 17 international branches and over 175,000 customers worldwide.
 



  





 Join a workplace that connects, motivates, and moves forward together – where your work has real impact.
 



  





**About seca** 




 Founded in Hamburg in 1840, seca has grown from a precision scale workshop into a global Health Tech brand. For over 185 years, we have built devices and software solutions that help healthcare professionals make better decisions — in hospitals, clinics, rehabilitation centers, and fitness facilities around the world. As a family\-owned company now in its fourth generation, we operate 17 international branches.
 



  





**Ready to shape international campaigns for a global Health Tech brand?** 
 Apply today and help define how seca communicates across Medical, Fitness, and digital platforms. We look forward to receiving your complete application.
 



  





**Please note that only applications including a relevant portfolio or selected work samples will be considered.**

data.jd_text:
The Head of Engineering is responsible for establishing and leading the engineering function as a core competitive advantage for the System Integration Division. The role provides strategic and technical leadership across design, protection, automation, panel engineering, and system architecture to ensure delivery of reliable, cost\-effective, and compliant solutions.
   

  

 The position drives engineering excellence through standardization, technology adoption, strong customer technical engagement, and robust project execution while ensuring profitability, quality, safety, and customer satisfaction. The role also builds organizational capability by developing high\-performing engineering teams, strengthening supplier and OEM partnerships, and supporting bids, new solutions, and product development initiatives.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
****Job Responsibilities****
****Job Requirements****
**Engineering Strategy \& Technical Authority**
* Define and implement the engineering strategy, design philosophy, and technical governance framework for the division.
* Establish company standards for drawings, documentation, SLDs, wiring diagrams, design templates, and BOM structures.
* Act as the final technical approval authority for all engineering deliverables and design packages.
* Own technical risk management and ensure alignment with business profitability and margin targets.
* Lead high\-level technical engagement with clients, consultants, utilities, and OEM partners.
* Define and execute the technology roadmap including adoption of modern substation automation, IEC 61850 architectures, smart MCCs, and digitalization initiatives.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective action for major technical failures, NCRs, or quality concerns.


* Project Engineering \& Bid Management
* Provide technical leadership during bids, tenders, and proposal stage, ensuring optimal technical and commercial positioning.
* Validate technical compliance with customer specifications, international standards, and contractual requirements.
* Oversee project engineering to ensure designs are delivered on time, within budget, and with zero major deviations.
* Manage interfaces with clients, consultants, OEMs (Siemens, ABB, GE, SEL, Schneider, etc.), and internal stakeholders.
* Balance standardization vs. customization to improve efficiency without compromising project requirements.
* Support business growth by enabling engineering capability for new markets, products, and solutions.
* Ensure seamless coordination with Testing \& Commissioning teams for successful system validation and handover.
* Departmental Leadership \& Capability Building
* Establish and lead a high\-performing engineering organization including Protection, Automation, Design, and Application Engineering.
* Define competency frameworks, skill matrix, and succession pipeline for critical roles.
* Drive recruitment, mentoring, and technical capability development.
* Optimize engineering resource planning across multiple concurrent projects.
* Foster a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Commercial \& Value Engineering
* Own engineering cost optimization through value engineering and design efficiency.
* Review and influence project profitability through technical decisions.
* Identify cost drivers within BOMs and propose alternatives without compromising performance.
*
