data.jd_text:
The College of Engineering (CEN) at American University of Sharjah (AUS) invites applicants for the position of the Head of the Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering (CHBE) starting Fall 2027\. The college is seeking a visionary academic leader with the responsibilities of ensuring smooth and successful operation and sustainable development of the department.
   

  

 The candidate for the position must hold earned degrees, including a doctorate, in chemical engineering or a related field. The candidate must have demonstrated leadership in research, as evidenced by her/his outstanding publication record. In addition, a demonstrated record of excellence in teaching, and in academic and relevant professional services is required. The selected individual will have the opportunity to develop and articulate a vision and long\-range plan for the department in teaching and in research strategy that embodies the relevant areas that are vital to the department and the region. Special consideration will be given to candidates with a clear vision and achievable goals that are in line with the college’s and university’s strategic plans.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The successful candidate must be a dynamic, collaborative, visionary and innovative individual with demonstrated leadership experience that can promote the continued advancement of the department. He/she is expected to have strong communication skills to effectively engage with a wide variety of constituents within and outside the university. His/her leadership style should include positive attitude, transparency, integrity, trust, fairness, promptness and collegiality. In addition to the general and wide responsibilities of the department head position, as partially outlined in the
 *Faculty Handbook* 
 , the selected applicant will be required to:
   

  

* provide effective leadership with well\-defined plans to nurture and elevate the standard of the department, accompanied with the development of short\-term and long\-term strategies in alignment with the strategic plans of the college and the university
* ensure high\-quality teaching as well as holistic development of the students, using approaches such as technology supported delivery, problem\-based learning, and other cutting\-edge trends in engineering education, in addition to leading the continuous improvement of the curriculum
* facilitate the conduct of innovative and cutting\-edge research of high\-quality and impact and promote multidisciplinary research with the optimal use of research funds and research facilities
* empower, mentor, promote, inspire and support faculty and staff to develop and sustain excellence in teaching, research and service
* foster a positive culture of innovation and entrepreneurship among faculty and students
* improve continuously teaching, research and service through benchmarking
* lead the department in achieving student recruitment goals by establishing and implementing recruitment plans for undergraduate and graduate students
* enrich the students’ experience via enhanced services, exchange visits, invited speakers, field trips, student clubs, professional certifications, competitions, conferences, etc.
* secure full\-time and internship positions and provide undergraduate research experience to the students
* participate in outreach activities, including maintaining ties and collaborations with alumni, industry, government, advisory boards, other university units and community members, and maintaining involvement in local and international professional organizations
* advertise locally and publicly the achievements and expertise of the faculty, staff and students of the department through web, newsletters and media exposure to enhance the academic reputation of the program
* collect data systematically and continuously from the department to plan and execute informed decisions
* ensure and increase diversity and equity in faculty hiring and student recruitment
* maintain and actively promote a positive, safe, transparent, fair, open, respectful, collegial working environment at the department, college and university
* interact and communicate effectively with individual faculty, staff and students (and parents) on a range of professional and personal issues
* represent the faculty and staff and convey their needs to the college’s and university’s administration.
* oversee the department’s operations including scheduling, advising, registration, lab preparations, budget allocation, compliance and risk management, etc.
* review and coordinate faculty course releases, sabbaticals and leave without pay requests
* conduct fair faculty and staff annual evaluations and provide effective feedback
* evaluate faculty and staff for promotion and/or rolling contract decisions
* lead and manage accreditation visits
* performing other duties as needed or assigned by the Dean


 Applicants should fill out an application form and upload the required documents (PDF) using the following \<a href\="javascript:aus\_external\_warning\_ShowExternalUrlDialog("https://acg\-apps1\.aus.edu/cen/empapp/apply.php?p\=CHE\-DH\-26\-01");"\>link. The required documents are a cover letter and a detailed curriculum vitae (including a teaching statement, a research statement, vision and goals for the department, list of courses that can be taught or were taught, and names of at least three references who would be willing to write letters of recommendation). Positions are open until filled. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
   

  

 The Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering has approximately 200 undergraduate students, 15 graduate students, 12 full\-time faculty and 3 lab instructors. Students and faculty represent very diverse backgrounds and nationalities; approximately 90 nationalities are present on campus. The department offers a Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering, a Bachelor of Science in Chemical and Biological Engineering, and a Master of Science in Chemical Engineering.
   

  

 AUS is located in the Emirate of Sharjah (about 15 km from Dubai). AUS is an independent, not\-for\-profit, coeducational university, serving more than 5,700 students. Further information can be obtained here.
   

  

 AUS is licensed and its programs are accredited by the Commission for Academic Accreditation of the Ministry of Education's Higher Education Affairs Division in the United Arab Emirates. AUS has been accredited in the United States of America by the Middle States Commission on Higher Education (1007 North Orange Street, 4th Floor, MB \#166, Wilmington, DE 19801 USA) since June 2004\. The Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering offered by the College of Engineering is accredited by the Engineering Accreditation Commission of ABET, \<a href\="javascript:aus\_external\_warning\_ShowExternalUrlDialog("http://www.abet.org/");"\>http://www.abet.org/.

**About Us**
 We are the real estate subsidiary of a well\-established, diversified business group with interests across multiple industries in the GCC. Our business focuses on the development, ownership, and management of a diverse portfolio of residential, commercial, mixed\-use, and retail real estate assets. With capabilities spanning the full real estate lifecycle—from project development and construction to leasing, property management, and asset operations—we are committed to delivering high\-quality developments and creating long\-term value for our stakeholders.
   

  

 As we continue to expand our portfolio and strengthen our market presence, we are seeking an accomplished Finance Director to lead our finance function and play a pivotal role in shaping the company’s financial strategy and supporting sustainable growth.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Finance Director will provide overall financial leadership, governance, and strategic direction across the organization. Reporting to senior executive management, you will drive financial performance, capital efficiency, and disciplined investment decision\-making across a diversified real estate portfolio.
   

  

 You will oversee both development and operational real estate assets, ensuring strong financial control across project delivery, leasing operations, property management, and investment activities. This role requires a strong combination of strategic vision, technical finance expertise, and hands\-on leadership within a complex real estate environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Financial Strategy \& Leadership
   

  

* Lead financial planning, forecasting, and performance management across the business.
* Support executive leadership in evaluating investments, acquisitions, and development opportunities.
* Provide financial insights to drive profitability, capital efficiency, and long\-term value creation.


 Development \& Asset Finance
   

  

* Oversee financial management of development projects from acquisition through completion and stabilization.
* Manage project budgets, cash flows, escrow accounts, and contractor/consultant payments.
* Monitor financial performance across leasing, property management, and retail assets.


 Treasury \& Funding
   

  

* Manage liquidity, cash flow planning, and banking relationships.
* Lead negotiations for project finance, banking facilities, refinancing, and restructuring.


 Financial Planning \& Analysis
   

  

* Lead budgeting, forecasting, and long\-term financial planning.
* Develop financial models and feasibility studies for new developments and investments.


 Commercial \& Investment Support
   

  

* Review and support negotiation of key commercial contracts and agreements.
* Provide financial input into investment structuring and strategic decision\-making.


 Governance \& Controls
   

  

* Ensure compliance with IFRS and internal control frameworks.
* Oversee audits, statutory reporting, and financial governance processes.
* Strengthen financial policies, systems, and controls across the organization.


 Leadership \& Team Development
   

  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing finance team.
* Build strong finance capability across development and operational business units.
* Foster a culture of accountability, performance, and continuous improvement.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Economics; professional qualification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, CMA) preferred.
* 15\+ years of progressive finance experience, ideally within real estate development and asset management.
* Strong experience in development finance, including project cash flows, escrow structures, and contractor payment processes.
* Strong financial modelling, feasibility analysis, and investment evaluation skills.
* Experience across both development and operational real estate portfolios, including leasing, property management, and retail assets.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience in contract review and investment decision support.


 Why Join Us?
   

  

 Join a leading real estate company within a diversified group, where you will play a key role in shaping financial strategy, enabling major developments, and driving long\-term value creation across a growing portfolio.

data.jd_text:
Independent Food Company is home to some of the region's most recognised hospitality concepts, including SALT, Somewhere, Parker's, Shalwa, Somewhere, and Public. We are a fast\-growing organisation with an expanding portfolio of concepts, an active acquisition strategy, and ambitious plans for growth across new and existing markets. As we scale, the quality of our people remains central to everything we build. That is where you come in.
 



  





**Job Purpose:** 




 The Director of Real Estate is responsible for managing and expanding the organization’s retail property portfolio, including site selection, lease negotiations, budget analysis, and store openings across the UAE and franchisees. This role requires strategic leadership to develop and implement real estate strategies aligned with the company’s vision, while building strong relationships with key stakeholders and ensuring compliance with industry standards. The Director will lead a team and work closely with operations, project managers, and developers to identify growth opportunities, mitigate risks, and achieve sustainable expansion.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Strategic Planning and Market Analysis:** 




 • Conduct in\-depth market and competitive analysis to develop independent expansion plans, either in house or outsourced.
 



 • Prepare and submit annual business plans to the board, ensuring equal growth opportunities for all brands.
 



 • Create and implement real estate strategies tailored to each brand’s demographics, pricing, and product range.
 



 • Present brand market potential and expansion capacity for the next 3 years.
 



 • Conduct Real Estate Market Mapping and Sales Forecasting.
 



 • Develop and present detailed feasibility studies, including financial projections and market analysis, prior to obtaining site approvals
 



  





**Existing Portfolio Management, Renewals, and Crisis Resolution** 




 • Portfolio Oversight \& Performance Tracking: Proactively manage and monitor the performance of the existing real estate portfolio, conducting monthly reviews of asset performance, rent\-to\-sales ratios, and location viability.
 



 • Lease Renewals \& Restructuring: Oversee the end\-to\-end lease renewal pipeline, evaluating historical store performance to determine whether to renew, renegotiate terms, relocate, or exit properties.
 



 • Crisis Management \& Landlord Relations: Act as the primary point of escalation and resolution for property crises (e.g., operational disruptions, landlord\-tenant disputes, mall maintenance issues affecting sales, or unexpected economic downturns). Lead rent\-reduction or lease\-restructuring negotiations during operational crises to safeguard company margins.
 



  





**Site Selection and Management** 




 • Aggressive Location Scouting: Lead hands\-on, ground\-level field scouting and site mapping to uncover premium, off\-market, or high\-potential spaces (malls, high\-streets, cloud kitchens, and standalone spots) tailored to specific brand concepts.
 



 • Conduct comprehensive site assessments, traffic counts, visibility analyses, and accessibility mapping to guarantee optimum footfall and brand exposure.
 



 • Investigate, evaluate, and identify potential sites, markets, towns, and competition for new store locations.
 



 • Manage schedules for projects and oversee processes to obtain permits and approvals.
 



 • Prepare detailed project estimates and reports for management review.
 



  





**F\&B Project Development** 




 • Oversee the development of F\&B projects, including feasibility studies, design monitoring, and financial analyses.
 



 • Develop and implement strategies to expand and improve F\&B offerings in retail locations, aligning with company goals and market trends.
 



 • Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to align F\&B goals with overall business objectives.
 



 • Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
 



 • Provide insights and guidance on food and beverage (F\&B) operations, including labor optimization, supply chain logistics, and customer service standards, to ensure successful project execution.
 



 • Ensure properties and real estate strategies aligned with delivering exceptional guest experiences, prioritizing innovation, quality, and service excellence
 



  





**Team Development and Risk Management** 




 • Recruit, manage, and develop a high\-performing team, including managers and supervisors, to build a reliable and effective department for market mapping and research.
 



 • Ensure compliance with relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards in all property dealings. • Identify and mitigate risks, including regulatory and financial risks, through effective risk management strategies.
 



 • Foster a positive and collaborative team culture, aligned with the company’s core value
 



  





**Contractual \& Commercial Lease Terms Governance** 




 • Legal \& Commercial De\-risking: Direct the drafting, review, and structuring of all legal lease agreements, ensuring all commercial and operational terms protect the company's long\-term interests.
 



 • Clause Enforcement: Secure favorable legal clauses, including but not limited to: Exclusivity/Non compete protections within specific developments, clear termination and break\-clauses, realistic force majeure terms, and capped annual rent escalations.
 



  





**Landlord Negotiations \& Deal Structuring** 




 • Deal Sourcing \& Commercial Pitches: Lead high\-stakes commercial negotiations with major developers (e.g., Emaar, Nakheel, Majid Al Futtaim, Merex) and private landlords to secure highly competitive rates and preferential positioning.
 



 • Financial Terms Optimization: Strategically negotiate base rents, turnover rent percentages, rent\-free periods (fit\-out periods), key money, and landlord fit\-out contributions to maximize early\-stage ROI and reduce capital expenditure.
 



  





**Business Development and Relationship Management** 




 • Create, pitch, and build new leads with developers, investors, and local authorities.
 



 • Develop business and market plans for all brands acquired or franchised by the company.
 



 • Address stakeholder concerns and collaborate on approvals and permits.
 



 • Stay updated on industry trends, demographic shifts, and competitor activities to identify new opportunities and recommend strategies for sustainable growth.
 



 • Demonstrate cultural awareness and sensitivity by understanding local customs, preferences, and business practices in the Middle East, ensuring alignment with regional expectations
 



  





**Other Duties:** 




 Perform other duties and responsibilities as may be assigned by management from time to time.

**Job Description**
**About Us**
 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

****Job Description****
 The Senior Director, Visa Global Processor Partnerships, is responsible for executing business development strategies through partnership to grow our business and drive innovation adoption with processor partners located in Visa’s CEMEA Region (Central Europe, Middle East, and Africa). These clients are third party issuer processors (TPP\\’s).
   

  

 This person will work with CEMEA Processing Head in CEMEA region and provide operational support, strategic analysis, sales analysis and technical expertise. The result of these efforts will be increasing strategic value to the client, identifying new uses cases, and delivering Visa innovation across the ecosystem including processing (Issuer), program management, BIN sponsorship and core solutions.
   

  

 The Senior Director will also directly develop the portfolio of issuer processors and processing resellers in the CEMEA region.
   

  

 The role requires a deep understanding of the payments ecosystem, its players, and payment technologies. The Senior Director is required to say abreast of global payment trends and technologies that may affect client strategies.
   

  

 This position is full\-time and located in Dubai.
   

  

 As the Senior Director for Global Processor Partnerships, you will:
   

  

* Head the development and execution of all related sales activities with all Issuer processor in CEMEA region
* Work with product and processing teams to identify and prioritize the implementation of Visa solutions (tokenization, push payments, installments, digital issuance, risk and dispute solutions) for TPP integration and distribution.
* Identify and eliminate friction points that limit our ability to innovate and drive brand outcomes
* Oversee the development and management of the reporting of CEMEA Processing Partnership sales plans, including relevant metrics. Review KPI’s regularly with Processing Head to identify variances and work with the RPS team to address them.

* Identify strategic opportunities through a strong understanding of clients’ businesses, including payment processing strategies aligned with Visa’s overall strategy
* Build and deepen relationships/partnerships with processor executives
* Prepare proposals, RFP’s, and negotiate contractual relationships with various internal and external stakeholders
* Participate on relevant cross\-functional teams (internal / external) that include representation from Product, Technology, Corporate Strategy, Digital Innovation, Operations, Marketing, Risk and Market Research groups


 This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.

* 12\-15 years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 8\-10 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 6\+ years of work experience with a PhD
* 10 years Pre\-Sales or business development experience with related TPP sales and relationship management experience in the payments industry; issuer/acquirer processing experience/functional processing understanding is critical.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to establish effective relationships with all levels, including senior management
* Excellent strategic thinking and analytic skills and a proven track record of creating solutions that increase revenue
* Ability to manage \& grow internal and external resources and cross\-functional relationships
* Proven ability negotiating business agreements and ability to enhance existing and develop new business partnerships

WW\+P is a world\-leading architecture, urban design, and planning practice with more than 400 architects, urban designers, and planners across 12 studios worldwide, including offices in London and Manchester. Founded in 1985, the practice integrates planning, urban design, landscape architecture, and architecture to deliver projects that combine visionary regenerative design thinking with technical excellence. Our work spans scales and disciplines to create better cities, smarter infrastructure, and more inclusive communities.
   

  





 WW\+P is also a member of the 10N Collective, a group of leading urbanism, architecture, and design practices brought together by Egis. In 2026, SvN Architects and Planners merged with WW\+P, bringing together more than 80 years of combined expertise in transformative urban design and planning.
   

  





 As part of the Egis Group, a global leader in architecture, consulting, engineering, construction, and mobility services, WW\+P contributes to shaping sustainable, resilient, and climate\-responsive environments worldwide. Operating in 100 countries with 19,500 employees, Egis delivers innovative solutions that support balanced territorial development and improve quality of life for communities around the globe.
   

  





 In the Middle East, Egis employs 3,500 professionals across eight countries and has successfully delivered more than 700 complex development projects. Recognised among the region's leading engineering and consulting firms, Egis combines global expertise with deep local knowledge to support governments, investors, and developers in delivering sustainable growth and lasting positive impact.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**
* Represent WW\+P in the region, utilising a comprehensive knowledge of the WW\+P project portfolio, values, and approach.
* Collaborate with the WW\+P global studio, primarily through liaison with the Middle East Managing Director and Senior Leadership Team.
* Collaborate with the 10N Collective to maximise working synergies and support regional growth.
* Collaborate with all relevant Egis Business Lines and Units to maximise working synergies and support growth. Close working relationships with relevant colleagues in Transportation, Energy \& Sustainable Cites, and Aviation will be important to the success of the role.
* Support the management of design teams based in the WW\+P global studios, in the role of local first\-point\-of\-contact for clients and partners.
* Build key client relationships through increased exposure and networking and establish business opportunity within this.
* Be a champion of a user\-centric design philosophy, demonstrating empathy with end\-users and creating projects that resonate with their needs and desires.
* Safeguard and evolve the identity of WW\+P, ensuring output aligns with the brand's values and messaging.
* Support and mine new business opportunities: advance the client’s knowledge of core capabilities; recognize untapped opportunities within existing relationships; leverage formal and informal networks in the pursuit of new business possibilities.
* Maximise project profit returns where possible.


**Qualifications**
* Proven track record of delivering excellent, award\-winning design on a variety of project typologies.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate and present design concepts to diverse stakeholders.
* Knowledge of the Middle East construction market, including the relevant local and international clients, consultants, contractors and stakeholders.
* Leadership experience including the ability to communicate with and manage remote design teams.
* Strong commercial understanding and project management.
* Exceptional portfolio showcasing a diverse range of design projects and successful implementations.

 This global portfolio operations team is seeking an experienced Executive Director to play a key leadership role within a rapidly growing investment platform. The successful candidate will be responsible for originating, evaluating, executing, and managing investments across multiple asset classes while contributing to portfolio strategy, capital allocation decisions, and overall business growth.
   

  

 Working closely with senior leadership, the Executive Director will lead transaction execution, manage stakeholder relationships, mentor investment professionals, and help shape the long\-term investment strategy of the platform.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Investment Strategy \& Portfolio Management**
* Support the development and execution of investment strategy across targeted sectors, geographies, and asset classes
* Identify investment themes, market trends, and emerging opportunities aligned with strategic objectives
* Provide recommendations on capital allocation, portfolio construction, and risk management
* Monitor portfolio performance and recommend value creation initiatives


**Deal Origination \& Execution**
* Source and originate investment opportunities through established industry networks and strategic relationships
* Lead all stages of the investment process, including opportunity assessment, financial analysis, valuation, structuring, due diligence, negotiations, and execution
* Prepare investment memoranda and present recommendations to senior management and investment committees
* Coordinate with legal, tax, technical, commercial, and financial advisors throughout transaction processes


**Asset Management \& Value Creation**
* Work closely with portfolio companies, operating partners, and management teams to drive performance improvement and strategic initiatives
* Support business transformation, operational optimisation, growth strategies, and capital planning across investments
* Monitor key financial and operational performance indicators and report on portfolio developments


**Leadership \& Stakeholder Management**
* Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, financial institutions, advisors, developers, operators, and strategic partners
* Represent the organisation in negotiations, industry events, and key stakeholder meetings
* Mentor and develop junior investment professionals, fostering a high\-performance culture
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with finance, legal, risk, treasury, and business leadership teams


**Governance \& Risk Management**
* Ensure all investments adhere to internal governance frameworks, investment policies, and risk management standards
* Present investment opportunities and portfolio updates to governance committees and senior leadership
* Maintain high standards of compliance, transparency, and fiduciary responsibility


**Skills \& Experience**
**Essential Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Engineering, Real Estate, or related discipline
* 12\-18\+ years of relevant experience in private equity, sovereign wealth funds, investment management, principal investing, infrastructure, real estate, private credit, or investment banking
* Demonstrated track record of leading complex transactions from origination through execution
* Strong financial modelling, valuation, due diligence, and investment analysis capabilities
* Experience managing senior stakeholders and presenting to investment committees and boards
* Excellent commercial judgement and strategic thinking skills
* Strong leadership capabilities with experience managing and developing teams
* Outstanding communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills


**Preferred Qualifications**
* MBA, CFA, CAIA, or other relevant postgraduate qualification
* Experience investing across real estate, infrastructure, private equity, credit, or alternative investments

 Why This Role Stands Out
   

  

 This position offers the opportunity to shape investment strategy and drive value creation across multiple asset classes within a rapidly growing platform.  The role is responsible for providing excellence in fund services client relationship management. managing and nurturing client relationships within our fund administration division. This role requires a deep understanding of fund administration services, strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to provide tailored solutions to meet clients’ fund administration needs. The role holder shall primarily interface between external parties (investment managers, auditors, bankers, brokers, legal counsels etc.) to understand their requirements and internal parties (different production units globally) to ensure compliance, ensuring all the deliverables are accurate, on time and of high quality.
   

  

**Primary Duties And Responsibilities**
 Client Relationship Management:
   

  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of fund administration clients, building and maintaining strong, long\-term relationships.
* Conduct regular meetings with clients to understand their fund administration needs, regulatory requirements, and reporting preferences.
* Ensure clients are informed about the full range of fund administration services available and provide expert guidance on best practices.
* Interpret the data and answer queries that might arise from the Investment Manager or investors regarding the financial statements of a fund and in particular its portfolio investments, fee calculations and NAV per share.
* Attending client meetings and provide technical support to the sales team.


**Service Delivery And Quality Assurance**
* Collaborate with internal fund accounting teams to ensure the accurate and timely delivery of services to clients.

* Communicate regularly and effectively with the Fund Accounting team in India/ Mauritius who are responsible for all accounting and investor services.
* Give administrative support to Fund Services team and Fund Relationship Manager, including arranging payments, keeping filing updated, scanning and faxing.
* Constant monitoring of shareholder services to ensure up to date processing of subscription and redemptions, with timely completion of KYC/AML checks.


**Time Recording**
* Accurately record chargeable time and value of service using Maconomy, ensure effective monitoring of transactions, handle pricing, invoicing and collection of outstanding fees for the portfolio of clients.
* Monitor own productivity and chargeability on weekly basis and review productivity and performance against targets. to ensure that individual financial targets and client communication KPIs are met.
* Follow a disciplined approach to submitting timesheets for client work and meet the weekly and monthly time/chargeability targets


**Other Duties**
* Undertake the role of director, trustee, nominee, manager, partner, secretary, authorized signatory or any related position in internal entities or client entities of Amicorp Group, where necessary and required by the Management.

**Qualifications, Skills, And Experience**
* Relevant Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics or Business Administration. CPA/ CA/ CAIA qualified or part qualified (preferred but not a must)

* Experience in Private Equity fund structuring, waterfall distribution, carried interest calculation are highly
* appreciated. Basic understanding on offshore jurisdiction fund structures as well as industry relevant regulations including FATCA, CRS, BEPS, GAAR, ESR.
* Excellent organizational, interpersonal and communication skills, preferable in regional languages. Exceptional client facing skills. Well\-developed spoken and written communication skills and the ability to tailor style to relevant audiences, and successfully liaise with people at different levels. Excellent English language fluency; additional languages preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills, solution driven, highly organized and detail\-orientated with good decision making and time management skills. Independent, hands\-on and takes accountability to deliver solutions and results.
* Ability to adapt and work in a smaller, dynamic local team environment with tight deadlines; along with being part of a bigger matrix organization. Proven team player skills, with ambition to excel in the role and grow into fund origination and structuring.

Established in 2004, Dubai Holding is a global investment company with investments in more than 34 countries and a combined workforce of nearly 45,000 individuals. In line with the vision of Dubai’s leadership and economic diversification strategy, Dubai Holding companies have nurtured sectors, irrevocably transforming Dubai’s socio\-economic landscape and positioning Dubai as a diversified, globally integrated economy.
 



 Dubai Holding is committed to the diversification of Dubai’s non\-oil economy. Our portfolio, valued at over AED 280\+ billion, spans 10 sectors, including real estate, hospitality, leisure \& entertainment, ICT, design, education, media, retail, manufacturing \& logistics, and science.
 



  





**For the Good of Tomorrow** 




 Dubai Holding is currently seeking a
 **Senior Manager – Digital Services** 
 , reporting to the Director – Infrastructure Operations. The role holder is responsible for the strategy, delivery, and continuous evolution of the organisation's web platform ecosystem, spanning a portfolio of 100\+ digital properties, enterprise API integrations, cloud\-hosted web applications, and internal business automation solutions.
 



 The role holds end\-to\-end ownership of web platform operations across the organisation, orchestrating the combined capabilities of internal development teams, strategic third\-party vendors, and emerging technologies to deliver secure, performant, and accessible digital experiences at scale.
 



 A core contributor to the group\-wide digital strategy and technology roadmap, the role plays an integral role in shaping and executing the direction of the organization's web platform function — ensuring all solutions and initiatives are grounded in sound architectural principles, aligned to security, compliance, and governance requirements, and structured to deliver tangible business value.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities** 



* Define and own the organization's web platform architecture strategy, ensuring all digital solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned to business objectives.
* Act as the senior solution architect across all web development initiatives, bridging the gap between business requirements and technical delivery.
* Oversee the full lifecycle management of web platform components, from planning, procurement, and development through to deployment and decommissioning, operating within defined budgets, risk appetites, and compliance frameworks.
* Take executive ownership of the availability, stability, performance, and compliance of all web platform services — including 100\+ Web flow\-managed digital properties, Azure\-hosted web applications, and associated integration services — ensuring they remain fit for purpose and aligned with agreed service levels.
* Drive a proactive performance culture across the function, ensuring continuous monitoring, technical SEO and AEO optimization, analytics configuration, and resolution of platform issues before they impact the business or end\-user experience.
* Provide 24/7 senior operational oversight for the digital portfolio, serving as the escalation point for critical incidents and urgent business requests, and applying deep technical expertise to rapidly coordinate resolution and minimize business impact.
* Serve as the organization's senior authority on web security and data protection, owning compliance with information security standards, proactively monitoring for vulnerabilities, and driving the implementation of security improvements across the entire digital portfolio.
* Champion rigorous standards for web accessibility, ensuring all digital properties meet WCAG compliance requirements, and embedding accessibility principles from design inception through to production delivery.
* Own and govern the organization's cookies consent framework across 100\+ digital properties, overseeing technical implementation, monitoring ongoing compliance, and managing the strategic relationship with the cookies consent solution vendor.
* Ensure all web platform solutions adhere to data protection, information security, and accessibility standards — embedding required principles and design patterns from inception through to delivery.
* Design, build, and steward enterprise\-grade API integrations — including Salesforce and custom microservices — applying best practices in REST API design, security, and documentation to ensure robust, maintainable, and scalable integration architecture.
* Lead the evaluation, onboarding, and governance of SaaS solutions and enterprise platforms — including enterprise contract and license management, user access management, and vendor relationships — ensuring all tools are adopted effectively and deliver measurable value.
* Manage and evolve the organization's internal Power Platform capability, overseeing the design and delivery of automation flows and applications.
* Develop and manage the web platform and digital operations budget in excess of $1M, balancing cost efficiency with operational excellence, and continuously identifying opportunities for financial optimization without compromising service quality or delivery capability.
* Build and maintain strong collaborative relationships with business, commercial, and marketing stakeholders, acting as a trusted technical consultant on new digital initiatives and providing expert guidance on platform capabilities, constraints, and opportunities.
* Lead and develop a multidisciplinary digital team — comprising web developers, operations manager, and microservices developer — setting clear direction, providing meaningful performance feedback, and creating pathways for professional growth and career development.
* Drive upskilling and continuous development initiatives within the team in line with the capability requirements and service priorities of the function.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and ownership within the team, encouraging experimentation with emerging technologies while maintaining delivery discipline and quality standards.



  





**Who We Are Looking For** 




 Proven experience in enterprise web platform management, digital operations, or a closely related discipline, with a minimum of 8 years in a leadership role overseeing multi\-stakeholder digital environments.
 



  





**Education / Professional Certifications** 



* Master's degree in computer science
* PRINCE2 Practitioner
* UX Management certification



  





**Technical Competencies** 



* Front\-end and full\-stack development proficiency: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, Next.js, Astro, PHP
* Microsoft Azure platform knowledge, with hands\-on experience in App Services, deployment pipelines, and Azure DevOps
* REST API design, development, and validation; experience building secure, production\-grade integrations
* Low\-code/no\-code automation platforms: Power Apps, Power Automate, Zapier, Xano
* Database design and SQL; data engineering fundamentals
* Web Accessibility Standards (WCAG) and UX best practices
* Technical on\-site SEO and AEO strategy and implementation
* Analytics and tracking: Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, custom data layer configuration
* Webflow platform administration and development at enterprise scale
* DNS, networking fundamentals, and information security principles
* Version control and CI/CD workflows (Git)
* Figma and design\-to\-development collaboration



  





**As much as we would be delighted to entertain all applicants, due to high volumes of applications only successful applicants will be contacted within 14 business days.** 




**This job description is not all inclusive. Dubai Holding reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. Dubai Holding is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.**

 The business is profitable, growing, and entering its most commercially ambitious phase to date. This hire is central to that next chapter.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 The Director of Marketing and Business Development is a senior, commercially critical appointment reporting directly to the CEO. You will own the full growth engine of the business — leading both the Sales (Admissions \& Strategic Partnerships) and Marketing (Digital, Content \& Brand) functions, and driving high\-quality client acquisition across the group's international markets.
 



  





 You will inherit a talented, technically capable four\-person marketing team based in Thailand, supported by a specialist external SEO agency. **Brand \& Thought Leadership** 



* Elevate the organisation's reputation as a recognised authority in addiction treatment and mental health care

**Who We're Looking For** 




  





 The successful candidate will be hands\-on, hungry, and commercially sharp — someone who leads by doing, not just by directing. You will be as comfortable shaping content strategy as you are reviewing conversion data or meeting a clinical referral partner.
 



  





**You will bring:** 



* Demonstrable experience leading Sales and/or Marketing functions at Director level in a healthcare, wellness, hospitality, or international services environment

**Why Chiang Mai?**

data.jd_text:
Pattern is a leading eCommerce accelerator with offices across the globe offering outsourced marketplace and ecommerce management services for brands worldwide. The Pattern Ecommerce Acceleration Platform leverages AI\-powered technology, industry expertise, and global distribution, logistics, and fulfilment services to help quality brands scale profitably on their own websites and through hundreds of marketplaces. Pattern works with some of the most recognized brands such as Thorne, Naturelo, Marshall, Nutricost, MegaFood, TIGI, Hair Burst and Sage and it ranks among the top 5 Amazon sellers globally.
   

  

 Pattern is expanding and we are looking for an experienced Ecommerce expert to join our MENA Team in Dubai to support the scaling of the business by driving the performance of the brands we represent on Amazon and other Marketplaces.
   

  

 You will own the relationship and financial performance of a portfolio of global brands managing their performance across marketplaces here in MENA. You will support the Associate Director of eCommercewith defining and implementing the E2E growth and profitability plan for your portfolio of brands by working cross\-functionally with Operations, Content, Advertising, Creative, Merchandising and Finance. You will also lead cross\-functional projects to implement processes to scale the organisation in MENA. You will be a strategic and commercial ecommerce professional who can engage partners and internal stakeholders towards a common goal. You will have a growth mindset and love navigating the challenges of working in fast changing landscapes.
   

  

**The core responsibilities of the eCommerce Manager reflect the following**
* Drive revenue growth on marketplaces across MENA through a data\-driven approach across a portfolio of brands through B2B and D2C marketplaces.
* Ensure that a clear activity plan is in place to achieve and surpass the budget targets, including promotional planning, seasonal phasing, NPD launches, advertising campaigns etc.
* Define the strategy and joint business plan with our brands to create mutually beneficial sales and marketing plans which grow market share.
* Represent your brands brilliantly across Marketplaces through best\-in\-class product content, including but not limited to images, enhanced content, keyword SEO, local language translation, advertising campaigns etc.
* Conduct analysis of brands performance using multiple data sources and tools on a regular basis to ensure that performance is continuously optimised across all touch points.
* Manage inventory, working alongside our merchandisers to maintain a healthy pipeline
* .Establish and maintain relationships with appropriate client partners, providing day\-to\-day contact on project status and changes.
* Have a passion for continuous improvement and building and automating processes.


**What will I need to thrive in this role?﻿**
* Demonstrated success in managing an ecommerce business
* 2\-5 years experience in an ecommerce role
* Strong academic background (2:1 or above)
* Previous experience managing and growing 3P business on Marketplaces (Amazon and Noon)
* Creative thinker and problem solver
* Highly organized and disciplined
* Willing to be nimble and adaptable to change
* Able to work under pressure and manage workloads effectively
* Arabic fluency preferred to facilitate communication with local market clients


**We Are Looking For Individuals Who Are**
**Game Changers** 
 \- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.
   

  

**Data Fanatics** 
 \- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.
   

  

**Partner Obsessed** 
 \- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations and delivers results that exceed them, prioritises the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.
   

  

**Team of Doers** 
 \- Someone who is a part of team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.

 You’ll join us at an exciting stage of growth in Riyadh, helping establish and expand our local presence while contributing to strategic fintech initiatives with long\-term impact across the Kingdom.

data.jd_text:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.
   

  

 For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.
   

  

 Context
   

  

***This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage. Any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval.***
 The Project Controls Manager will lead and manage all project controls functions across major railway and transportation infrastructure projects, ensuring effective planning, scheduling, cost control, reporting, risk management, change management, and performance monitoring. The role is critical to supporting successful project delivery in line with approved budgets, schedules, quality standards, and contractual obligations.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Lead and manage the overall project controls function, including planning, scheduling, cost control, risk, change management, progress measurement, and performance reporting.
* Establish and maintain project controls procedures, systems, tools, templates, and reporting protocols in line with PMC and client requirements.
* Manage and mentor the project controls team, ensuring effective delivery across planning, cost, reporting, and risk disciplines.
* Review and monitor contractor and consultant schedules to ensure alignment with project milestones, contractual requirements, and delivery strategy.
* Analyze schedule performance, identify delays and critical path impacts, and recommend mitigation, recovery, and time impact measures where required.
* Establish and oversee cost control processes, including budget tracking, forecasting, cash flow monitoring, variance analysis, and alignment of cost with physical progress.
* Prepare and consolidate dashboards, KPIs, and project controls reports for senior management and client stakeholders.
* Lead risk and change management processes, including risk registers, impact assessments, trend monitoring, variations, and support for claims and extension of time reviews.
* Coordinate with commercial, engineering, construction, and client teams to ensure alignment on project controls matters and contract compliance.
* Ensure effective use of project controls systems, data integrity, reporting quality, and continuous improvement in controls processes and governance.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* Minimum 20 years of experience in project controls, planning, cost, and performance management on major capital projects.
* Mandatory experience in railway or major transportation infrastructure projects.
* Strong GCC experience is required.
* Saudi Arabia experience is preferred.
* Proven experience working with PMC, client\-side, or major program management teams on large, complex projects.
* Demonstrated ability to manage project controls across multiple contracts and interfaces.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or related field is required.
* Master’s degree is preferred.
* PMP, PMI\-SP, AACE, RICS, or equivalent professional certification is desirable.
* Strong knowledge of project controls principles, scheduling techniques, cost control systems, and risk management practices.
* Proficiency in Primavera P6 and strong familiarity with cost and reporting tools.
* Strong understanding of EPC, design\-build, and FIDIC\-based contract environments.
* Ability to analyze complex data and provide strategic recommendations to project leadership.
* Strong leadership and team management capability.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a high\-profile, multicultural, and fast\-paced delivery environment.
* Strong report\-writing and presentation skills for senior executive audiences.


 Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants.

data.jd_text:
We are seeking a highly capable PMO Manager to lead the project management office for a real estate developer in Riyadh.
   

  

 The PMO Manager will oversee the full development delivery cycle: feasibility support, design management, consultant and contractor coordination, cost and schedule control, procurement tracking, risk management, project reporting, handover, and close\-out.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Establish and manage PMO governance, reporting standards, project controls, templates, and approval workflows across the development portfolio
* Monitor projects from design stage through construction, handover, and final close\-out on behalf of the developer
* Prepare executive dashboards and weekly/monthly reports covering project progress, cost, cash flow, risks, design status, procurement, variations, sales readiness, and key decisions required
* Verify actual site progress through regular site inspections and independent validation, rather than relying solely on contractor reports
* Control approved budgets, BOQs, commitments, variations, forecasts, and cost\-to\-complete for each project
* Track master schedules, identify delays early, assess recovery plans, and escalate critical risks to management
* Lead coordination between development, design, finance, procurement, sales, legal, consultants, contractors, and government\-related stakeholders
* Review design deliverables, consultant outputs, BOQs, specifications, tender packages, and construction documentation for completeness before execution
* Monitor consultant and contractor performance against their contractual scope, deliverables, milestones, quality requirements, and approved budgets
* Maintain project risk registers, issue logs, decision trackers, action plans, and mitigation measures
* Support tender evaluations, consultant and contractor appointments, variation reviews, claims assessments, and project close\-out
* Ensure projects are delivered in line with approved product positioning, financial objectives, delivery timelines, and quality standards
* Identify operational gaps and implement practical improvements to strengthen accountability, reporting quality, and delivery performance


**Requirements**
**Mandatory Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Project Management, or related discipline
* Minimum 8 years of total experience in real estate development, project management, project controls, or construction delivery
* Minimum 3 years of direct experience working for a real estate developer / owner / master developer is mandatory
* Demonstrated experience managing residential, mixed\-use, commercial, or hospitality development projects from the developer side
* Proven experience in managing consultants, contractors, design coordination, budgets, BOQs, procurement, variations, project schedules, and handover
* Strong understanding of the full real estate development lifecycle, not only construction execution
* Proficiency in Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project, advanced Excel, PowerPoint, and reporting/dashboard tools
* Strong commercial awareness, including budget monitoring, cash\-flow tracking, cost forecasting, and variation control
* Experience establishing or working within PMO governance frameworks, including project controls, reporting standards, risk registers, issue logs, action trackers, and stage\-gate processes
* Experience in project scheduling, critical\-path analysis, recovery planning, progress measurement, and executive reporting
* Experience with tender evaluation, procurement planning, variation assessment, and contractor performance monitoring
* Business\-fluent English
* Eligible to work in Saudi Arabia
* Based in Riyadh or willing to relocate
* Able to conduct regular site visits across active development and construction projects in Riyadh
* Able to work in both office and construction\-site environments
* Able to attend project meetings, inspections, and site walks as required
* Proficient in using a laptop and standard Microsoft Office tools for day\-to\-day work
* Able to work effectively with digital project documentation, drawings, BOQs, schedules, and cloud\-based collaboration platforms


**Preferred Qualifications**
* PMP, PMI\-SP, PMI\-RMP, RICS, Primavera, or equivalent certification
* Experience with project management systems, ERP platforms, or real estate development software
* Experience managing multiple projects or a development portfolio simultaneously
* Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE) registration, preferred for engineering\-degree holders
* Availability to join within 30 to 60 days is a plus


**What We Are Looking For**
* A developer\-side PMO professional who understands the owner's commercial, technical, and delivery priorities
* Someone who can challenge consultants and contractors constructively and protect the developer's interests
* A hands\-on manager with strong site awareness, disciplined reporting, and the ability to identify issues before they become delays or cost overruns
* A leader who can create accountability across internal teams and external stakeholders


**Benefits**
* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage
* Pension scheme in accordance with Saudi labor regulations
* Paid annual leave and public holidays
* Professional development and training opportunities

Lead the City Technology Project Management Office (PMO) responsible for portfolio governance, delivery assurance, demand intake, stage\-gate control, and operational readiness across all IT and OT technology towers within QIC City Technology.

 .
   

  

 The PMO acts as the control tower for all City Technology projects transitioning into run\-state operations.

 Reports to:
 **Director — Technology Governance, Architecture, Budget, ITSM Standards \& PMO**
**Direct Reports:** 
 PMO Managers, Project Governance Leads, Reporting \& Controls Analysts

* City Physical Security technology
* City ICT infrastructure and data centers including City IT/OT Security


**Key Responsibilities**
* Delivery \& Handover Governance Framework (City Technology)
* Implement and maintain Delivery \& Handover Governance standards for City Technology programs, including:
+ reporting templates and cadence
+ stage\-gate criteria
+ RAID log standards
+ dependency tracking rules
+ baseline control requirements (scope/schedule/cost)

* Ensure all delivery teams and vendors comply with governance controls

* Design completion readiness (as required by TDAs)
* Testing and commissioning evidence
* Documentation and as\-built readiness
* Operational readiness evidence for transition into technology support

**City Business Applications**
**City OT \& Smart Systems**
**City Physical Security Systems**
**City Platforms (Integration / IoT / Data)**
**City ICT Infrastructure and Data Centers including City IT/OT Security**
* Risk, Issues, and Dependency Governance (RAID)

* Ensure RAID logs are complete, current, and actionable
* Run dependency reviews and cross\-tower issue resolution sessions
* Escalate unresolved risks/issues to the appropriate governance level
* Delivery Reporting \& Executive Packs
* Produce standardized delivery reporting packs including:
* Schedule health (RAG)
* Delivery risk exposure
* Dependency hotspots
* Milestone achievement
* Vendor delivery performance indicators
* Readiness risks for transition to technology support
* Ensure reporting is auditable and consistent across towers

+ Reporting cadence
+ Evidence packs
+ Stage\-gate readiness
+ Documentation standards

+ City Technology leadership (for escalation)

+ corporate technology governance processes (where applicable)

+ design authority requirements (IT/OT/physical security/platforms/data)
+ cybersecurity gating requirements
+ Track and report exceptions and required waivers through the correct forums


**Key Interfaces**

* Director — City Technology Governance \& Architecture
* Tower Directors (Apps / OT / Physical Security / Platforms / Infrastructure / Cybersecurity)
* City ITSM governance and assurance function

* Finance / budgeting governance stakeholders


**External:**
* Systems Integrators
* Delivery contractors
* OEMs providing commissioning and handover support
* Managed service providers supporting transition planning


**Success Measures (KPIs)**
* % of City Technology programs compliant with Delivery \& Handover Governance reporting cadence
* Stage\-gate compliance rate (% passing with complete evidence)
* % of projects with maintained baseline (scope/schedule/cost)
* Delivery risk closure rate (RAID actions completed on time)
* Number of uncontrolled scope changes / late change requests
* Reduction in "handover defects" (missing documentation, missing runbooks, missing monitoring)

**Operational Readiness \& Handover Governance**

**Requirements**
* 15\+ year\-experience in large\-scale ICT infrastructure, smart city, or complex technology Delivery \& Handover Governance / PMO / program controls roles

+ IT \+ OT programs
+ infrastructure and data centers
+ physical security technology delivery
+ smart city platforms and integration

* Strong knowledge of:
+ stage\-gate Delivery \& Handover Governance
+ RAID management

* Strong stakeholder management and escalation skills
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, IT, Computer Science or related field (Master's preferred)
* Experience managing IT \+ OT delivery environments preferred
* Strong experience in governance\-heavy or giga\-project environments
* PMP or equivalent certification required

* ITIL knowledge required
* Strong financial governance and executive reporting capability

* High integrity, resilient, client‑centric, with strong communication and stakeholder influence.

* Conduct detailed assessments of operational readiness, identifying gaps and recommending solutions to enhance service delivery
* Design, implement, and oversee staff training programs aimed at equipping teams with the skills required for operational excellence
* Create and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to assess operational effectiveness and readiness, providing regular updates to senior management
* Identify potential operational risks and develop mitigation strategies to ensure smooth project rollouts
* Foster a customer\-focused culture among staff to ensure high standards of guest experience are met and exceeded


**Requirements**
* A bachelor's degree in Business Management, Operations, or a related field
* Minimum of 7 years of experience in operational management or readiness roles


**Benefits**
 Comprehensive benefits package

**Requirements**

* A minimum of 10\-15 years of experience in commercial management, particularly within the transport or infrastructure sectors
* Proven track record of successfully leading commercial initiatives on large\-scale projects
* Strong understanding of procurement processes, contract management, and negotiation strategies
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex financial data and strategies
* Exceptional leadership qualities, with the ability to inspire and guide diverse teams
* Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
* Knowledge of standard contract forms (e.g., FIDIC) and relevant legislation
* Experience in the Middle East / KSA market is highly desirable
* A results\-driven mindset, with the ability to adapt in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment


 Applications closing on 1st July 2026\.

 Comprehensive benefits package

* Monitor operational risks, escalations, audit readiness, and business continuity requirements
* Support annual budgeting, staff cost planning, and operational expenditure coordination across support functions
* Oversee third\-party support vendors and service providers to ensure compliance, responsiveness, and operational continuity
* Coordinate implementation of policies, procedures, controls, and governance requirements across the asset
* Support setup and stabilization of internal administrative and operational systems required for launch and early operations
* Drive cross\-functional coordination to ensure support services remain aligned with the Film Studio operating model and evolving business needs


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, HR, Operations, or related field
* 8\-10 years of experience in corporate services, operations support, administration, or asset\-level enablement roles
* Experience supporting activation\-stage assets, entertainment, hospitality, real estate, or other complex operating environments preferred
* Demonstrated experience coordinating with centralized/shared service functions and managing governance\-driven support models is preferred


**Key Competencies**
* Operational governance
* Stakeholder management
* Cross\-functional coordination
* Organizational setup and activation
* Problem solving and execution

**Job Description**
 What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?
   

  

 At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
   

  

 As a Senior Project Manager, you are responsible for the strategic leadership and successful delivery of complex, multi\-disciplinary projects, with a focus on retail and mixed\-use developments, from early concept through to completion.
   

  

 The role requires a highly proactive and commercially astute approach, ensuring delivery aligns with client objectives, brand requirements, operational constraints, and fast\-track retail programmes. You will lead project teams, drive decision\-making, and manage key stakeholder relationships, ensuring high\-quality outcomes across all stages of design and delivery.
   

  

 You are expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, provide leadership across multiple workstreams, and act as a trusted advisor to clients.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Contract \& Scope
   

  

* Lead project set\-up, including contract finalisation, internal alignment and mobilisation of the team
* Fully understand and manage the contract, ensuring compliance with key obligations and deliverables
* Define, agree and manage scope across all disciplines, ensuring clarity of responsibilities
* Lead the appointment and coordination of sub\-consultants, including scope, fees and agreements
* Identify and manage changes to scope, leading variation preparation, negotiation and agreement with the client
* Ensure all deliverables meet WSP quality standards and client expectations


 Communication \& Team Leadership
   

  

* Act as the primary interface with the client, operators, tenants, and key stakeholders
* Provide clear leadership, establishing a high\-performing “one team” culture
* Lead client engagement, workshops and presentations, including executive\-level reporting
* Manage complex stakeholder environments, including retail tenants, landlords, operators and authorities
* Support clients with strategic decision\-making, balancing commercial, operational and design priorities
* Proactively manage expectations, risks and issues to maintain trust and project momentum Programme
* Lead development of detailed, realistic programmes aligned with retail delivery and tenant fit\-out requirements
* Manage programmes proactively, identifying and mitigating risks to delivery
* Coordinate with design teams to ensure alignment with anchor tenant, F\&B and retail unit handover milestones
* Oversee integration of base build, shell \& core, and tenant fit\-out packages
* Ensure programme reflects authority approvals, procurement strategies and phased handovers
* Work with Planning \& Controls to maintain robust P6 programmes and client reporting


 Design \& Technical Coordination
   

  

* Lead multidisciplinary design coordination through all stages (Concept to IFC and construction support)
* Ensure alignment between brand standards, operational requirements and technical design solutions
* Oversee design reviews, ensuring buildability, compliance and coordination across disciplines
* Drive high\-quality outputs through structured QA/QC processes
* Ensure coordination between landlord criteria and tenant requirements


 Risk Management
   

  

* Establish and lead the project Risk Register, ensuring regular review and active management
* Identify key risks associated with retail phasing, tenant changes, authority approvals and programme constraints
* Develop and implement mitigation strategies
* Escalate critical risks to senior leadership and clients as required


 Commercial Management
   

  

* Lead all project commercial aspects, including budget management and financial reporting Manage project invoicing, cost tracking and financial performance
* Lead preparation, negotiation and agreement of variations
* Provide commercial advice to clients, particularly relating to programme impacts and tenant\-driven changes


 Delivery \& Handover
   

  

* Oversee project delivery through to completion, ensuring alignment with client and operational objectives
* Coordinate phased handovers, including base build and tenant fit\-out interfaces
* Ensure smooth transition to supervision / construction teams
* Lead project close\-out, ensuring all deliverables, approvals and documentation are complete


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture or related field
* 10\+ years professional experience, with a strong focus on retail, mixed\-use or commercial developments
* Proven track record delivering complex, multidisciplinary projects from Concept through to IFC and construction
* Demonstrable experience in retail delivery, including tenant coordination and fit\-out integration
* Experience working with major developers, operators or retail brands preferred
* Experience managing large, multidisciplinary teams and multiple stakeholders


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Strong leadership and ability to operate at a senior, client\-facing level
* Strategic thinking with ability to manage competing priorities
* Excellent stakeholder management, particularly within complex retail environments
* Commercial acumen and contractual awareness
* Strong programme and risk management capability
* Ability to drive quality, coordination and technical excellence
* Collaborative and proactive communication style
* Ability to lead and motivate multidisciplinary teams
* Strong understanding of health and safety in design


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Join our close\-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
   

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.**

data.jd_text:
**About The Role**
 HENSOLDT Middle East is seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead the successful delivery of projects and programmes within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This opportunity is exclusively open to Saudi Nationals.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be responsible for managing projects from initiation to completion, ensuring delivery within scope, budget, schedule, quality, and customer requirements. At Senior Project Manager level, the role includes leading multiple projects or large, complex programmes, managing cross\-functional teams, driving stakeholder engagement, and ensuring successful project outcomes aligned with business objectives.
   

  

**Qualification and experience:**
* Minimum technical qualification; Preferred Undergraduate Engineering qualification or similar qualification.
* PMP certification from the Project Management Institute (PMI) highly preferred.
* Experience in a Defence environment, preferably within the Electronic Warfare domain.
* Depending on level: experience in project management, operational management, customer and stakeholder management, non\-co\-located team leadership, and team leadership.
* Minimum ideal experience of 6–8 years in project management and delivery.


**Key technical skills:**
* Project planning and project control techniques and tools.
* Stakeholder management (internal and external) with strong communication, influencing, and negotiation skills.
* Clear understanding of the project lifecycle and control of project outputs.
* Coordination of technical work and allocation of resources according to project needs.
* Scope and change management within complex project environments.
* Strong understanding of project finance principles for effective budget and cost control.
* Ability to lead and motivate diverse teams (engineers, operators, technicians, and support staff).
* Knowledge of project management methodologies such as PRINCE II, PMP, and Agile.
* Understanding of complex systems within a design and development environment.
* Application of Systems Engineering principles to project execution.


**Key responsibilities:** 
  

  

* Contractual Programme / Project Execution
* Create and maintain a Project Management structure and team.
* Coordinate the project kick\-off with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure effective scope management during project execution without negatively impacting schedule, technical, or cost objectives unless formally agreed.
* Use project execution, control, and monitoring tools (e.g., Qmuzik/SAP) and PMO\-defined KPIs as measures of performance.
* Deliver contracted project milestones to the end user as a total solution.
* Ensure requirements are formally agreed and documented for traceability during and after project execution within technical, schedule, and budget constraints.
* Participate in major contract scope change negotiations and/or requirements changes when required.
* Planning and Technical
* Plan projects to achieve the Business Case, including:
+ Resource planning
+ Budgeting
+ Scheduling
+ Creating and maintaining risk and issue logs

* Allocate Project Management resources to the execution of work.
* Monitor Project Management output and workload.
* Create, maintain, and monitor monthly delivery and expenditure forecasts.
* Manage procurement of parts according to project scope.
* Ensure and review regular project scope outputs by the project team and align execution plans accordingly.
* Work with technical teams, engineers, and external suppliers to ensure the proposed technical solution meets customer expectations in terms of functionality, maintainability, usability, and producibility.
* Collaborate with systems engineers to ensure proper gate reviews take place to support decision\-making and technical integrity.
* Ensure projects are properly executed and closed in line with the project management process.
* Conduct gate project meetings to ensure delivery according to agreed standards.
* Manage mitigation of risks and issues within the project.
* Reporting
* Serve as a bridge between external customers and internal stakeholders to ensure alignment of goals and milestones.
* Regularly communicate with external customers and project teams to provide status updates and ensure alignment of activities with programme goals.
* Report externally to the client on project execution status (technical and schedule).
* Report internally on execution status in terms of financial, technical, schedule, and risk status to Programme Managers.
* Project Closure
* Conduct gate reviews for production readiness.
* Conduct reviews on costs, budget, and the technical solution of the project.
* Identify gaps and define future or follow\-up actions.
* Create a project closure report with recommendations.
* General
* Uphold Company Values and the PMO Code of Conduct by adhering to company policies and disciplinary codes.
* Represent the Client internally and ensure the “Voice of the Customer” is heard.
* Ensure company policies and procedures relating to Project Management are followed as practically reasonable.
* Execute any reasonable ad hoc duties assigned by Executive Management within the scope of the role.
* Suggest areas for improvement in internal processes and propose solutions.
* Cooperate and add value within the PMO Business Unit wherever possible.

 HENSOLDT South Africa focuses on diversity, equity, and inclusion in our organizational strategy. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive corporate culture that benefits our employees and delivers better outcomes for our clients. In line with our commitment to equal employment opportunities and our focus on diversity in the operational environment, we welcome applications from all ethnic groups. In line with HENSOLDT's commitment to equal employment opportunities and our focus on diversity in the operational environment, preference will be given to suitable candidates from designated groups.

 : 29 June 2026\.

data.jd_text:
We are seeking an accomplished Senior Project Control Manager to join JASARA, a leading program management company driving large\-scale infrastructure and giga\-projects across Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will lead the planning, scheduling, cost control, and performance monitoring of complex projects, ensuring delivery excellence aligned with client and Vision 2030 objectives. Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that’s shaping the future of flying.
