**About The Role**
 Are you the strategic mastermind who can turn complex aviation regulations into a symphony of safety and performance?
   

  

 In this role, you will partner with teams across Flight Operations, Ground Operations, Engineering, and Maintenance to embed quality, compliance, and accountability into every aspect of the operation, ensuring the highest standards of safety and performance.
   

  

 Take the lead in establishing, implementing, and continuously enhancing quality management systems and compliance monitoring frameworks that ensure adherence to regulatory requirements, internal policies, and industry best practices.
   

  

 Drive operational excellence by overseeing audits, compliance assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring effective risk management, audit readiness, and the successful closure of findings across all operational areas.
   

  

 Ensure quality and compliance risks are proactively identified, assessed, and mitigated through robust monitoring, transparent reporting, and corrective action plans that safeguard operational integrity and regulatory adherence.
   

  

 Hold authority to interface with regulatory bodies on compliance\-related matters, including securing approvals, responding to regulatory inquiries, managing certifications such as Third Country Operator (TCO) authorization, and representing the organization during audits and inspections.
   

  

 Lead and develop high\-performing quality and compliance teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, regulatory excellence, and operational accountability while ensuring sustainable compliance leadership and decision\-making continuity.
   

  

 Drive a culture of ownership, governance, and regulatory discipline by holding self and others accountable for delivering commitments, maintaining compliance standards, and achieving operational objectives.
   

  

 Promote transparency through performance monitoring, timely escalation of risks and findings, and the effective execution of corrective actions to ensure sustainable compliance and operational excellence.
   

  

 Join us to shape world\-class quality assurance and compliance programs, strengthen regulatory excellence, and drive safe, efficient, and industry\-leading operations across the organization.

 Degree qualified, y ou will demonstrate a minimum of 7 years in airline quality assurance and compliance.
   

  

 You are expected to demonstrate an in\-depth knowledge of aviation regulations, safety standards, and industry best practices.
   

  

 We'd love to hear from you even more if you are able to lead a team, and are familiar with GACA (General Authority of Civil Aviation) regulations.
   

  

 This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.
   

  

 Please submit your application by clicking on the Apply button. Our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing applications shortly.

**Job Description**

 As a Senior Project Manager working with Portfolio 2 delivery teams, you will be responsible for developing detailed project plans and timelines.
   

  





 You will be involved in breaking down the event into key phases (e.g., pre\-event, event execution, and post\-event), identifying major deliverables, and creating a project schedule. You will coordinate with all stakeholders, define the scope, set expectations, and establish deadlines for each milestone.
   

  





  

  





**What You Will Do**




 Stakeholder Management
   

  




* Act as the primary liaison between internal and external stakeholders, including event sponsors, exhibitors, clients, vendors, and internal teams (marketing, operations, technical teams, etc.).
* Ensure all stakeholders understand their roles, requirements, and timelines, fostering clear communication and alignment.
* Manage expectations and address concerns to maintain strong relationships and ensure smooth collaboration.



 Feature Management
   

  




* Oversee the planning and execution of event features such as workshops, deals hubs, competitions, activations, and closed\-door roundtable conferences.

 Risk Management

 Coordination of Multi\-Functional Teams

 Communication and Reporting
   

  




* Establish regular meetings, status reports, and communication plans to keep all parties informed about progress, risks, and changes.

* Provide clear and concise updates to stakeholders, ensuring transparency and accountability.



 Post\-Event Evaluation and Reporting
   

  




* Conduct post\-event reviews to assess success metrics and gather feedback from stakeholders.
* Prepare a final report summarizing achievements, lessons learned, and recommendations for future events.
* Track post\-event milestones and support the rollout of new event launches.

* Exposure to MS Office/Office 365 suite of software, Smart Sheets and Airtable



**Demonstrated skills:**



* Ability to perform critical work involving judgement, accuracy and speed with minimal supervision

* Proactive and self\-motivated

**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
 The Senior Project Manager – Infrastructure is responsible for the full lifecycle delivery of complex infrastructure projects, such as roads and highways, utilities, bridges and structures, drainage networks, and associated civil works. The role leads multi‑disciplinary teams and multiple contractors from initiation through design, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, and handover, ensuring that scope, schedule, budget, quality, safety, and stakeholder requirements are achieved.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Leadership \& Governance**
* Lead planning and execution of infrastructure projects from concept through handover and closeout.
* Develop project execution strategies, implementation plans, and stage‑gate deliverables in line with corporate and client requirements.
* Establish project governance, roles and responsibilities, communication protocols, and decision‑making structures.
* Provide clear leadership to project teams, aligning them with project objectives, priorities, and performance expectations.


**Scope, Schedule \& Cost Management**
* Develop and manage the integrated Project Management Plan covering scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, and communications.
* Work with planning and project controls teams to establish and maintain baseline programs and budgets.
* Monitor progress against schedule and budget; identify variances early and drive corrective and recovery actions.
* Manage scope changes and variations through formal change control, ensuring impacts are assessed, documented, and approved.


**Design \& Technical Coordination**
* Coordinate with design managers and consultants to ensure timely, coordinated design deliverables that support procurement and construction.
* Ensure designs are aligned with project requirements, constructability, maintainability, and HSE‑by‑design principles.
* Lead multi‑disciplinary interface management (roads/civils, structures, utilities, MEP, traffic, environmental).
* Oversee resolution of key technical issues and ensure lessons learned are captured and applied.


**Procurement \& Contract Management**
* Support development of procurement strategies for major packages (civils, structures, utilities, specialist systems).
* Work with commercial and procurement teams to prepare tender documentation, evaluate bids, and recommend awards.
* Manage contractor performance against contract requirements, including progress, quality, HSE, and commercial obligations.
* Review and recommend approval of major contract changes, claims, and final accounts in coordination with the commercial team.


**Construction, Commissioning \& Handover**
* Oversee on‑site execution of infrastructure works, ensuring adherence to design, specifications, and HSE standards.
* Coordinate construction sequencing, access, traffic management, and logistics to minimize clashes and disruption.
* Ensure testing and commissioning plans are in place and executed for relevant systems (e.g., utilities, ITS, lighting, pump stations).
* Lead project handover processes, including punch lists, as‑built documentation, O\&M manuals, training, and acceptance by the end‑user/operator.


**HSE, Quality \& Regulatory Compliance**
* Promote and enforce a strong HSE culture, ensuring compliance with company, client, and statutory requirements.
* Ensure project‑specific HSE plans, method statements, risk assessments, and permit‑to‑work systems are in place and effective.
* Oversee implementation of quality plans, inspection and test plans , and quality assurance/quality control processes.
* Ensure compliance with applicable codes, standards, utility requirements, and permit/consent conditions.


**Risk, Issues \& Stakeholder Management**
* Establish and maintain project risk and issues registers; lead risk identification, assessment, mitigation, and contingency planning.
* Escalate critical risks and issues promptly with clear analysis and recommended actions.
* Act as primary point of contact for clients, authorities, utilities, and key stakeholders on project matters.
* Manage stakeholder expectations through regular, transparent communication and effective issue resolution (e.g., community impacts, traffic management).


**Reporting \& Performance Management**
* Provide regular project status reports (schedule, cost, risk, HSE, quality, key decisions) to senior management and clients.
* Define and track project KPIs (schedule performance, cost performance, change volume, HSE metrics, defects/rework, stakeholder satisfaction).
* Lead monthly progress meetings, steering committees, and executive reviews as required.
* Drive continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned and implementing improvements in project delivery processes.


**Team Leadership \& Development**
* Lead and mentor a multi‑disciplinary project team, including project engineers, coordinators, planners, HSE, quality, and commercial staff.
* Allocate resources effectively and ensure clear accountabilities across internal teams and contractors.
* Foster a collaborative, solution‑oriented culture across design, construction, commercial, and client teams.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related engineering discipline.
* years of progressive project management experience on major infrastructure projects (e.g., roads, bridges, utilities, large‑scale civils), including successful delivery of multi‑disciplinary projects.
* Demonstrated experience managing projects from initiation through commissioning and handover in a client, consultant, or Tier 1 contractor environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in Project Management, Engineering, or Business.
* Professional project management certification such as or equivalent.
* Chartered/Professional Engineer status , , or equivalent is an advantage.
* Experience with standard forms of contract (FIDIC)and their commercial and time‑related provisions.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong project management skills across scope, schedule, cost, risk, and change control.
* Solid understanding of core infrastructure disciplines (roads, civils, structures, utilities) and their interfaces.
* Excellent leadership, team management, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong negotiation, problem‑solving, and decision‑making abilities under time and operational pressure.

data.jd_text:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.
   

  

 For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.
   

  

 Context
   

  

***This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage. Any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval.***
 The Project Delivery Manager will be responsible for leading the successful delivery of the conventional railway and freight rail program, with a strong focus on construction execution, package coordination, interface management, and delivery performance. The role requires a highly capable leader with deep expertise in managing large\-scale conventional railway, freight rail, and associated infrastructure works, coordinating multidisciplinary teams, resolving complex technical and delivery interfaces, and ensuring execution in line with project requirements for schedule, budget, quality, safety, and operational performance. The position demands substantial experience in delivering integrated works across conventional rail corridors, freight alignments, yards, depots, terminals, and associated infrastructure, including coordination of civil, structural, track, systems, MEP, architectural, utilities, and operational interfaces, while ensuring compliance with project specifications, applicable standards, regulatory requirements, and the operational needs of conventional and freight railway systems.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Lead and manage the overall construction delivery of the railway program across multiple project packages, work fronts, or contractor interfaces.
* Drive site execution strategies to ensure safe, efficient, and timely delivery of all construction activities.
* Oversee and coordinate construction teams, subcontractors, package managers, and support functions to achieve program milestones.
* Ensure strong integration between engineering, procurement, construction, commercial, planning, contracts, and project controls functions.
* Monitor construction progress and productivity, and implement recovery plans where required to address delays or performance gaps.
* Manage site\-related risks, constructability issues, sequencing constraints, logistics challenges, and interface coordination across the program.
* Lead delivery reviews, construction progress meetings, and reporting processes to ensure transparency and timely decision\-making.
* Ensure construction activities are executed in compliance with project specifications, contractual requirements, quality standards, and HSE regulations.
* Support the development of construction methodologies, phasing plans, mobilization strategies, and execution plans during bid and post\-award stages.
* Act as a key point of contact for internal stakeholders, contractors, consultants, and the client on all matters related to delivery and construction performance.
* Promote a strong site culture focused on safety, quality, productivity, accountability, and delivery excellence.
* Support testing, commissioning readiness, and handover planning in coordination with relevant teams, where required.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* The successful candidate will be a hands\-on, delivery\-focused leader with strong construction execution capability and a proven ability to manage complex railway works in live and challenging environments. They should be capable of driving site performance, managing contractors and interfaces, and ensuring coordinated delivery across multiple packages while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, and operational excellence. Prior conventional railway and freight rail project experience is essential.
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline. A master’s degree is an advantage.
* Minimum 20 years of total experience in major infrastructure and construction projects.
* Strong experience in conventional railway and freight rail projects is essential.
* Proven project and construction delivery experience in leading major infrastructure, rail, or transportation projects from execution through completion.
* Strong background in construction management, site delivery, contractor coordination, and field execution.
* Prior experience in a Program Delivery Manager, Construction Delivery Manager, Senior Project Manager, or similar senior delivery role on major conventional and/or freight railway projects.
* Gulf experience preferred.
* Strong understanding of construction sequencing, site logistics, temporary works, constructability, project controls, and commercial impacts on delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex construction interfaces and multidisciplinary teams in large project environments.
* Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong knowledge of HSE, quality, risk, compliance, and construction best practices in major infrastructure projects, including the requirements of conventional and freight railway systems.


 Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants.

**Job Description**

**Role Overview**




 This role brings deep expertise in gaming investment and deal\-making into the Investor and Startup Programme infrastructure. The primary mandate is designing the investment programmes and deal\-making activations that make Gaming event the strongest investment event in the global gaming calendar. The role also flexes across the broader Investor and startup program portfolio, supporting investor programming at other events where sector knowledge and investor relationships add value. The event provides the structure; this person provides the sector depth, does the heavy lifting with the gaming and tech investment community, and raises the bar on investor experience across every event they touch.
   

  





**Gaming Investment Programme**



* Design investment programmes and deal\-making formats for gaming conference that attract international investors, publishers, and funds and set a global standard for capital\-meets\-talent events


* Build and own the gaming investor pipeline from scratch: identify gaming VCs, publisher venture arms, sovereign funds with gaming mandates, angel networks, and accelerator programmes, and conduct targeted outreach.


* Manage the investor application and vetting process verifying fund credentials, investment thesis alignment, and genuine intent to engage with gaming studios and founders.


* Develop the content and format for all gaming investment activations: reverse pitches, hosted buyer programmes, closed\-door investor roundtables, and live deal\-making showcases.


* Work with the B2B Content Producer to ensure the investment content track is credible, current, and attracts the right calibre of participant.


* Design the investor experience end\-to\-end: investor lounge, curated sessions, concierge meetings, and investor\-only programming that delivers a premium environment.


* Own the investor\-side matchmaking process by working with internal teams to ensure match quality and deal relevance are high.


* Manage investor delegate communications, matchmaking logistics, and on\-site facilitation to ensure the programme delivers real outcomes, not just introductions.


* Track and report on investment programme outcomes: deals initiated, capital committed, follow\-up meetings generated.



**Cross\-Portfolio Investor Support**



* Support the investor programme across other Investor \& Startup program portfolio events contributing investor relationships, outreach, and programming input where sector knowledge adds value.


* Contribute to investor outreach campaigns across portfolio events with the marketing and cross\-functional teams.


* Provide investor program cover for senior team members during high\-volume pre\-event and on\-ground periods.


* Curate a balanced, high\-quality investor room for each assigned event, reflecting that event’s sector focus and strategic objectives.


* Programme investor\-focused roundtables, LP introductions, and deal\-flow sessions in collaboration with the special value programmes team.


* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date investor records in internal management tools covering fund details, investment thesis, meeting history, and post\-event feedback.


* Track investor programme KPIs across assigned events: investor count, AUM represented, meetings held, investment signals generated, and investor NPS.


* Conduct post\-event investor debriefs, gather feedback, and share improvement recommendations with the program lead.


* Maintain and nurture investor relationships year\-round, ensuring warm relationships carry forward into future editions.


* Develop new ideas for value\-driven investor programme features and lead on concept note development for future editions.

* 4–5 years of experience in investor relations, investor programme management, or VC/LP engagement ideally within an event, ecosystem, or gaming industry context.
* Demonstrated expertise in the gaming investment landscape: VCs, publisher venture arms, sovereign funds with gaming mandates, angel networks. This is the core credential.
* Demonstrable experience curating and managing high\-touch investor experiences, not just registration and logistics, but genuine investor engagement design.
* Strong existing network within the gaming and tech investment community, particularly in MENA, APAC, or Europe.
* Understanding of how the gaming investment chain works from pre\-seed accelerators through to sovereign capital deployment.
* Sector knowledge in cybersecurity, fintech, or other technology verticals is an advantage for cross\-portfolio event support.
* Excellent relationship management skills, able to manage senior investor relationships with professionalism and discretion.
* Comfortable working across multiple simultaneous events with different investors, geographies, and sector focuses.
* Experience with investor management platforms, CRM tools, and event management systems.
* Strong written English is mandatory; Arabic is a meaningful advantage.
* **What You will bring**




 Deep expertise in gaming investment and deal\-making is the non\-negotiable. Must understand how funding rounds, publishing deals, and M\&A transactions work in gaming and know the regional investors, funds, and studios that matter, particularly across Saudi Arabia and MENA. Comfortable in investor conversations and able to hold their own in a room with fund managers, portfolio directors, and publishing executives. Able to design investor programmes from the ground up that bring international capital to an event and raise the bar on what a gaming investment activation can be. Equally capable of plugging into broader Investor and startup programs across events and adding immediate value through relationships and sector credibility.

**Overview**

Partnering closely with Joby’s senior leadership and U.S. headquarters teams, you will drive government and municipal engagement, develop strategic partnerships (including JVs and M\&A), and lead end\-to\-end deal execution. You will serve as Joby’s local face, elevating brand awareness, representing the company with stakeholders and media, translating market insights into action, and providing clear performance updates to executive leadership and the board.

**About The Role**
 Müller's Solutions is looking for a senior, hands\-on Project Manager to lead the delivery of a SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition implementation for a major trading group based in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. You will take full ownership of a multi\-legal\-entity Finance and Supply Chain transformation — from Fit\-to\-Standard workshops through go\-live and hypercare — working at the intersection of our client's leadership and a hybrid onsite/offshore delivery team.
   

  

 This is a high\-visibility role within our Middle East practice. You will report directly to the Managing Director and act as the single point of accountability for scope, schedule, budget, and client satisfaction throughout the engagement.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
 — End\-to\-end delivery of the S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition program using SAP ACTIVATE methodology, from Prepare through Run.
   

  

 — A delivery team spanning Finance, Supply Chain, Integration, Data Migration, and Training — coordinating onsite and offshore workstreams as one team.
   

  

 — The project plan, RAID log, budget tracking, and resourcing decisions across all phases.
   

  

 — Executive\-level reporting and steering committee facilitation with client leadership across 4 legal entities.
   

  

 — Scope governance and change request management, protecting both project quality and commercial margin.
   

  

 — Cutover planning, go\-live readiness, and hypercare oversight — ensuring the client lands the system successfully.
   

  

 — Coordination of ZATCA Phase 2 compliance milestones with the Finance workstream lead.
   

  

**Requirements**
 — 8\+ years of SAP project management experience, with full lifecycle accountability.
   

  

 — A minimum of 3 completed SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition go\-lives as lead Project Manager.
   

  

 — SAP ACTIVATE methodology certification.
   

  

 — Demonstrated experience managing multi\-legal\-entity SAP deployments within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 — Confident, polished stakeholder management with C\-level and finance leadership in Arabic\-speaking business environments.
   

  

 — A track record of holding scope, budget, and timeline discipline on fixed\-price or milestone\-based engagements.
   

  

**Preferred**
 — PMP or PRINCE2 certification.
   

  

 — Prior experience in trading, distribution, or manufacturing client environments.
   

  

 — Familiarity with SAP Integration Suite and BTP\-based integration landscapes.
   

  

**Benefits**
 — Work on flagship Cloud ERP transformations for some of the region's most respected enterprises, backed by a multi\-vendor partner ecosystem spanning SAP, ServiceNow, OpenText, BMC, Boomi, and Red Hat.
   

  

 — A Berlin\-headquartered firm with genuine regional depth — offices in Riyadh, Dubai, Cairo, and Casablanca, and an offshore delivery model that lets you focus on what matters most: the client.
   

  

 — Direct visibility and access to senior leadership — your impact on client outcomes is seen and valued, not buried in a large delivery hierarchy.
   

  

 — A culture that rewards ownership: you scope it, you lead it, you're credited for it.

 As a

This role requires a strong understanding of urban development principles and the ability to navigate complex regulatory environments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Detailed Key Responsibilities**
* Project Leadership \& Lifecycle Management
* End\-to\-End Delivery: Lead the tactical execution of Master Planning projects from inception through to delivery.
* Workstream Integration: Synchronize multi\-disciplinary workstreams—including infrastructure, sustainability, landscape architecture, and transport planning—to ensure a unified project output.
* Revenue Management \& Performance Monitoring: Implement and oversee Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) regarding schedule adherence, budget burn rates, and technical quality standards.
* Governance \& Change Control
* Project Reporting \& Performance Management: Lead the preparation and delivery of high\-quality weekly and monthly progress reports (MPRs) for clients, providing clear updates on programme status, key milestones, risks, resource utilisation, commercial performance, and upcoming look\-ahead activities.
* Scope Management: Rigorously monitor project boundaries; identify, document, and manage "scope creep" to ensure commercial viability.
* Change Protocol: Execute formal Change Requests for variations in schedule or budget, conducting impact assessments before escalating for Senior Management approval.
* Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify project risks (regulatory, environmental, or financial) and develop robust mitigation strategies to prevent delivery delays.
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Communication
* Primary Point of Contact: Act as the central liaison for clients, government authorities, utility providers, and contractors, ensuring transparency and trust.
* Conflict Resolution: Mediate technical or contractual disputes between stakeholders, leveraging professional diplomacy to maintain project momentum.
* Reporting Excellence: Author and present comprehensive monthly progress reports, dashboard updates, and executive briefings for internal leadership and external client boards.
* Quality Assurance \& Documentation
* Technical Compliance: Ensure all deliverables align with local planning regulations, international best practices, and the specific sustainability mandates of the project – by working with the technical leads of the project.
* Document Control: Oversee a rigorous documentation environment, ensuring all deliverables, data requests, email requests and stakeholder approvals are audited and archived correctly.
* Schedule Management: Develop and maintain detailed Project Plans using MS Project or Primavera P6\. Utilize Critical Path Methodology (CPM) to identify and mitigate potential delays.


**Qualifications**
* Academic Foundation: Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Business Management or Information Technology.

* Software Command: Expert\-level mastery of Microsoft Project, PowerPoint, Excel and Word. Primavera P6 is desirable.
+ Design Coordination: Familiarity with InDesign.
+ Data/Commercial: Advanced Excel (Pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, financial modelling)

* Essential Behavioural Competencies
* Self\-Starter \& Proactive Ownership: Takes initiative, thinks ahead, identifies risks and opportunities early, and drives actions forward without the need for close supervision or constant direction.
* Workload Management \& Accountability: Effectively manages own priorities, remains organised under pressure, and can independently balance multiple tasks and deadlines with minimal guidance.
* Team Contribution \& Support: Works collaboratively as part of the wider team, builds strong internal relationships, and actively supports colleagues by sharing workload and contributing where needed.
* Senior PM Support \& Added Capacity: Provides reliable support to the Senior Project Manager by taking ownership of delegated responsibilities, reducing pressure on senior leadership, and stepping in to manage additional tasks during peak periods.
* Client \& Stakeholder Relationship Building: Builds trusted, professional relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal teams through clear communication and dependable delivery.
* PMO \& Project Controls Capability: Able to undertake all aspects of PMO support, including reporting, governance, programme coordination, document control, action tracking, and maintaining project controls.
* Financial Management \& Forecasting: Competent in managing project financials, including monitoring time charged, tracking spend, reviewing budgets, and maintaining accurate cost forecasts.
* Resilience \& Commitment: Comfortable working in demanding, fast\-paced environments, including longer days or additional hours when required to meet project milestones and business needs.
* Adaptability \& Flexibility: Responds positively to changing priorities, urgent issues, and evolving project requirements while maintaining a high standard of delivery.
* Communication: Exceptional command of written and spoken English. Ability to present complex data in a visually compelling and concise manner. Arabic proficiency is desirable.
* KSA Client Environment Experience: Good understanding of client expectations, business culture, and consultant standards when operating in Saudi Arabia.
* Certification: Active PMP (Project Management Professional) or Chartered Planner (RTPI/AICP/MRICS) status is highly desirable.
* Specialized Knowledge: Experience with KSA Giga\-projects is a significant advantage.
* Advanced Analytics: Use of Power BI and other analytical tools.


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Work on landmark projects around the world and embrace opportunities to make an even bigger impact in the communities you care about. What if you could do the best work of your life and create a legacy for yourself?
   

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.**

***Radically Changing the Way People Learn!***

**Now: We’re laser\-focused on reinventing schools in Saudi Arabia. We’re accelerating rapidly, well\-funded, and profitable.
   

  

 Office: Full\-time, Riyadh\-based. We’ve got a sweet office near the Boulevard, and we’d love to have you in it.**
 Role Purpose
   

  

 The purpose of this role is to lead and manage the execution of expansion and engineering projects from early site assessment until final handover.
   

  

 The role will ensure that each project has a clear scope, timeline, contractor ownership, execution plan, quality control process, snagging closure, and proper handover to operations.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager \- Facilities Expansions to lead and deliver large\-scale facilities projects for a growing international education provider. This role offers the chance to manage the end\-to\-end delivery of campus expansions, refurbishment, and fit\-out programmes, ensuring projects are completed on time, on budget, and to a high standard while supporting our mission to create excellent learning environments.
   

  

 The Senior Project Manager will own the project lifecycle from planning and procurement through construction, commissioning and handover. You will work cross\-functionally with academic leaders, operations, design teams, external consultants and contractors, and will be responsible for driving schedules, cost control, risk management and quality assurance in often complex, fast\-moving settings. The role may be based remotely with regular travel to project sites; relocation is not required.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead the delivery of facilities expansion projects including new build, extensions, refurbishments and specialist learning space fit\-outs from feasibility through to handover.
* Develop and maintain integrated project plans, budgets, risk registers and milestone tracking; ensure robust reporting to senior stakeholders.
* Manage procurement and contract administration for consultants and contractors, ensuring compliance with procurement policies and best practice.
* Coordinate multidisciplinary teams including architects, engineers, MEP, AV/IT and specialist suppliers to translate educational requirements into built outcomes.
* Drive site\-based project management including programme management, site supervision, quality control, health \& safety compliance and statutory approvals.
* Implement effective quality assurance and commissioning processes to ensure completed works meet functional, technical and safety standards.
* Manage stakeholder engagement with school leaders, operations, finance and external authorities to align project delivery with operational needs and academic calendars.
* Provide mentorship and line management to project team members and contribute to continuous improvement of project delivery frameworks and templates.


**Must\-Have Requirements**
* Proven track record delivering complex facilities projects (new build and refurbishments) valued at £2m\+ or equivalent international projects.
* Chartered or professionally recognised qualification in construction, engineering, project management or related discipline (e.g., MRICS, CEng, PMP, CIOB).
* Minimum 7\+ years’ relevant experience managing design and construction projects with responsibility for budgets, programmes and procurement.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience of contract administration (NEC, JCT, FIDIC or equivalent).
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to present to senior leadership and external authorities.
* Demonstrable experience of site\-based project management, health \& safety compliance and quality assurance processes.
* Able to work full\-time Sunday to Thursday (GMT \+3\) where required for coordination with regional teams and project sites. Some flexibility for site visits outside these hours may be required.
* Right to work in relevant locations and ability to travel regularly to project sites (regional travel may be required).


**Highly Advantageous**
* Experience delivering projects within the education sector or other client\-facing environments where minimising disruption to operations is critical.
* Familiarity with sustainable design principles, BREEAM, LEED or other environmental standards.
* Experience working in the Middle East or with regional statutory authorities and local supply chains.
* Arabic language ability.


**What We’re Really Looking For**
* A pragmatic, solutions\-focused project leader who thrives in dynamic environments and enjoys balancing technical delivery with strong stakeholder relationships.
* Someone who can confidently own projects end\-to\-end, make decisive trade\-offs, and maintain high standards of quality and safety.
* A collaborative team player who can mentor others and help mature project delivery processes across the organisation.


**Who This Role Is (and Isn’t) For**
* Ideal for: Experienced senior project managers or construction leads who have managed multi\-million pound projects and want to apply their skills to create outstanding educational facilities.
* Not for: Individuals who prefer purely office\-based or purely design\-only roles without responsibility for on\-site delivery and stakeholder coordination.


**Other details:**
* The is site\-based depending on project needs. Regular travel to sites and occasional overnight stays may be required.
* We are looking for someone who can start at short notice.


**How To Apply**
* If this role aligns with your experience and ambitions and you want to contribute to delivering world\-class learning environments, we would love to hear from you. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted to go through a structured hiring process. Join us and help shape inspiring spaces for students and staff.


 Noon Academy is the leading edtech platform in the Middle East, with over 14 million students and teachers using our app to learn, teach, and collaborate. We have recently raised $41 million in Series B funding to expand our reach and impact in the region and beyond. We are on a mission to transform the physical classroom experience by introducing our highly engaging social, group\-based learning and AI to make learning fun and improve learning efficacy. Our ultimate goal is to provide access to the best teachers to every student even if that teacher is only available virtually. We believe we can do this if we blend AI, peer\-to\-peer learning, and a carefully designed physical space.

data.raw_snippet: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how mi
data.jd_text:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Anduril's Middle East team delivers cutting\-edge platforms, software\-first systems, and integrated effects from across Anduril's portfolio to regional customers, with the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) serving as our primary growth anchor. The team adapts and applies Anduril's core hardware and software products to serve the unique national security and defense requirements of Saudi Arabia and the broader GCC. As this team rapidly expands its footprint in Riyadh, this role requires an applicant willing to take on diverse responsibilities. The Business Development (BD) team is responsible for identifying, shaping, capturing, and growing new opportunities and capabilities for the company. BD team members serve as the bridge between Saudi defense stakeholders and the broader Anduril team; they convey local operational requirements to our global enterprise while serving as the Anduril brand ambassador in\-Kingdom. They partner extensively with engineering and program management to ensure Anduril products exceed regional mission demands and align with KSA’s defense modernization goals.
   

  

**About The Job**
 We are looking for an Associate Director, Business Development (BD) based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, to identify, shape, and capture opportunities to grow revenue within the Kingdom and the wider region. You will serve as the critical link between Saudi defense prospects/clients and our global product teams, translating local operational needs into the Product and Engineering pipelines to ensure Anduril’s suite of autonomous systems meets the Kingdom’s security demands. This role requires a high degree of initiative, localized cultural fluency, and a deep understanding of Saudi procurement. You will have direct ownership of shaping, capturing, and executing business development opportunities in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030 defense localization objectives.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Find, pursue and close business within Saudi Arabia. This will involve extensive travel within the Kingdom, high\-level engagement at regional defense exhibitions (such as the World Defense Show), and deep responsibility for navigating KSA budget cycles and ministerial approval processes. Success will be achieved by developing deep relationships within the Ministry of Defense (MoD), Ministry of National Guard (MNG), Ministry of Interior (MoI), and presidency forces. You will monitor local buying cycles, lead specific proposal and capture efforts, and generate highly targeted growth strategies based on KSA’s threat landscape and strategic priorities.
* Develop capture strategies. Provide cohesive business plans and execution models that outline acquisition paths, create clear alignment to Saudi investment strategies, and drive towards programs of record. Success will be achieved by engaging key stakeholders—including the General Authority for Military Industries (GAMI) and Saudi Arabian Military Industries (SAMI)—to shape requirements, secure relevant funding, and develop localized industrialization and supplier strategies for competitive captures.
* Drive product adoption and program transition. Anduril thrives by developing new technologies for our clients' most pressing operational challenges, particularly in UAS, Counter\-UAS, and border security. You will drive the transition of nascent concepts into KSA operations through early\-stage pilot programs, field trials, and collaborative R\&D. Internally, you are charged with translating Saudi defense challenges back into our engineering organization, ensuring our product suite remains best\-in\-class for the region’s unique desert and maritime operating environments.
* Grow existing business. While the primary role is capturing new business, you will represent all Business Lines across Anduril's portfolio. You will partner with local execution teams, joint venture partners, and product engineers to scale our footprint with existing Saudi clients. This involves not only expanding current contracts but leveraging established relationships to explore new capabilities, sensor integrations, and localized software\-defined command and control (C2\) solutions.
* Communicate our value to clients. BD team members are brand ambassadors who represent Anduril to Saudi decision\-makers, local industrial partners, and the regional public. You must project the company's ethos, clearly communicating our software\-first approach, speed of innovation, and competitive edge in localized co\-production and technology transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of business development, military operational, or strategic sales experience interfacing directly with Saudi government decision\-makers (i.e. MoD, MNG, MoI, security forces), with deep expertise in GAMI regulations, localization mandates, and Saudi procurement processes.
* The ideal candidate will be a proven growth leader with prior experience in commercial or defense capture and sales within the Kingdom, demonstrating a track record of building, executing, and winning defense contracts under Saudi Vision 2030 guidelines.Prior acquisition or operational experience in\-Kingdom, with a strong understanding of Saudi Arabia’s strategic security priorities and threat environment.
* An aptitude and appetite to thrive within organizations with nascent structure, high\-ownership culture, and a "whatever it takes" environment.
* A knack for knocking out deliverables in an ambiguous environment, while maintaining a level\-head, strong interpersonal skills, and the cultural gravitas required to navigate senior\-level Saudi defense environments.
* Excellent writing and communication skills with experience briefing senior military commanders and executive leadership.
* Bachelor's degree from an accredited university.
* Ability to travel 50%\-75% (predominantly within KSA and the Middle East, with occasional travel to US HQs).
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S., Canada, U.K., Australia, or New Zealand security clearance.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience shaping and leading capture efforts directly involving SAMI (Saudi Arabian Military Industries) or local Saudi defense\-industrial partners.
* Prior experience working with Foreign Military Sales (FMS), Direct Commercial Sales (DCS), and Saudi direct commercial procurement, including navigating ITAR, licensing, and technology releasability.
* Demonstrated knowledge of KSA defense modernization programs, with a history of zero\-to\-one program growth in the Middle East.
* Demonstrated high\-energy, high\-ownership individual who will drive performance and exhibit strong management skills with a high level of emotional intelligence and cultural awareness. Must be able to work in a fast\-paced, highly entrepreneurial environment, and adapt global technologies to the local market.
* Riyadh\-based or willing to permanently relocate to Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
* Currently has and is able to maintain an active U.S., Canada, U.K., Australia, or New Zealand security clearance.
* Strong bilingual communication skills; fluency in both written and spoken Arabic and English.


**Benefits**
 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including:
   

  

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next.
 *For more information, Explore Our Benefits.*
**Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**
 Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.
   

  

 To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind
   

  

* No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* Please always verify communications:
+ Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
+ Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

* Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
* What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.


**Data Privacy**
 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice/.
   

  

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third\-party service provider to conduct pre\-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third\-party service provider provides risk\-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public\-record information, and other lawful open\-source or commercial data sources. This third\-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

 **Senior Landscape Architect (Saudi National)** 
 to join our site\-based construction supervision team on a major public realm development in Diriyah, which includes a series of iconic and neighborhood parks, open spaces, and over 55 kilometers of streetscape. The objective of this program is to create a vibrant, inclusive environment that enhances livability, accessibility, and community well\-being.

* Report to the Construction Director/Resident Engineer and act as the discipline lead for landscape works on site.

* Conduct daily site inspections and regular site walks to monitor progress, workmanship, quality of planting, soil preparation, and layout to maintain the design intent.
* Verify plant species, sizes, quantities, spacing, and locations against the approved drawings and plant schedules.
* Check that levels, grading, planting bed shapes, edges, and transitions are consistent with the design and coordinated with hardscape and utilities.
* Coordinate and follow up on inspection requests (IRs), NCRs, and site observations with the contractor, ensuring timely corrective actions and closure.
* Liaise closely with hardscape architects, wet and dry utilities engineers, irrigation specialists, structural and architectural teams, and the contractor to resolve on\-site conflicts and interface issues.
* Review and approve samples, mock\-ups, and trial planting areas before full\-scale implementation.
* Oversee plant delivery, handling, storage, and installation, ensuring plants meet quality and health standards and are installed in accordance with best horticultural practices.
* Monitor initial maintenance and establishment periods, including irrigation, fertilization, pruning, and replacement of dead or failed plants.
* Review and verify as\-built drawings and landscape O\&M manuals for completeness and accuracy.
* Participate in progress, technical, and coordination meetings, providing input on landscape\-related matters, risks, and mitigation strategies.
* Monitor the contractor’s work program, sequencing, and resources for landscape works, highlighting potential delays and recommending solutions.
* Ensure that health, safety, and environmental (HSE) requirements are fully implemented for all landscape activities, in line with Parsons and project policies.
* Prepare and submit discipline\-specific reports, including daily/weekly site reports, quality reports, technical memos, and site correspondence as required.
* Support inspections, snagging, de‑snagging, and final handover of landscape areas to the client, ensuring high quality and alignment with the design vision.

* Bachelor's degree in Landscape Architecture or a closely related field from a recognized university.
* in landscape construction supervision, preferably on large\-scale public realm, parks, or urban development projects.
* Strong understanding of landscape design, horticulture, planting design, and soil/plant relationships, including regional plant species suitable for arid climates.

* Proven experience in site\-based supervision, quality control, and coordination with multi\-disciplinary teams and contractors.
* Ability to read and interpret landscape, architectural, structural, and utility drawings, and ensure proper coordination on site.
* Strong communication, leadership, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to protect and implement design intent during construction.

This role leads multi‑disciplinary teams and multiple contractors from initiation through design coordination, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, and handover, ensuring that scope, schedule, budget, quality, safety, and stakeholder requirements are met or exceeded.

**Project Leadership \& Governance**
* Lead the planning and delivery of utility compound projects from concept to handover and closeout.

**Scope, Schedule \& Cost Management**
* Develop and manage the integrated project management plan, including scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, and communications.

**Design, Engineering \& Technical Coordination**
* Coordinate with Design Director/Managers and design consultants to ensure timely, coordinated design deliverables that support procurement and construction.

**Procurement \& Contract Management**
* Support procurement strategy development for major packages (civil works, buildings, MEP, equipment, specialist systems).

* Manage contractor performance against contract requirements, including progress, quality, HSE, and commercial obligations.
* Review and approve major contract changes, claims, and final accounts in coordination with the commercial team.


**Construction, Commissioning \& Handover**
* Oversee site execution of civil, structural, architectural, and MEP works for the utility compounds.
* Coordinate construction sequencing, access, and logistics to minimize clashes and downtime.
* Ensure testing and commissioning plans are developed and implemented for all systems (power, MEP, building systems, SCADA, fire \& life safety, etc.).
* Lead or support project handover processes, including punch lists, as‑built documentation, O\&M manuals, training, and acceptance by operations.


**HSE, Quality \& Compliance**
* Promote and enforce a strong HSE culture, ensuring compliance with company, client, and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure project‑specific HSE plans, method statements, risk assessments, and permits are in place and effectively implemented.
* Oversee implementation of quality plans, inspection and test plans, and quality assurance/quality control processes.
* Ensure compliance with applicable codes, standards, utility design criteria, and permit conditions.


**Risk, Issues \& Stakeholder Management**
* Establish and maintain project risk and issues registers; lead risk identification, assessment, mitigation, and contingency planning.
* Escalate critical risks and issues promptly with clear analysis and recommended actions.
* Act as primary point of contact for clients, utility owners, authorities, and key stakeholders on project matters.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, ensuring timely, transparent communication and effective issue resolution.


**Reporting \& Performance Management**
* Provide regular project status reports (schedule, cost, risk, HSE, quality, key decisions) to senior management and clients.
* Define and track project KPIs (e.g., schedule performance, cost performance, change volume, HSE metrics, defects/rework).
* Lead monthly progress meetings, steering committees, and executive reviews as required.
* Drive continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned and implementing improvements in project delivery processes.


**Team Leadership \& Development**
* Lead and mentor a multi‑disciplinary project team, including project engineers, coordinators, planners, HSE, quality, and commercial staff.
* Allocate resources effectively and ensure clear accountabilities across the team and contractors.
* Foster a collaborative, solution‑oriented culture across design, construction, commercial, and client teams.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Electrical, Mechanical), Construction Management, or a related field.
* 15 years of progressive project management experience on major construction or infrastructure projects, with significant exposure to utility compounds, substations, or similar industrial/utility facilities.
* Proven track record of delivering multi‑disciplinary projects from initiation through commissioning and handover.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in Project Management, Engineering, or Business.
* Professional project management certification such as PMP or equivalent.
* Experience working with utility or energy clients, and within multi‑contract or program environments.

**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong project management skills across scope, schedule, cost, risk, and change.

 Applications closing on 1st July 2026\.

data.jd_text:
**Role Overview**
 Build the infrastructure \- establish the governance, tooling, and process foundation for how recurring engagements will be mobilized, monitored, and billed going forward.
   

  

 Run what already exists \- take direct ownership of currently live T\&M and Managed Services engagements so that delivery continuity, SLA attainment, and billing are not disrupted while the infrastructure is being built.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Infrastructure Build


 Stand up the SLA definition and agreement process for new Operational Managed Services engagements \- aligned to ISO/IEC 20000\-1 categories (availability, response time, resolution time, quality/output) in lines with the terms negotiated with clients that safeguard the company's interest.
   

  

 Establish the client enablement document template and process for T\&M engagements \- billable\-day definition, approval authority, exception handling, non\-withholding clause.
   

  

 Define the mobilization checklist and standard for both production (billable) and management staff \- covering client acceptance, rate/SLA confirmation, system access, and compliance documentation.
   

  

 Set up the Change Request (CR) governance process for Managed Services \- formal logging, classification, pricing against the Master Price List, and client acceptance before billing wherever applicable.
   

  

 Work to ensure all of the above is documented as a formal SOP, version\-controlled in the central SharePoint repository
   

  

* Live Engagement Management


 Take direct ownership of an assigned portfolio of active T\&M and/or Managed Services engagements immediately upon joining.
   

  

 Own the monthly timesheet governance cycle for T\&M engagements \- data preparation, Level\-1 and Level\-2 approval chase, daily rate application, and timely Delivery Note preparation.
   

  

 Monitor SLA attainment for Managed Services engagements in your portfolio \- track performance against agreed thresholds, escalate to Technology before a breach occurs, and produce the service period report.
   

  

 Manage the Delivery Note sign\-off cycle end\-to\-end \- reconcile to rate card/PO, obtain client signature, and hand over the signed DN package to Finance within the stipulated timelines.
   

  

 Act as the first escalation point for client\-side service issues, timesheet disputes, and delivery concerns within your portfolio.
   

  

 Flag and formally raise any engagement carrying unacceptable delivery risk \- including the right to recommend declining or restructuring high\-risk scope before commitment.
   

  

* Mobilization


 Coordinate the mobilization of new resources onto live engagements \- client acceptance of profiles, rate/SLA confirmation in writing, and compliance documentation (Iqama, GOSI, WPS enrolment) completed before Day 1 of billable work.
   

  

 Set up onsite and offshore delivery infrastructure for new mobilizations \- system access, VPN, workspace allocation, and working\-time framework \- confirmed and tested before go\-live.
   

  

 Coordinate with HR and Technology to ensure management and governance roles (not just production staff) are assigned and briefed before engagement start.
   

  

* Reporting \& Continuous Improvement


 Maintain real\-time visibility of utilization, recovery days, and SLA attainment across your portfolio \- feeding into the Portfolio Manager's aggregated view.
   

  

 Contribute engagement\-level data and lessons learned into the 90\-day capacity forecast and into future proposal costing.
   

  

 Identify recurring process gaps during live delivery and feed them back into the infrastructure build \- this role is expected to improve the SOPs it operates under, not just follow them.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Experience**
 6\-10 years of experience in IT services delivery, managed services operations, staffing/T\&M operations, or recurring service delivery.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience running live client engagements with commercial accountability \- not purely a project coordination background.
   

  

 Experience setting up a new process or function from scratch is strongly preferred \- this is as much a build role as a run role.
   

  

 Exposure to both onsite and offshore delivery models is an advantage, given the company's KSA, India, and Egypt footprint.
   

  

**Technical \& Functional Skills**
 Strong working knowledge of SLA frameworks \- familiarity with ISO/IEC 20000 or ITIL service management concepts preferred.
   

  

 Comfortable with timesheet, billing, and Delivery Note governance cycles \- understands the mechanics of how T\&M revenue is protected from leakage.
   

  

 Experience with ticketing or service management platforms (Fresh service, Jira Service Management, or equivalent) for CR and SLA tracking.
   

  

 Working knowledge of KSA labor compliance touchpoints \- Iqama, GOSI, WPS, Qiwa \- sufficient to coordinate with HR, not execute compliance directly.
   

  

**Behavioral \& Leadership Qualities**
 Comfortable holding two priorities simultaneously \- building new processes while keeping existing commitments running without disruption.
   

  

 Direct and proactive in escalating risk \- this role is expected to say no to unworkable commitments, not absorb risk silently.
   

  

 Strong written communication \- produces clean, factual service reports and escalation notes that a client or senior leadership can act on without rework.
   

  

 Works well under ambiguity without using that ambiguity as an excuse for delivery gaps.
   

  

**Certifications (preferred, Not Mandatory At Entry)**
 ITIL Foundation
   

  

 PMP or equivalent project/service management certification
   

  

 Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt or Green Bel

 , while meeting market, operational, and governance requirements.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Delivery Ownership
* Take full accountability for the delivery of assigned apartment buildings and residential clusters.
* Lead delivery execution in line with approved development strategy, masterplan, and apartment product brief.
* Act as the single point of accountability for apartment delivery outcomes across all project phases.
* Design \& Product Oversight
* Oversee apartment design development to ensure:
+ Efficient unit layouts and net\-to\-gross optimisation
+ Compliance with residential codes, authority approvals, and Qiddiya design standards

* Construction \& Programme Management
* Lead and manage delivery partners, project managers, contractors, and consultants for apartment projects.
* Monitor progress against approved programmes and key milestones, implementing corrective actions as required.
* Coordinate interfaces with infrastructure, utilities, public realm, and adjacent developments.
* Cost, Commercial \& Risk Control
* Maintain budget accountability for apartment delivery packages.
* Review and endorse cost plans, variations, claims, and change controls in collaboration with commercial teams.
* Identify, manage, and escalate delivery risks through formal governance and reporting structures.
* Handover, Readiness \& Close\-Out
* Ensure apartments are delivered fully complete and ready for occupation, including:
+ Testing, commissioning, and certification
+ Snagging, defects management, and authority approvals

* Coordinate with operations, asset management, and sales/leasing teams to support smooth handover and market readiness.
* Oversee final accounts, close\-out documentation, and post\-completion reviews.
* Governance \& Stakeholder Management
* Prepare and present delivery updates, risks, and decisions to internal governance committees.
* Manage key internal stakeholders including planning, commercial, design, operations, and sustainability teams.
* Engage with external stakeholders, authorities, and partners to secure approvals and resolve issues efficiently.

* Champion a strong health and safety culture across all apartment construction sites.
* Ensure sustainability and ESG requirements are embedded into apartment delivery, including energy efficiency, water management, and material selection

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related discipline.

* 10 \- 12 years' experience in large\-scale apartment or high\-density residential delivery.
* Proven track record delivering mid\-rise to high\-rise apartment buildings within complex, multi\-stakeholder environments.
* Experience on large\-scale developments or mega/giga projects in the Middle East is highly desirable.


****Core Competencies****
* Strong end\-to\-end delivery leadership
* Residential construction and apartment product expertise
* Commercial and contractual awareness
* Programme and risk management
* Executive\-level stakeholder management

data.jd_text:
**ABOUT SIFI**




 SiFi is a corporate expense management platform designed to empower finance and accounting teams with seamless control over corporate spending. Our platform allows companies to issue cards with specific spending restrictions, ensuring that funds are used efficiently and only for approved expenses.
   





**POSITION OVERVIEW**




 The Infrastructure Manager is a senior role that combines strong people and operational leadership with deep, hands\-on technical expertise in infrastructure and reliability engineering. This role reports directly to the Director of Technology and is responsible for leading the Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team, driving infrastructure strategy, and maintaining full technical authority over SiFi’s systems.
   





 Unlike a purely administrative management role, the Infrastructure Manager is expected to possess and actively apply deep technical knowledge — participating in architecture decisions, contributing during critical incidents, and evaluating infrastructure solutions at an engineering level. This role ensures high system availability, robust security controls, full compliance with SAMA regulations, and cost\-optimized infrastructure operations.
   

  

  

  




 Requirements
   

  


**Team Leadership \& Culture**




 • Lead, mentor, and develop the SRE and infrastructure team; set clear career paths, goals, and performance expectations.
   





 • Foster a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and technical excellence aligned with SiFi’s values: Customer Centricity, Product\-First Mindset, and Data\-Driven Excellence.
   





 • Partner with Product and Engineering teams to ensure infrastructure supports secure, reliable product delivery.
   

  





**Infrastructure Architecture \& Engineering**




 • Own and actively contribute to infrastructure architecture decisions, including reviewing and designing cloud\-native and hybrid solutions to support scalability, security, and performance.
   





 • Lead the hands\-on design, implementation, and maintenance of secure, scalable, and resilient cloud and hybrid infrastructures, including deployment pipelines and system hardening.
   





 • Perform regular architecture and system health assessments to proactively identify risks, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities; translate findings into actionable engineering work.
   





 • Act as a technical authority in infrastructure and DevOps, providing guidance across teams and ensuring alignment with SiFi’s long\-term technology strategy.
   

  





**Reliability \& Incident Management**




 • Define and enforce SLAs, SLOs, and error budgets; ensure system performance meets or exceeds targets through proactive monitoring, alerting, and automation.
   





 • Provide hands\-on support during critical incidents, including deep technical troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and system recovery — acting as the most senior technical responder when needed.
   





 • Lead production readiness reviews, post\-incident reviews, and disaster recovery drills; maintain and validate business continuity frameworks.
   





 • Track and meet clear reliability KPIs, including system uptime targets (e.g., \>99\.95%).
   

  





**Security \& Access Control**




 • Develop and enforce robust access control processes; ensure system access is authorized, reviewed regularly, and provisioned or de\-provisioned in a timely manner.
   





 • Collaborate with the Cybersecurity Department to align infrastructure security with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
   

  





**Regulatory Compliance**




 • Ensure infrastructure operations comply with SAMA regulatory controls; serve as the primary infrastructure contact for regulators, ensuring timely reporting and transparent cooperation.
   





 • Coordinate with Compliance, Risk, and Cybersecurity teams to close regulatory observations and audit findings promptly.
   





 • Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date compliance documentation and evidence for audits and inspections.
   

  





**Cost \& Vendor Management**




 • Own and optimize the budget for infrastructure, systems, and software licenses; identify cost\-saving opportunities through vendor management and efficient resource utilization.
   





 • Manage relationships with cloud providers, infrastructure vendors, and license suppliers; ensure SLA adherence and value delivery.
   

  





**Reporting \& Communication**




 • Report to the Director of Technology and relevant stakeholders on system availability, incidents, compliance posture, and infrastructure health.
   





 • Communicate proactively with internal functions about infrastructure initiatives, risks, and issue resolution.
   

  

  

  




 Benefits
   

  


**Experience**




 • 8\+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, SRE, or cloud operations, with at least 3–4 years in a management or senior technical leadership role overseeing infrastructure or SRE teams.
   





 • Experience with payment systems or financial services infrastructure is preferred.
   

  





**Technical Skills**




 • Deep technical knowledge of Linux/Unix systems, networking, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and infrastructure\-as\-code tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) — with the ability to contribute at an engineering level when required.
   





 • Proven expertise in designing, operating, and scaling secure, high\-availability cloud\-native and hybrid environments.
   





 • Strong knowledge of SRE principles, observability, ITSM practices, and cost management for infrastructure and licenses.
   





 • Hands\-on experience implementing and managing system access controls aligned with security frameworks.
   





  





**Leadership \& Compliance**




 • Demonstrated ability to manage, mentor, and grow a high\-performing technical team while maintaining the technical credibility to guide engineering decisions and drive quality.
   





 • Proven track record mentoring engineering teams on reliability and infrastructure best practices.
   





 • Deep familiarity with regulatory frameworks, including SAMA, and experience cooperating with regulators and internal compliance functions.

data.jd_text:
**Role Purpose**
 The Executive Director \- MMC \& Delivery Learning Systems is responsible for institutionalising innovation and structured learning across the Qiddiya City Programme.
   

  

 The role leads two strategic programme enablers:
   

  

* Modern Methods of Construction (MMC) \- to enhance productivity, scalability, quality consistency, safety, and delivery predictability
* Delivery Learning \& Knowledge Systems \- to reduce systemic repeat failures, accelerate decision\-making, and embed institutional delivery intelligence across Business Units (BUs)


 Operating at programme scale, the role ensures that Qiddiya moves from fragmented project\-based execution toward structured, repeatable, and performance\-driven delivery systems.
   

  

**Strategic Mandate**
* Modern Methods of Construction (MMC)
* Define and steer Qiddiya's MMC ambition, roadmap, and governance framework
* Identify scalable MMC opportunities across asset typologies
* Establish standards, decision pathways, and adoption frameworks to enable BU implementation
* Align with Procurement and Supply Chain to support manufacturing agreements and market feasibility
* Translate pilot outcomes into institutionalised standards and repeatable playbooks
* Monitor measurable impact on cost, schedule, quality, HSE, and sustainability performance


 The role does not replace BU delivery accountability; it enables structured and scalable adoption across the programme.
   

  

**Delivery Learning \& Knowledge Systems**
* Establish and govern a structured delivery knowledge\-sharing system across the Qiddiya programme
* Institutionalise lessons learned, best practices, and repeatable standards
* Create cross\-BU transparency mechanisms to reduce duplication and rework
* Implement structured feedback loops between Delivery, Logistics, Engineering, Procurement, and Commercial functions
* Embed a culture of constructive transparency, where learning accelerates performance rather than assigning blame


 Knowledge sharing is positioned as a performance accelerator and delivery control mechanism — not documentation.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Provide executive leadership for MMC and Delivery Learning initiatives in alignment with SDU mandate and TOM
* Translate systemic delivery risks and recurring failure patterns into structured institutional solutions
* Secure executive alignment and approvals for frameworks, governance models, and scaling strategies
* Ensure integration across Delivery, Procurement, Engineering/Design, Logistics, Commercial, and Digital functions
* Drive measurable improvements in delivery predictability, productivity, and cross\-BU coordination


**Success Measures**
**MMC**
* Demonstrable adoption of MMC solutions on eligible assets
* Improved schedule confidence and delivery consistency
* Established supplier/manufacturing pathways supporting scalable adoption
* Measurable performance gains on pilot implementations


**Delivery Learning**
* Reduction in repeat systemic issues and avoidable rework
* Increased cross\-BU coordination and visibility
* Sustained platform adoption and knowledge reuse
* Faster issue resolution cycles across delivery ecosystem


**Stakeholder Environment**
**Internal:**
 SDU Leadership; BU Delivery Directors; CDU/Implementation; Engineering/Design; Procurement \& Supply Chain; Logistics; Commercial/Contracts; Digital/IT; People \& Culture.
   

  

**External:**
 Delivery partners; Tier 1 contractors; modular/offsite manufacturers; technology providers; specialist consultants; supply chain ecosystem.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Profile Requirements**
 This role requires a senior international development and delivery executive with demonstrated experience leading major programmes or large\-scale master developments.
   

  

**Experience**
* Minimum 18 years' progressive experience in international real estate development, infrastructure, or complex construction environments
* Proven leadership in multi\-asset or giga\-project settings with concurrent project portfolios
* Experience operating in high\-growth, high\-complexity environments (e.g., national transformation or large urban developments)
* Demonstrated exposure to construction innovation, industrialised construction, modular delivery, or transformation initiatives at scale
* Experience engaging senior executive committees and securing approval for strategic frameworks
* Strong understanding of programme governance, stage\-gate processes, and cross\-functional integration
* Track record interfacing with contractors, manufacturers, consultants, and supply chain ecosystems


**Role Positioning Summary**
 This is a programme capability and transformation role designed to:
   

  

* Enable scalable construction innovation (MMC)
* Institutionalise delivery learning across Business Units
* Improve predictability and performance at programme scale


 The Executive Director operates as a strategic enabler — strengthening delivery maturity, governance capability, and structured transparency across the Qiddiya City Programme.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Attractive compensations and benefits package
