data.jd_text:
The Director of Engineering is responsible for the strategic leadership, operational management, and continuous improvement of all engineering functions within the hotel. This role oversees the maintenance and reliability of the property's physical assets, including building infrastructure, mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP) systems, HVAC, fire and life safety systems, energy management systems, and all back\-of\-house facilities.
 



  





 The incumbent ensures that all engineering operations support the delivery of exceptional guest experiences while maintaining the highest standards of safety, regulatory compliance, sustainability, and financial performance. The Director of Engineering develops long\-term asset management strategies, leads capital improvement initiatives, and drives preventive and predictive maintenance programs to maximize equipment reliability and lifecycle value.
 



  





 As a member of the Executive Committee, the Director of Engineering collaborates closely with hotel leadership to align engineering objectives with overall business goals and serves as the lead coordinator for emergency preparedness and response activities related to facility operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Engineering Operations \& Technical Leadership** 




  




* Provide strategic leadership and oversight of all engineering and maintenance operations across the property.
* Direct the operation, maintenance, and optimization of HVAC systems, chillers, cooling towers, boilers, refrigeration systems, electrical distribution networks, generators, UPS systems, plumbing infrastructure, water treatment systems, swimming pool systems, kitchen and laundry equipment, elevators, and Building Management Systems (BMS).
* Establish and implement preventive and predictive maintenance programs to ensure optimal equipment reliability and minimize operational disruptions.
* Monitor engineering performance indicators, identify opportunities for improvement, and implement corrective actions to enhance operational efficiency.
* Ensure all engineering activities comply with established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and manufacturer recommendations.



  





**Asset Management \& Capital Planning** 




  




* Develop and execute long\-term engineering strategies aligned with the hotel's business objectives and brand standards.
* Lead the development and execution of the annual Engineering Business Plan and departmental objectives.
* Prepare, justify, and manage the annual engineering operating budget and capital expenditure plans.
* Develop and maintain a 5 to 10\-year asset replacement strategy for major plant and equipment.
* Manage renovation projects, equipment upgrades, and capital improvement initiatives from planning through commissioning.
* Supervise contractors, consultants, and project teams to ensure projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and to required specifications.



  





**Financial Management** 




  




* Monitor departmental expenditures and maintain effective control over engineering operating costs.
* Analyze financial reports, payroll summaries, utility consumption trends, and P\&L statements to identify areas for optimization.
* Implement cost\-saving initiatives related to energy consumption, maintenance practices, procurement strategies, and service agreements.
* Ensure effective inventory management and control of engineering tools, spare parts, and consumables.
* Contribute to the annual budgeting and forecasting process.



  





**Energy \& Sustainability Management** 




  




* Lead energy conservation initiatives aimed at reducing utility consumption while maintaining guest comfort and operational efficiency.
* Monitor and optimize electricity, water, gas, and fuel usage through data\-driven analysis and system enhancements.
* Promote sustainable engineering practices and support environmental initiatives aligned with corporate sustainability objectives.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements that enhance operational performance and reduce environmental impact.



  





**Fire, Life Safety \& Regulatory Compliance** 




  




* Ensure full compliance with all applicable local regulations, Qatar Civil Defence requirements, health and safety standards, environmental regulations, and hotel brand standards.
* Maintain the operational readiness of all fire detection, fire suppression, emergency lighting, evacuation, and life safety systems.
* Oversee the testing, inspection, certification, and maintenance of all statutory systems and equipment.
* Ensure all permits, licenses, certifications, and maintenance records remain current and readily available for audit purposes.
* Serve as the Chairperson of the Emergency Response Team and lead preparedness planning for facility\-related emergencies.



  





**Team Leadership \& Talent Development** 




  




* Lead, mentor, and develop the engineering management team and technical staff to foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Establish clear performance expectations and conduct regular performance evaluations.
* Identify training needs and facilitate technical and leadership development initiatives.
* Promote a safe working environment through effective implementation of health and safety practices.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, labor regulations, and disciplinary procedures.
* Encourage employee engagement through open communication, recognition programs, and succession planning initiatives.



  





**Guest Experience \& Service Excellence** 




  




* Support hotel operations by ensuring all guest\-facing facilities remain in excellent working condition.
* Respond proactively to engineering\-related guest concerns and implement corrective measures to prevent recurrence.
* Collaborate with operational departments to minimize disruption during maintenance activities.
* Drive initiatives that enhance comfort, reliability, and overall guest satisfaction through engineering excellence.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  





**Education** 




  




* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Facilities Management, or a related discipline from an accredited institution.
* Professional certifications in HVAC, electrical systems, facilities management, energy management, or project management will be considered an advantage.



  





**Experience** 




  




* Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive engineering experience within luxury hospitality environments, including at least 3–5 years in a senior engineering leadership role.
* Proven experience managing large\-scale hotel engineering operations, preferably within internationally recognized five\-star hotels or resorts.
* Demonstrated expertise in preventive maintenance programs, asset lifecycle management, and capital project execution.
* Experience managing engineering budgets, utility optimization programs, and vendor relationships.



  





**Technical Competencies** 




  




* Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, refrigeration plants, electrical distribution systems, plumbing systems, water treatment processes, fire and life safety systems, Building Management Systems (BMS), and Energy Management Systems (EMS).
* Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS).
* Thorough understanding of Qatar Civil Defence regulations, local statutory requirements, and international hospitality engineering standards.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, technical manuals, and financial reports.



  





**Leadership Competencies** 




  




* Strategic thinking and business acumen.
* Strong decision\-making and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent project management and organizational skills.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Demonstrated ability to lead high\-performing teams in a fast\-paced hospitality environment.
* Commitment to service excellence, continuous improvement, and operational integrity

data.jd_text:
**Title:** 
 Construction Manager
 **–** 
 Airside (Runway/Taxiway/Apron/Road Works)
 



**Location :** 
 Kinshasa, DRC
 



**Reporting to :** 
 Airport Project Director
 



**Contract Type :** 
 Expatriate Assignment
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 The Construction Manager will lead the delivery of a large\-scale airport infrastructure project in Kinshasa, ensuring safe, timely, and cost\-effective execution in compliance with quality and regulatory standards. The role oversees all on\-site construction activities, including planning, drawings interpretation, method statements, and management of plant, equipment, and site resources.
 



  





 Responsible for airside works such as runways, taxiways, aprons, drainage, roads, utilities, and AGL interfaces, the role requires strong hands\-on leadership in a high\-risk operational environment with strict access control and interface coordination.
 



  





 The position demands robust technical expertise and disciplined execution within operational airside constraints, ensuring strict adherence to safety procedures, FOD prevention, work permits, and handback requirements, while maintaining full accountability for site execution, quantities, and resources.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Project Planning \& Execution** 




  




* Lead and coordinate day\-to\-day construction activities across assigned workstreams.
* Support technical and feasibility studies, including site investigations and risk assessments.
* Translate engineering designs into executable construction plans.
* Monitor project timelines and ensure adherence to approved schedules.
* Plan and manage airside phasing and work windows, including shift/night works where required, ensuring safe demarcation, temporary arrangements, and handback readiness.
* Coordinate airside execution interfaces (earthworks/pavements/drainage/duct banks/AGL interfaces) to avoid rework and to maintain a clear critical path for airside readiness.
* Ensure survey control, setting\-out and level/line control are established and maintained for airside geometry compliance (grades, levels, transitions) and that as\-built data is captured progressively.
* Review and interpret approved drawings, specifications, bills of quantities, and related technical documents, and ensure construction works are executed in accordance with the latest approved information.
* Review, comment on, and ensure implementation of method statements, inspection and test plans, work packs, permits, and short\-term execution plans before works commence.
* Plan and control site resource deployment, including labour, plant, equipment, machinery, tools, temporary works, access arrangements, and lifting requirements for each work front.
* Coordinate with Technical, QA/QC, HSE, Procurement, Commercial, and Project Controls to ensure construction activities are properly supported and sequenced, while maintaining Construction accountability for execution decisions and site inputs.



  





**Procurement \& Contract Management** 




  




* Contribute to the preparation of technical specifications and scope of work.
* Support tendering processes, including contractor selection and bid evaluations.



  





**Construction Quantities, Plant \& Resource Accountability** 




  




* Remain accountable and responsible for defining, reviewing, and formally signing off the plant, equipment, machinery, tools, temporary works, and site execution resources required for the works.
* Review and verify material quantities, equipment requests, and site resource plans before submission to Procurement or other support functions.
* Monitor plant utilisation, availability, maintenance status, suitability, and replacement needs, and take corrective action where shortfalls may affect safety, quality, cost, or programme.
* Review and sign off measured quantities, quantity take\-offs, measurement sheets, and supporting site records before issue for progress measurement, valuation support, reporting, or third\-party use.



  





**Site Supervision \& Quality Assurance** 




  




* Supervise construction works to ensure compliance with design specifications, engineering standards, and quality requirements.
* Identify and resolve design, technical, and execution issues in collaboration with engineering teams.
* Conduct regular site inspections and enforce quality control procedures.
* Ensure airside pavement works (subgrade, capping, subbase/base, asphalt/concrete as applicable) comply with approved ITPs, testing frequencies, and acceptance criteria; drive timely corrective actions for non\-conformities.
* Coordinate with QA/QC and testing laboratories to ensure traceable test results, approvals, and release of work fronts prior to subsequent layers/activities.
* Coordinate AGL civil readiness (duct banks, pits, chambers, cable routes, bases) and support commissioning readiness activities by ensuring construction completion and close\-out of punch items affecting AGL installation/testing.
* Carry out constructability, interface, and field\-readiness reviews to confirm that works can be executed safely, efficiently, and in line with approved drawings and site conditions.
* Verify installed quantities, field measurements, and supporting site records before these are issued for progress measurement, valuation support, or reporting.
* Review subcontractor and supplier execution documentation, including shop drawings, method statements, lifting plans, temporary works submissions, and ITPs, and ensure comments are closed out before implementation.



  





**Health, Safety \& Compliance** 




  




* Ensure strict adherence to health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards.
* Enforce compliance with local regulations and international construction standards.
* Promote a strong safety culture across all contractors and site personnel. Implement airside\-specific safety controls including airside driving rules, access/escort protocols, exclusion zones, communications/briefings, and stringent FOD prevention, ensuring that all personnel and subcontractors comply with airside operational safety requirements.
* Ensure work areas are secured with compliant barricading/marking and that temporary conditions do not create hazards to aircraft operations.
* Ensure daily FOD walks/controls and strict housekeeping standards are implemented and recorded.
* Ensure that method statements, permits to work, lifting plans, and task\-specific risk assessments are reviewed and implemented before execution.



  





**Risk \& Issue Management** 




  




* Identify potential project risks and implement mitigation strategies.
* Proactively resolve construction challenges to avoid delays or cost overruns.
* Provide early warning on discrepancies in drawings, quantities, site conditions, plant or equipment performance, and subcontractor capability that may affect delivery.
* Provide early warning on airside operational constraints, access restrictions, interface clashes, and handback risks that may affect safety, programme, or readiness milestones; propose mitigation and recovery actions.



  





**Additional Responsibilities** 




  




* Perform any other related duties as assigned by management in support of project delivery. This includes formal construction review and sign\-off on relevant site execution matters where required.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of
 **7–10 years of experience** 
 in construction management, preferably in large\-scale infrastructure or airport projects.
* Proven experience managing contractors and complex construction sites.
* Demonstrated experience delivering airside works (runway/taxiway/apron/roads earthworks and pavements and/or airfield civil works) with strong understanding of airside execution constraints.
* Experience working in operational airfield environments or under strict access and permit\-to\-work controls is a strong advantage.
* Strong knowledge of construction methodologies, materials, and project management principles.
* Familiarity with ICAO airfield requirements (geometry, safety areas, markings/signage/AGL interfaces) and airside compliance constraints is a strong advantage.
* Experience working in Africa, preferably in challenging or emerging markets.
* Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, bills of quantities, method statements, inspection and test plans, and related technical documentation.
* Practical experience in quantity verification, progress measurement, field productivity monitoring, and review/sign\-off of site execution records.
* Strong understanding of plant, equipment, machinery, temporary works, materials planning, and construction resource control.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 




  




* Strong leadership and site management skills
* Excellent problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities
* Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* High attention to detail and commitment to quality and safety
* Fluent in English is mandatory; professional working proficiency in French is strongly preferred.
* Strong technical ability in reading drawings, verifying quantities, reviewing method statements, and assessing construction resource requirements.
* Clear ownership mindset for plant, equipment, machinery, tools, temporary works, and site productivity.
* Strong discipline in permit\-to\-work compliance, shift handback readiness, and interface coordination in constrained operational environments.
* High standards of field leadership, subcontractor control, and delivery predictability under fast\-paced conditions.



  





**Work Environment** 




  




* Site\-based role in Kinshasa with regular presence on construction sites
* May require extended working hours depending on project needs
* Exposure to a dynamic, fast\-paced infrastructure development environment

data.jd_text:
**Head Of Physical Education (whole School \- Male)**
**Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK), Qatar**
**Job Overview**
**Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male)**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor is looking to appoint an outstanding Head of Physical Education (Whole School \- Male) to join a well\-established, supportive team in a highly successful and expanding school.
   

  

**The closing date for applications 30th June 2026\.**
**The start date for this role is 1st August 2026\.**
**About You**
 You are an outstanding team leader with the track record for developing a vision for excellence and continual improvement. You excel in leading and managing people by creating a culture where colleagues are both supported and challenged to deliver the best possible learning experience for students. You can develop a highly motivated team by nurturing positive working relationships built on respect, trust, support, and recognition. You lead improvement through rigorous self\-evaluation of department performance and use quality assurance feedback to identify improvement priorities moving forward. You demonstrate excellent management skills such as resource management, curriculum planning, data analysis, performance tracking, task delegation, organisation of meetings and creating teacher timetables.
   

  

 You lead a learning culture where students are supported, challenged, and inspired to be the best they can be \- students in classes across the department will believe there are no limits to what can be achieved. Your excellent motivation and communication skills enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within all lessons across the department.
   

  

 Receptive to feedback and ready to embrace change, you will be keen to share best practice with colleagues and peers. As a strong ambassador for the school, you will be able to develop new ways to engage students and parents across both our school (NAISAK), and the wider Nord Anglia Education communities. Your strong motivation and communication skills will also enable you to create a feeling of energy, excitement, and personal investment within the classroom.
   

  

 You will have the following:
   

  

  

* university degree in your specialist subject
* teaching qualification
* substantial Secondary level teaching experience, and knowledge of the Physical Education National curriculum, and IGCSE and A Level curriculums


 You will also be able to meet visa\-related restrictions for Qatar, including possession of a Bachelor's degree and a teaching qualification from a face\-to\-face (non\-online) course.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Join our dynamic international education environment, where you will lead the delivery a fit\-for\-purpose curriculum, built on the UK National Curriculum and preparing students for external examinations at IGSCE/AS\-A levels. You will lead the development of a culture in which students are challenged to be ambitious learners and teachers are required to be innovative to enhance the student experience and outcomes. You will understand the diverse international language environment within our school community to manage effective curriculum programmes to not only teach Physical Education subject content but also continue to support English language development for students across all areas of the school curriculum. Developing a high\-quality extra\-curricular programme for sport and health is a key priority, with a dual\-focus on development\-for\-all and competition.
   

  

 Your educational philosophy will equip you to meet the needs of all learners and be able to teach students with a range of prior achievement, knowledge, and skills. Your expertise and planning adaptability will allow you to map out pathways for all students to progress in your subject, creating opportunities for all learners to achieve success based on individualised targets. You will contribute to good practice by demonstrating a collegiate approach to departmental development and sharing strategies with colleagues.
   

  

 As Head of Physical Education, you will be responsible for leading the planning, delivery and evaluation of the curriculum, teaching and learning, assessment, reporting, student behaviour, and professional development of teachers across the Physical Education department.
   

  

 Please refer to the job description of the role for the following information:
   

  

  

* Job purpose
* Reporting to
* Key relationships
* Key results areas
* Performance measurement


**About Our School**
 Nord Anglia International School Al Khor (NAISAK) is a highly successful, growing school with a committed and inspirational team of teaching professionals at its heart. Our close\-knit, supportive team is proud to be at the centre of the local community, educating over 1350 young people aged 3\-18\. Secondary is 4\-form entry at Key Stage 3, and 3\-form entry in KS4 upwards, with approximately 530 students aged 11\-18\.
   

  

 Our school resides in the town of Al Khor, 35 minutes north of Doha (the capital of Qatar). We educate both local and expat students through a bespoke Secondary curriculum which draws on both the Physical Education National curriculum and the Qatar Ministry of Education curriculum.

* Prepare and deliver consolidated performance reports, and executive\-level dashboards.

**Functional Competencies:** 



* Business intelligence, business analytics \& dashboarding tools

**Behavioral competencies:** 



* Innovative growth mindset.

data.jd_text:
**The kind of PM we're looking for**
 You've got 2\-4 years under your belt at an independent pharma or healthcare agency, enough to know how MLR works, what a tight timeline actually means, and how to keep five things moving without losing the thread on any of them. You're not a coordinator looking to level up, and you're not a senior PM who needs to own the strategy. You're in that sweet spot where execution is your superpower and you genuinely love it.
   

  

 You thrive when the environment is lean, the team is direct, and no one's waiting on three layers of approval to make a call. If you've come from a large networked agency, this might feel different, in a good way, if you've been craving it.
   

  

**What you'll do**
* Plan and execute pharma marketing projects across cross\-functional teams, keeping everything moving from kickoff through delivery
* Build and own project timelines, tracking milestones, dependencies, and risks before they become problems
* Coordinate internal teams across creative, account, strategy, and analytics, you're the connective tissue
* Run status meetings, kickoffs, and checkpoints that are tight, useful, and don't waste anyone's time
* Maintain project documentation, status reports, and workflow trackers with obsessive consistency
* Monitor budget burn and flag scope shifts early, you catch things before they become conversations
* Keep projects inside established workflows and escalate when something's about to go sideways


**What This Role Is Not**
 This is not a budget ownership role. It's not scope negotiation or team management. And if your planning horizon is quarters rather than days, this won't be the right fit. This role is about execution, doing it well, doing it fast, and doing it with the kind of calm that steadies the people around you.
   

  

**What You Bring**
* 2\-4 years of project management or coordination experience inside a pharma or healthcare independent agency environment
* Hands\-on familiarity with Ziflow and Slack; comfort picking up new tools quickly
* The organizational instincts to track what others miss without being asked
* A communication style that keeps teams aligned, direct, clear, no noise
* A solutions\-first mindset: you don't just flag problems, you walk in with options
* Energy for execution, you're wired for the day\-to\-day, not the 30,000\-foot view


**Compensation \& Benefits**
* $91,000 to $110,000 USD
* Full medical and dental benefits
* 15 days vacation plus one additional day per year of service, unlimited flex time
* $500 home office stipend at time of hire
* Our hiring package is ever\-evolving to meet the needs of our team


**The environment**
 P10 is remote\-first, always has been. The team moves fast, the clients are direct, and the work is real. You'll report to our Project Director, and work inside a structure that's flat enough that your contributions are visible and your voice is heard.
   

  

 If you've been looking for a place where independent thinking is rewarded and nobody's waiting on a committee to make a call, this is it.
   

  

 Interested in working with us? Apply online today.
   

  

**Not an agency\***
 The layer\-laden teams. The prehistoric processes. The impersonal, ego\-driven dog\-and\-pony shows. Take what you think you know about agencies and burn it. P10 was born of the idea that if something isn’t working, or could work better, change it. And that’s exactly what we did. We know that what we’re not makes us who we are. And we’re not just another agency. We are people driven by a palpable passion and purpose, felt by our clients from the very first conversation.
   

  

 P10 brings together a team of diverse, remote\-only seasoned professionals to deliver exceptional value for our clients. Dare to do something different \- join us.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.raw_snippet:

data.jd_text:
**Overview \& Responsibilities**
 To ensure total alignment with client operational needs, EEE will assign a dedicated
 **Customer Project Managers (CPM)** 
 to work closely with the Client. This role provides continuous support, improved communication, and proactive project management directly at Client sites and headquarters. When not deployed on field assignments, the primary location will be at the Client office in Al Jubail, with expectations for regular, scheduled site visits to all Client end\-users and affiliate sites where the EEE fleet is installed.
   

  

 The Customer Project Manager coordinates the administrative, contractual, technical, and commercial aspects of field service and repair projects from initial inquiry to final billing and collection, directly producing service income for EEE. The incumbent manages multidisciplinary projects involving multiple EEE departments and product lines, as well as non\-EEE products. On major projects, the CPM directly supervises and provides onsite project management for the installation, commissioning, overhaul, rerate/modifications, and troubleshooting of EEE and other OEM equipment (aligning with Field Service Project Manager requirements). This requires deep engineering knowledge to direct projects from inception (quote stage) to commissioning while ensuring execution remains strictly within budget.
   

  

**Stakeholder Engagement Matrix**
 The CPM acts as the core liaison across internal departments, client divisions, and third\-party compliance bodies:
   

  

**Internal EEE Contacts**
 All levels of management and assigned personnel in:
   

  

* Field Service Operations
* Repair Shop Operations
* Service Parts Operations
* Technical Service
* Rerates and Modifications
* Aftermarket Sales
* Finance/Accounting
* Legal/Contract Administration
* HSE


**External Client Contacts**
* Headquarters (HQ) departments
* HSE
* Procurement
* Engineering
* All key Affiliate sites


**Project, Third\-Party \& Compliance**
* Vendors
* Sub\-contractors
* Service Providers
* Internal and external ISO \& HSE auditors


**Turnaround Project Management \& Field Support**
 This role requires a wide range of independent action and decision\-making throughout the entire project lifecycle (from RFQ to invoicing):
   

  

* Sales Integration \& Proposals: Support service sales operations when selling major field projects; technically support Sales teams and representatives during proposal presentations to customers. Collect data, understand scopes of work, conduct site surveys for technical/commercial proposals, and assist the Sales team with Terms \& Conditions (T\&Cs). Issue comprehensive technical proposals, including detailed work scopes, project plans, and manpower plans for Field Service projects.
* Costing, Pricing \& Resource Mobilization: Compile cost data for project man\-hours, materials, and equipment required for implementation so the Sales team can establish commercial proposals and finalize job pricing. Plan jobs by scheduling and mobilizing personnel, tools, equipment, subcontractors, and goods; issue corresponding internal and external purchase orders and project order entries.
* Onsite Execution \& Supervision: Lead and coordinate EEE field activities at Client sites; manage onsite projects directly or actively support execution as an engineer. Supervise and schedule subcontractor teams for both major and minor projects. Brief all personnel (project managers, service engineers, technical representatives, subcontractors) prior to site work to ensure complete technical, commercial, and safety understanding.
* Outage \& Maintenance Planning: Support the Client with turnaround and maintenance planning; coordinate EEE bids for turnaround projects to ensure total alignment with Client requirements. Coordinate essential pre\-turnaround activities, including spare parts planning, equipment surveys, and logistics.
* Project Controls \& Financial Management: Perform planning, technical detailing, and create work method statements to establish work requirements; manage projects dynamically within planned man\-hours and financial budgets. Track project "extras" (additional working time, materials, etc.), initiate order amendment requests, and handle/log technical and commercial issues (including warranty handling and logging).
* Invoicing, Closure \& Access: Monitor project progress against contractual milestones to execute invoicing on progress payment orders; coordinate in\-process cost tracking, initiate final invoicing upon completion, and assist in the collection of outstanding monies when necessary. De\-brief teams post\-job to establish internal lessons learned, implement/communicate discovered improvements, attend project closeout/lessons learned meetings with customers, and conduct self\-assessments on assignments to improve products, processes, or quality systems. Maintain active, valid gate passes for all sites with an installed EEE fleet to ensure immediate emergency support when required.


**Equipment Condition, Lifecycle Support \& Technical Diagnostics**
* Surveys \& Performance Monitoring: Conduct detailed on\-site surveys and monitor equipment performance to share data\-driven insights on reliability improvements.
* Technical Troubleshooting: Assist with equipment troubleshooting, failure analysis, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and define preventative and corrective actions.
* Strategic Recommendations: Provide professional recommendations on maintenance, repair, spare parts strategies, modifications, and upgrades designed to extend equipment life, improve safety, or maximize efficiency.


**Quality, Safety, Compliance \& Risk Management**
* System \& Safety Alignment: Perform all daily work in strict alignment with company guidelines as defined by the Quality and HSE management systems. Prepare necessary project risk assessments, safety documentation, and specialized rigging studies. Take an active, leading role in ensuring all work is executed safely to prevent injury to personnel or damage to equipment, including preparing and conducting on\-site toolbox talks.
* Quality Control \& Nonconformity Prevention: Establish quality and documentation requirements for projects; initiate immediate action to prevent the occurrence of any nonconformity relating to products, processes, or the quality system.
* Risk \& Liability Management: Perform advanced planning to avoid field delays and protect profit margins. Define problems expeditiously, exercise independent judgment/corrective actions based on trouble severity, resolve the Company’s liability in failure claims, verify the validity of customer claims, and involve upper management as necessary.


**Business Development, Client Relations \& Continuous Improvement**
* Market Intelligence \& Growth: Keep Aftermarket Sales personnel and the Field Service Manager promptly and thoroughly informed on all immediate/future sales potential, performed work, quality trends, and customer reactions. Promote deep customer goodwill through effective communication and cooperation; make targeted courtesy calls to check customer inventories, promote parts sales, inspect new equipment shipments, and sell services in conjunction with Service Sales Engineers.
* Reporting \& Knowledge Sharing: Provide formal post\-project and lessons learned reports; prepare required service reports promptly and completely, noting specific instances with dates and names of connected persons. Benchmark and share industry best practices; facilitate technical seminars and targeted training sessions on EEE products for customer personnel.
* Performance Reviews \& Feedback Loops: Conduct regular performance review meetings and improvement sessions; capture active feedback from Client affiliates on EEE performance to develop continuous improvement initiatives. Contribute new ideas to improve product design, aesthetics, and company service, while actively working to eliminate reoccurring field troubles.
* Data \& System Management: Oversee KPI management and reporting (based on mutually agreed\-upon EEE/Client metrics). Develop, manage, and maintain a comprehensive fleet historical database containing all documentation (Manuals, Reports, Parts lists), as well as a centralized ticketing system to track and record support requests. Provide support to all department activities as directed by Field Service Operations management.


**Education, Domain Expertise \& Aptitudes**
* Degree Requirement: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related technical field (or an equivalent combination of education and hands\-on experience).
* Years of Experience: 5 to 10 years of proven experience in the industry.
* Technical Domain Expertise: Direct experience working with steam turbines, process compressors, steam turbine generators, and auxiliary equipment, including a strong working knowledge of related industry standards. Broad familiarity with EEE product lines as well as rotating machinery manufactured by other OEMs.
* Technical \& Cognitive Aptitudes: Strong thermodynamic aptitude and mechanical aptitude for high\-speed rotating machinery. Functional knowledge of system controls. Proficient in reading, interpreting, and understanding complex technical drawings, blueprints, layouts, and schedules. Proven ability to author highly technical field reports, root cause analyses, and work method statements.


**Commercial, Leadership \& Soft Skills**
* Commercial \& Leadership Capabilities: Expertise handling the contractual, commercial, and administrative aspects of field jobs within an international turbomachinery environment. Strong supervisory skills necessary to direct, schedule, and coordinate diverse teams of 20 to 100 lead engineers, technical representatives, and labor personnel assigned to major site projects. Demonstrated selling and negotiation skills.
* Soft Skills \& Adaptability: Highly organized, self\-motivated, flexible, and resilient when coping with a wide variety of tasks, shifting environments, and complex forms of contract. High level of comfort navigating cultural diversity and strict health and safety (HSE) management systems.
* Communication \& Relationship Management: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a profound, professional command of the English language. Natural ability to nurture strong working relationships with internal and external contacts, backed by proven conflict resolution skills.


**Presentation \& Software Proficiency**
* Presentation Skills: Ability to collect, analyze, and present data in a clear and coherent manner, utilizing appropriate mediums.
* Computer \& Software Systems: Advanced capability utilizing industry\-standard software tools, including Microsoft Office Suite (specifically Excel), Project Management Software (MS Projects, Primavera), and Enterprise Systems/Databases (Oracle, Windchill, Lotus Notes).


**Base Location \& Work Schedule**
 This is a full time permanent position based in Dammam, Saudi Arabia
   

  

**The world turns to Ebara Elliott Energy.**
 Customers throughout the world choose Ebara Elliott Energy for the design, manufacture and service of their critical rotating equipment. EEE’s global service network routinely installs, overhauls, repairs, upgrades and rerates machines from any manufacturer. Customers everywhere turn to EEE for precision engineering, extraordinary reliability and unparalleled service.

data.jd_text:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 As a Service Project Manager at Siemens Energy, you will be at the forefront of driving impactful projects that enhance our global energy solutions. This role targets experienced project managers with a background in electrical engineering, renewable energy, or mechatronics, who are adept at navigating complex challenges and leading diverse teams. Your work will directly contribute to Siemens Energy’s mission of delivering sustainable energy solutions, fostering innovation, and ensuring compliance with quality standards. Expect a collaborative team culture that values diversity, creativity, and continuous improvement, where your leadership will inspire and empower others to achieve shared goals.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Lead cross\-functional teams across various locations, ensuring effective collaboration and accountability for project outcomes.
* Develop and implement structured communication plans to maintain transparency with stakeholders and facilitate milestone tracking.
* Manage the full project lifecycle, from scope definition to closure, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Utilize Siemens Energy tools and digital platforms for data\-driven decision\-making, process optimization, and comprehensive reporting.
* Drive change through coaching and mentoring, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within the team.
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks using procurement plans and responsibility matrices, ensuring project health and compliance.


**What You Bring**
* A Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics, or a related field, with specialization or certification in project management (IPMA\-C or PMP is a plus).
* 5 to 10 years of experience in project management or team leadership, with a proven track record of managing complex projects in a multinational and multicultural environment.
* Strong documentation skills for project reporting, milestone tracking, and stakeholder communication, with familiarity in audit processes and quality gates (QMiP, FAC, etc.).
* Proficiency in project lifecycle management, budgeting, risk analysis, and contract handling using Siemens Energy standards and tools.
* Excellent interpersonal skills for managing relationships, resolving conflicts, and communicating effectively with diverse stakeholders.
* Initiative, adaptability, and ownership in achieving project outcomes under dynamic conditions, with a focus on innovation and analytical thinking.


**About The Team**
 Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.
   

  

**Who is Siemens Energy?**
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With \~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
   

  

 Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150\-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
   

  

 Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens\-energy.com/employeevideo
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity**
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
   

  

**Rewards/Benefits**
* Opportunities to work with a global team
* Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects
* Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens\-Energy platform


 https://jobs.siemens\-energy.com/jobs
   

  

 The job posting will remain open for applications for 14 days from the posting date.

People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant international team.
   

  

 Siemens Digital Industries is a leading innovator in automation and digitalization. Our mission is to support customers in maximizing growth, profit opportunities and ecological footprint in the discrete and process industries. Ready to create your own journey?
   

  

 Join our Digital Industry as Senior Project Manager and help us transform the everyday by finding solutions and making the world a more inquisitive place for tomorrow.

data.jd_text:
We are partnering with a frozen food manufacturer in Saudi Arabia to appoint an Operations Director (Head of Factory).
   

  

****Role Purpose****
 The Operations Director holds full strategic and operational accountability for the manufacturing facility. This is a senior leadership role responsible for shaping and executing the plant's operational strategy, building a high\-performing organization, and delivering against ambitious targets for output, quality, cost, and safety.
   

  

 The successful candidate will set the operational agenda, modernize and scale the facility, and embed a culture of excellence that positions the plant as a benchmark in the frozen food sector.
   

  

****Strategic Leadership****
* Define and execute the operational strategy for the facility, aligned with the company's growth ambitions and commercial plans.
* Lead the transformation and modernization of the plant, including capacity expansion, automation, and capital investment planning.
* Translate business objectives into clear operational targets and a roadmap that the wider operations team can deliver against.
* Serve as a key member of the senior leadership team, contributing to overall business direction and decision\-making.


****Operational Excellence****
* Drive operational excellence across the facility through lean manufacturing, Six Sigma, and structured continuous improvement programs.
* Improve key metrics including OEE, yield, throughput, labor productivity, and waste reduction, with sustained year\-on\-year gains.
* Establish robust planning and scheduling disciplines that ensure on\-time, in\-full delivery against demand.
* Lead root\-cause problem solving and a culture of data\-driven decision making across all shifts and functions.


****Production \& Facility Management****
* Own the full production operation, from raw material intake through processing, freezing, packing, and dispatch.
* Ensure the reliability and performance of all plant assets, including cold\-chain, freezing, and refrigeration infrastructure, through proactive and preventive maintenance.
* Oversee facility management, utilities, and capital projects to keep the plant running safely and efficiently at all times.


****Quality \& Food Safety****
* Ensure full compliance with all food safety, quality, and regulatory standards, including SFDA, HACCP, ISO 22000, GMP, and customer\-specific requirements.
* Maintain audit readiness at all times and uphold the highest standards of hygiene, traceability, and product integrity.
* Build quality and food safety into the culture of the plant, not just the systems.


****People \& Organization****
* Lead, develop, and inspire a large multi\-disciplinary workforce across production, quality, engineering, and supply chain.
* Build organizational capability through hiring, succession planning, training, and performance management.
* Foster a culture of safety, accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement at every level.


****Financial \& Commercial****
* Own the facility's operating budget and capital plan, with full P\&L accountability for the cost of operations.
* Drive cost optimization across labor, materials, energy, and overhead without compromising quality or safety.
* Partner closely with commercial, supply chain, and procurement teams to align production with sales, inventory, and service targets.


****Candidate Profile****
* 15\+ years in food manufacturing operations, with significant experience in frozen, chilled, or processed food production.
* Proven track record at Operations Director, Plant Director, or Head of Factory level, leading a full facility at scale.
* Demonstrated success delivering operational excellence, plant transformation, and measurable improvements in cost, efficiency, and quality.
* Deep expertise in food safety and quality systems, with hands\-on command of SFDA, HACCP, ISO 22000, and GMP.
* Strong engineering, maintenance, and capital project experience, including cold\-chain and freezing infrastructure.
* Experience operating within Saudi Arabia, including familiarity with local regulatory requirements, Saudization, and large\-workforce management.
* Engineering, food technology, or operations management degree; postgraduate qualification or lean/Six Sigma certification preferred.
* Exceptional leadership presence, commercial judgment, and the ability to build and lead high\-performing teams.


****Key Competencies****
* Strategic and operational leadership
* Operational excellence and continuous improvement
* Food safety and quality governance
* Financial and commercial acumen
* People leadership and organizational development
* Results orientation and accountability

data.jd_text:
Assystem is an international company with one mission: accelerate the energy transition around the world.
   

  

  

  

 Every day, our 6,500 switchers located in 12 countries (Europe, Middle East, Pacific Asia \& Africa) connect their six thousand billion neurons to tackle the task of the century: switching to low\-carbon energy.
   

  

  

  

 We are a collective committed to the actors who are making the energy switch. Sharing our knowledge, expertise and values allows us to innovate and think differently about the energy transition.
   

  

  

  

 Drawing on more than 55 years' experience in highly regulated sectors subject to strict security and safety requirements, we provide our customers with engineering and project management services, as well as digital services and solutions to optimize the performance of complex infrastructure projects throughout their life cycle. The Group is currently ranked second in the world for nuclear engineering.
   

  

  

  

 To ensure a viable, efficient, and reliable energy future for all
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**
* **Project Leadership:** 
 Lead and monitor multi\-disciplinary engineering design teams throughout the project lifecycle to ensure seamless delivery of comprehensive engineering packages.
* **Scope \& Schedule Management:** 
 Define project scope, develop detailed delivery schedules, and monitor progress against critical paths to proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks.
* **Financial Control:** 
 Manage project financial performance, including budgeting, cost estimation, forecasting, and tracking cash flow against milestones.
* **Stakeholder Relations:** 
 Act as the primary focal point for clients, subcontractors, and regulatory authorities, leading regular design reviews and managing change orders effectively.
* **Risk Mitigation:** 
 Identify technical and commercial risks early in the design cycle and execute proactive strategies to protect project timelines and margins.
* **HSEQ Compliance:** 
 Ensure all engineering designs and project delivery methods strictly adhere to Health, Safety, Environment, and Quality guidelines.


**Qualifications**
* **Experience:** 
 A minimum of
 **5 years of dedicated experience** 
 in engineering project management or design management, preferably within an engineering consultancy, infrastructure, or complex energy sector environment.
* **Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or a related discipline) from an accredited university.
* **Professional Registrations:** 
 Mandatory membership/registration with the Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE). A Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification is highly desirable.
* **Technical Expertise:** 
 Strong understanding of standard multi\-disciplinary engineering design workflows, technical documentation cycles, and modern digital engineering platforms (e.g., BIM or CAD systems).
* **Skills \& Competencies:** 
 Exceptional leadership, stakeholder negotiation, and conflict resolution capabilities, with a proven track record of managing diverse, multi\-cultural engineering teams.
* **Languages:** 
 Fluent in written and spoken English. Professional proficiency in Arabic is considered a significant asset.


**Additional Information**

 We are committed to equal treatment of candidates and promote, as well as foster all forms of diversity within our company. We believe that bringing together people with different backgrounds and perspectives is essential for creating innovative and impactful solutions. Skills, talent, and our people’s ability to dare are the only things that matter !. Bring your unique contributions and help us shape the future.

data.jd_text:
We are partnering with an established Saudi food manufacturer with its own brand in the market to recruit a
 ****National Sales Manager****
 .
   

  

 The business produces and markets branded food products, including meat and frozen food lines, selling across general trade, modern trade, and food service channels throughout the Kingdom and the wider GCC. It goes to market through sponsored companies, agency representatives, distributors, and a direct sales team.
   

  

 This opportunity is designed for a national sales leader who will own field sales delivery across the Kingdom, lead regional and channel teams and distributor partners, and drive national sales targets. The role reports to the Sales \& Marketing Director.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The National Sales Manager is responsible for the overall management and performance of the company's sales operation across Saudi Arabia and other GCC markets, including sales delivered through sponsored companies, agency representatives, distributors, and the direct sales team. Reporting to the Sales \& Marketing Director, the role ensures the implementation of commercially viable sales plans and marketing strategies that maximise returns and deliver customer service excellence. The single most important measure of success in this role is the consistent, profitable achievement of national sales targets.
   

  

 The National Sales Manager leads regional and channel sales teams, manages relationships with distributors, agencies, and key accounts, and works in close coordination with Marketing, Operations, Production, supply chain, and Finance to align sales plans with stock availability, order fulfilment, and collections.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
****National sales leadership****
* Supervise, direct, and control sales activities across general trade, modern trade, and food service in Saudi Arabia and other GCC markets, delivered through sponsored companies, agency representatives, distributors, and the direct sales team, ensuring attainment of planned sales targets
* Translate the commercial strategy set by the Sales \& Marketing Director into national, regional, and channel sales plans, targets, and route\-to\-market coverage
* Approve sales plans across product lines and monitor implementation and overall national sales performance
* Drive numeric and weighted distribution, product availability, and visibility across regions and channels
* Continuously track sales results against target, analyse variances, and take timely corrective action


****Planning, policies, and budgets****
* Develop sales work policies, procedures, plans, business budgets, and performance standards in cooperation with distributors, agency representatives, and the Marketing function, for approval by the Director
* Set and communicate KPIs for regional and channel teams, aligned to the national sales plan
* Review and assess the outcomes of market research and promotional campaigns to build effective sales plans and targets inside and outside the Kingdom


****Distributor, agency, and key\-account management****
* Build and manage relationships with sponsored companies, agency representatives, and distributors to ensure coverage, availability, and market penetration
* Negotiate trading terms, targets, and joint business plans with distributors and key retail accounts
* Maintain strong relationships with high\-end and modern\-trade retailers, category managers, and store managers
* Conduct regular market visits to assess product performance and competitor activity at point of sale


****Coordination and operations****
* Liaise on confirmed sales orders, shipping of sold products, stock availability, purchase orders, customer service, and billing
* Coordinate with Finance on collection of payments, billing of key customer accounts, credit control, and the opening of letters of credit to suppliers as required
* Liaise with suppliers, manufacturers, and government agencies on relevant matters and escalate important issues in good time
* Coordinate with supply chain and warehouses to ensure timely, accurate order fulfilment and avoid out\-of\-stock situations


****Reporting and analysis****
* Present periodic sales progress reports to the Sales \& Marketing Director with detailed analysis and recommendations for improvement
* Provide insight on market trends, competitor activity, pricing, and new business opportunities to support decision\-making


****Team leadership****
* Recruit, train, appraise, and motivate a competent national sales team
* Set priorities, assign territories and tasks, and uphold company standards and good conduct
* Build a culture of teamwork, accountability, and customer focus
* Conduct work\-related special assignments as required by the Director


****Authority and Decision\-Making****
* Operates within the company Authority Matrix
* Approves sales plans and monitors sales performance across product lines and regions
* Recommends trading terms and pricing within delegated limits, and credit decisions in line with policy
* Sets priorities and assigns territories and tasks across the sales team
* Conducts performance appraisals and leads recruitment, training, and development of sales staff


**Qualifications And Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Management, Marketing, or a related field; a postgraduate qualification is an advantage
* Eight or more years of experience in FMCG sales, including several years in a national or multi\-region sales management role; experience in meat processing or frozen food is strongly preferred
* Proven track record of managing distributors, agencies, and key accounts, and delivering national sales targets across general and modern trade
* Demonstrable track record in sales, business development, or account management with high\-end and modern\-trade retailers
* Professional certifications such as CBDM, PCM, or CSCP are an advantage
* Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and core tools for sales operations
* Fluency in written and spoken Arabic and English
* Strong leadership, decision\-making, multitasking, and team\-building skills, with a self\-motivated, disciplined, well\-organised, and adaptable personality and the ability to build rapport at all levels
* Willingness to travel across the Kingdom and the wider GCC as required

 : Manages, plans, directs, and coordinates all activities at the main Exchange branches and locations.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
 Broad managerial duties include, but are not limited to, the following:
   

  

* Directs and coordinates all phases of Exchange activities and associates efforts toward maximum responsiveness to the Navy Exchange Program mission and requirements.
* Makes periodic and frequent inspections of all activities and outlets, identifying areas of deficiency. Directs the correction of deficiencies and follows up to ensure that prompt and proper corrective action has been taken.
* Ensures maximum and full utilization of all facilities, equipment, cash, and associates.
* Assures compliance by all associates with requirements prescribed in departmental, Command, and NEXCOM directives and operating instructions for a high standard of operational performance and customer service.
* Responsible for achieving sales and profit objectives of the NEXCOM business strategy, basic policies, and programs. Reviews and analyzes operational reports to ensure that goals set for each operational department are achieved; initiates corrective action when goals are not met.
* Supervises operations through subordinate supervisory staff. Approves leave and vacation; enforces work rules, establishes internal operating policies and procedures, and initiates programs or projects to serve mission needs. Ensures that a continuing program of training in all areas is carried out. Interviews and selects associates, completes performance appraisals. Reviews proposed disciplinary actions and resolves grievances and complaints.
* Ensures through subordinate staff, receipt, price marking, storage, custody, and proper administration and documentation under the various control procedures applicable to the receipt of merchandise.
* Ensures that a maintenance and repair program is in effect for all equipment and facilities to keep all Exchange facilities in excellent condition.
* Ensures, through subordinate supervisors, the development of an Exchange Facility Master Plan showing a five\-year projection of projects to achieve facility objectives and encompass the preliminary development of capital expenditure projects. Prepares projects for final approval, supervises their execution, and, when required, evaluates the results.
* Ensures, through subordinate managers, the implementation, administration, and coordination of all phases of the Exchange Security, Safety, and Fire Protection/Prevention Programs.
* Responsible, through subordinate managers, for the custody, protection, and accountability of Exchange property and funds.
* Participates and encourages participation in local community activities to reflect the best interests of the Navy Exchange Program.
* Ensures that an effective sales promotion program, provided by NEXCOM, is implemented to generate increased sales and traffic.
* Reports directly to the Commanding Officer, who provides broad general direction. Recommendations, comments, and resolutions are reviewed for adherence to established policies and to ensure that objectives are met. Work performance is reviewed and evaluated based on overall results in meeting planned objectives and improvements in the Exchange's operating results.
* Requires Secret (S) Security Clearance.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.


**Training Requirement**
 Associates must receive hazardous material (HazMat) training within 90 days of hire per Department of Transportation regulations.
   

  

 The incumbent of this position must file a Financial Disclosure Report (OGE) Form 450, as required.
   

  

 Requires a total of seven years of experience as indicated below:
   

  

**GENERAL EXPERIENCE:** 
 Three years of administrative, operational, merchandising, and management skills/experience or other responsible work which enabled the applicant to gain knowledge of management practices and administrative processes; skill in dealing with others in person\-to\-person work relationships; and the ability to exercise mature judgment.
   

  

 OR
 **SUBSTITUTION OF EDUCATION FOR EXPERIENCE** 
 : 1 year of academic study above the high school level may be substituted for 9 months of experience, up to a maximum of a 4\-year bachelors degree for 3 years of general experience.
   

  

**AND SPECIALIZED EXPERIENCE:** 
 Four years of progressively responsible store operational management experience which demonstrated an understanding of the needs, problems and solutions in administering management programs relating to most of the following: merchandising, accounting, personnel, facility maintenance, distribution and general administration; and experience in planning, directing and/or coordinating merchandising activities; and supervisory experience in human resources; or similar work which demonstrated the knowledge and ability to provide support in managing a retailing organization.
   

  

 NOTE: Specialized experience must include four years of progressively responsible experience as a Branch Exchange Manager, General Manager in\-training, Store Manager, District Operations Specialist, and/or General Manager.

 Bahrain\-Bahrain\-Bahrain

 Bahrain
   

  

**Job**
 Store Management
   

  

**Schedule**
 Full\-Time (35 \+ hours)

Head of Engineering: Options
   

  

**About Keyrock**
 Since our beginnings in 2017, we've grown to be a leading change\-maker in the digital asset space, renowned for our partnerships and innovation.
   

  

 Today, we rock with over 200 team members around the world. Our diverse team hails from 42 nationalities, with backgrounds ranging from DeFi natives to PhDs. Predominantly remote, we have hubs in London, Madrid, Brussels, Singapore , New York and Paris, and host regular online and offline hangouts to keep the crew tight.
   

  

 We are trading on more than 80 exchanges, and working with a wide array of asset issuers. As a well\-established market maker, our distinctive expertise led us to expand rapidly. Today, our services span market making, options trading, high\-frequency trading, OTC, and DeFi trading desks as well as asset and wealth management. Keyrock is looking to expand and establish itself as a full\-service capital markets and asset \& wealth management financial institution through both organic innovation and inorganic growth.
   

  

 But we’re more than a service provider. We’re an initiator. We have been pioneers in adopting the Rust Development language for our algorithmic trading systems, and champions of its use in the industry. We upgrade Web3 ecosystems by injecting liquidity into promising DeFi, RWA, and NFT protocols. And we push the industry's progress with our research and governance initiatives.
   

  

 At Keyrock, we're not just envisioning the future of digital assets. We're actively building it.
   

  

**Mission statement**
 We are looking for a
 **Head of Engineering / Engineering Lead** 
 with strong experience in
 **systematic options trading** 
 to lead our Options Engineering team.
   

  

 In this role, you will be responsible for leading the Options Engineering team, driving continuous improvement across the trading infrastructure, and supporting the evolution of our systematic options trading platform. This includes areas such as automated quoting, execution, risk controls, pricing workflows, and production reliability.
   

  

 We are primarily looking for candidates based in
 **European time zones** 
 or the
 **US East Coast time zone** 
 .
   

  

**We are looking for someone who can:**
* Lead and grow an Options Engineering team of around 7 engineers
* Bring hands\-on experience in systematic options trading, ideally including options market\-making, automated quoting, execution, and risk management
* Own and evolve an existing Rust\-native systematic options trading platform
* Provide strong technical direction across trading infrastructure, system design, performance, reliability, and risk controls
* Work pragmatically through complex engineering and trading\-system challenges
* Partner closely with trading, quant, product, risk, and infrastructure stakeholders
* Balance technical leadership with people leadership, delivery ownership, and operational discipline


**Required Experience**
* 7\+ years of experience in systematic trading, options market\-making or low\-latency trading systems
* Strong hands\-on experience with Rust, C\+\+, or C
* Willingness to become deeply proficient in Rust, if not already
* Strong understanding of algorithmic options trading, including automated quoting, execution, pricing, risk controls, and market data workflows
* Experience building or maintaining low\-latency trading systems, ideally within options or derivatives markets
* Experience working with SQL databases in production environments, with PostgreSQL preferred
* Familiarity with functional testing, component testing, and production\-grade validation practices
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, service boundaries, and production reliability
* Strong knowledge of gRPC and experience working with Node.js\-based services is preferred
* Previous experience with crypto exchange connectivity and/or FPGA technologies is strongly preferred


**Leadership \& Working Style**
* Strong team player with the ability to lead, mentor, and guide engineers
* Pragmatic approach to problem\-solving, system design, and implementation
* Able to balance latency, reliability, safety, complexity, and delivery speed
* Comfortable making technical decisions under uncertainty
* Demonstrates outside\-the\-box thinking while staying grounded in practical delivery
* Communicates clearly and effectively, especially in unfamiliar or ambiguous contexts where clarity is critical
* Able to work closely with traders, quants, risk, product, and infrastructure stakeholders
* Strong ownership mindset, especially for production trading systems


**Our recruitment philosophy**
 We value self\-awareness and powerful communication skills in our recruitment process. We seek fiercely passionate people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, acts with ownership and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.
   

  

**Our offer**
* A competitive salary package
* Autonomy in your time management thanks to flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely
* The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence


 As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.
   

  

 Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

**Company Description**
 Mantis is a leading, conservation\-focused hotel group with eco\-lodges, waterways, and curated eco\-resorts located all over the world. Sustainable travellers have been enjoying eco\-tourism, safaris, and adventure travel with Mantis since 2000\. Rooted in conservation, Mantis pursues sustainable business practices and develops tourism products that are respectful of the environment and communities in which they operate. Whether small and intimate or vast and complex, on a sweeping African plain, beach\-side escap,e or bustling city, each is an exceptional place for guests to find themselves. While uniquely different in the experiences they offer, all are linked through a collective obsession to be extraordinary, to be rare in a world that mass\-produces sameness.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Hawar Resort by Mantis is seeking an experienced and dynamic Culinary Director to lead and oversee all culinary operations across the resort. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining the highest standards of food quality, consistency, innovation, guest satisfaction, and operational excellence across all dining venues. The Culinary Director will play a key role in menu development, talent management, cost control, and culinary innovation while ensuring that all food offerings align with the resort's luxury positioning and guest expectations.
   

  

**What Is In It For You**
* Unleash the excitement: enticing rewards and unbeatable benefits are waiting for you!
* Ignite your skills with our cutting\-edge Academies for rapid professional growth.
* Cultivate your talents and watch your career flourish, locally and globally.
* Drive change through impactful Corporate Social Responsibility activities.
* Immerse yourself in a vibrant work environment with extraordinary colleagues.
* Join us on a direct path to success as we skyrocket to new heights!


**Key Responsibilities**
* Oversee all culinary operations across the resort, ensuring alignment with brand standards and operational excellence.
* Lead the development and execution of authentic Italian cuisine concepts, menus, and dining experiences.
* Ensure consistency and the highest standards in food quality, taste, presentation, and temperature across all kitchens.
* Drive innovation in menus, concepts, and food presentation to enhance guest experience and market positioning.
* Collaborate with Marketing and F\&B leadership to develop promotions, campaigns, and destination dining experiences.
* Maintain and improve kitchen operations to maximize profitability while ensuring high guest satisfaction.
* Ensure effective communication and alignment across all culinary teams.
* Monitor and manage stock levels, purchasing, receiving, and storage to meet company standards and control costs.
* Ensure all goods purchased comply with hotel specifications and quality standards.
* Lead and develop culinary teams through training, coaching, succession planning, and performance management.
* Ensure compliance with HACCP guidelines, hygiene standards, and food safety regulations.
* Promote best practices in kitchen operations, cleanliness, and grooming standards.
* Build strong cross\-functional relationships with F\&B, Operations, Sales \& Marketing, and other departments.
* Identify opportunities for efficiency improvements, cost optimization, and operational excellence.
* Stay updated on culinary trends, particularly within Italian and Mediterranean cuisine, and implement relevant innovations.
* Lead by example, fostering a positive, engaged, and high\-performing team culture.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in culinary arts, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
* Professional Culinary Certification from an accredited institution.
* Minimum 10 years of professional culinary experience, including at least 3 years in a senior culinary leadership role.
* Strong expertise in Italian cuisine, including menu development, authentic preparation methods, and modern Italian dining trends.
* Previous experience in luxury hotels, resorts, or high\-end standalone restaurants.
* Proven track record in menu engineering, food cost control, and operational management.
* Experience managing large culinary teams in a high\-volume environment.
* Strong understanding of international cuisines and dietary requirements.
* Excellent leadership, communication, coaching, and organizational skills.
* Knowledge of kitchen management systems, inventory controls, and purchasing procedures.
* Advanced knowledge of food safety standards and HACCP requirements.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, multicultural environment.
* Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience opening or repositioning Italian restaurants within luxury hospitality environments.
* Experience working in island resorts, destination resorts, or luxury lifestyle hospitality brands.
* Strong network within the international culinary community and awareness of emerging food trends.


 Additional Information
   

  

**Our commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion:** 
 We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.
   

  

**Why work for Accor?** 
 We are far more than a worldwide leader. We welcome you as you are and you can find a job and brand that matches your personality. We support you to grow and learn every day, making sure that work brings purpose to your life, so that during your journey with us, you can continue to explore Accor’s limitless possibilities.
   

  

 By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality. Discover the life that awaits you at Accor, visit https://careers.accor.com/
   

  

**About Mantis Collection:** 
 Mantis is a boutique hospitality group that was founded by conservationist Adrian Gardiner in 2000, with its main focus predominantly in Africa and the Middle East. Mantis grew from Adrian’s vision to restore and rewild degraded farmland which he developed into a widely\-acclaimed Private Game Reserve. This was the first private game reserve in the Eastern Cape and the beginning of eco\-tourism in a poverty\-stricken province that had few opportunities outside of commercial farming. Adrian and the Mantis team successfully created a place where man and nature could co\-exist sustainably. From this initial success, the Mantis model was then developed worldwide, understanding that consumers could use the Mantis portfolio as a mark of quality, consistency and character. Today the diverse portfolio of handpicked properties links up to create travel journeys, which offer guests the opportunity to experience the essence of the location in a setting of tailored luxury. Rooted in conservation, Mantis pursues sustainable business practices and develops tourism products that are respectful of the environment and communities in which they operate.
