data.jd_text:
Description synthétique du poste
   

  

 Sous la responsabilité du Conseil d'administration (CA) de l’Alliance Française (AF) de Manama, et sous l'autorité du conseiller de coopération et d'action culturelle (COCAC), vous êtes responsable de l’exécution du projet d’établissement, du bon fonctionnement et du développement de l’Alliance ainsi que du suivi de l’ensemble des actions qui y sont menées, en conformité avec les lois locales. Trois mois suivant votre prise de fonction vous vous verrez remettre votre lettre de mission cosignée par la Direction générale de la Mondialisation, le président de l'Alliance et la Fondation des Alliances Françaises. Au plus tard six mois après votre prise de fonction, vous devrez présenter un projet d'établissement et un plan d'action soumis à l‘approbation du conseil d’administration et visé par l'ambassade, qui couvrira la durée de votre mission.
   

  

 Activités principales
   

  

 L'Alliance Française de Manama accueille 500 à 600 élèves différents par année. L'Alliance est propriétaire de ses locaux, toutefois le foncier demeure la propriété du Ministère bahreïnien des Finances. Elle possède 7 salles de classe équipées en TBI. L’ensemble du parc informatique a été renouvelé, avec connexion internet en fibre optique et 5G. L'AF assure aussi des cours hors de ses locaux (Écoles internationales, dont le Lycée français, Ministères, Universités, personnalités VIP) et cherche à développer les cours hors les murs. Et dispose d'un auditorium de 120 places. Dans ce cadre, vous êtes responsable des missions suivantes: Élaboration, proposition et impulsion de la stratégie de l'établissement ; Mise en place des priorités linguistiques et culturelles définies par l'Ambassade, par la Fondation Alliance française, sous l'autorité du CA de l’AF, de l'Ambassadeur et du COCAC ; Élaboration du budget de l'établissement, gestion du personnel, mise en place d'outils d'analyse et de suivi ; Etablissement d'étroites relations avec les professionnels de la culture et les autorités du pays d'affectation ; Représentation de l'Alliance Française en justice et dans tous les actes de la vie civile ; Compte rendu des réalisations et du contexte au Conseiller culturel, à l'Ambassadeur, à la Fondation et à la Direction Générale de la Mondialisation (DGM) du Ministère de l'Europe et des affaires étrangères (MEAE).
   

  

 Diplômes ou expérience professionnelle recommandée pour exercer les fonctions
   

  

 Master 2 ou niveau équivalent Expérience d’un milieu associatif et de sa gouvernance (relation CA) Compétences en communication et marketing Expérience avérée en management d’une équipe, direction d’un établissement Expérience de levée de fonds et/ou de mécénats Bonne connaissance du CECR, de la pédagogie par projet et de l’approche actionnelle La connaissance ou la maîtrise d’une langue locale, constituerait un atout. La connaissance de la région également.

**Job Purpose**
 The Projects Manager will execute fast\-track fit\-out projects for retail stores, F\&B outlets, hotels, and commercial offices. Working independently, he/she will be responsible for the overall planning, coordination, and management of multiple projects by leading multi\-disciplinary teams including subcontractors through project activities to meet client requirements and complete projects successfully, safely, within quality, within budget and on\-time.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Areas**
 The PM oversees the overall management of projects and client servicing on behalf of the Company, encompassing the following functions:
   

  

**1\-Project Management**
* Review tender programmes and convert them into construction programmes, including defining the client’s direct procurement requirements and client meetings calendar
* Specify project objectives and plans including site set\-up, planning and logistics. Delineation of scope, budgeting, scheduling, setting performance requirements, selection of project sub\-contractors and allocating internal resources (e.g., QA/QC, Health and Safety and MEP Management)
* Set targets for procurement packages and vet sub\-contractors’ tenders
* Decide on purchasing requirements (whether within or outside subcontractors’ remit)
* Ensure projects teams have sufficient resources, equipment, and labour. Plan into order to meet the project timescales and quality requirements
* Attend all site meetings with client and/or consultants as Company representative
* Approve interim payments for subcontractors and their final accounts
* Approve the Company’s interim valuations before submission to our client/consultant
* Liaise and cooperate with in\-house departments such as joinery manufacturing in Bahrain
* Maximise resource efficiency (e.g., labour, materials, and equipment)


**2\-Performance Management**
* Oversee the construction sites and associated site teams, and the management of vendors and trade subcontractors
* Maintain accurate records of construction progress across all projects and report to senior management on a weekly basis
* Ensure good communication between the Company and clients at all times
* Be responsible for health and safety on all sites under his management
* Ensure workers follow Company procedures
* Manage the rectification process on\-time and on\-budget
* Compile and submit Operations and Maintenance (O\&M) manuals to the clients upon project completion
* Manage close out procedure for all projects in accordance with contractual obligations and to high quality standards thereby compelling clients to give a positive review or testimonial


**Candidate Requirements**
* The Projects Manager (PM) should have worked with reputable fit\-out contracting companies in the Middle East for at least 7\-8 years
* Minimum of 10 years’ total work experience in the same field
* Very strong technical, execution and commercial abilities with sound knowledge of the woodworking business particularly the technical aspects relating to joinery and good manufacturing practices of timber, veneers, hardware, etc
* Proven track record as a successful leader at senior management level within the fit\-out industry
* A very good knowledge of latest developments in the fit\-out market. The candidate should be well\-versed with the current trends and news influencing market and be able to suggest ideas to boost the Company’s industry presence and build our brand
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills and the ability to work successfully in a multinational market environment

Engineering Lead: Options
   

  

**About Keyrock**
 Since our beginnings in 2017, we've grown to be a leading change\-maker in the digital asset space, renowned for our partnerships and innovation.
   

  

 Today, we rock with over 200 team members around the world. Our diverse team hails from 42 nationalities, with backgrounds ranging from DeFi natives to PhDs. Predominantly remote, we have hubs in London, Madrid, Brussels, Singapore , New York and Paris, and host regular online and offline hangouts to keep the crew tight.
   

  

 We are trading on more than 80 exchanges, and working with a wide array of asset issuers. As a well\-established market maker, our distinctive expertise led us to expand rapidly. Today, our services span market making, options trading, high\-frequency trading, OTC, and DeFi trading desks as well as asset and wealth management. Keyrock is looking to expand and establish itself as a full\-service capital markets and asset \& wealth management financial institution through both organic innovation and inorganic growth.
   

  

 But we’re more than a service provider. We’re an initiator. We have been pioneers in adopting the Rust Development language for our algorithmic trading systems, and champions of its use in the industry. We upgrade Web3 ecosystems by injecting liquidity into promising DeFi, RWA, and NFT protocols. And we push the industry's progress with our research and governance initiatives.
   

  

 At Keyrock, we're not just envisioning the future of digital assets. We're actively building it.

 We are looking for a
 **Head of Engineering / Engineering Lead** 
 with strong experience in
 **systematic options trading** 
 to lead our Options Engineering team.
   

  

 In this role, you will be responsible for leading the Options Engineering team, driving continuous improvement across the trading infrastructure, and supporting the evolution of our systematic options trading platform. This includes areas such as automated quoting, execution, risk controls, pricing workflows, and production reliability.
   

  

 We are primarily looking for candidates based in
 **European time zones** 
 or the
 **US East Coast time zone** 
 .
   

  

**We are looking for someone who can:**
* Lead and grow an Options Engineering team of around 7 engineers

**Required Experience**

**Leadership \& Working Style**

* Pragmatic approach to problem\-solving, system design, and implementation

* Able to work closely with traders, quants, risk, product, and infrastructure stakeholders

**Our recruitment philosophy**
 We value self\-awareness and powerful communication skills in our recruitment process. We seek fiercely passionate people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, acts with ownership and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.
   

  

**Our offer**
* A competitive salary package
* Autonomy in your time management thanks to flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely

 As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.
   

  

 Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

**About The Role**
 This role will be part of Zain Bahrain's Subsidiary Fintech Company \- "Bede"
   

  

 Bede, the fintech arm of Zain Bahrain, is a dynamic startup revolutionizing personal finance through Bahrain’s first Shariah\-compliant Islamic financing app. Licensed and regulated by the Central Bank of Bahrain, Bede is committed to creating an inclusive platform that offers practical solutions tailored to real customer needs.
   

  

 With a focus on customer centricity, strategic partnerships, and digital innovation, Bede aims to guide individuals toward growth and success by leveling the playing field for all. Bede
   

  

 The Finance Manager will be overall responsible for the strategic planning, implementation, management, and running of all finance activities for Bede, including business planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and financial operations, as well as providing commercial insight and recommendations across the business to achieve business plan targets. The role covers Bede’s full product portfolio — including microfinance, credit cards, remittances, and future products such as insurance, investment, and wallet services — reporting jointly to the Bede CEO and the Zain Bahrain CFO.
   

  

 The role is accountable for sound financial management, regulatory compliance with Central Bank of Bahrain requirements, and providing data\-driven insight to support business decision\-making. Working closely with Business, Technology, and Operations teams, the Finance Manager will evaluate product\-level financial performance, optimize costs, assess technology and app investment opportunities, and support the growth of Bede’s finance function as the business scales.
   

  

 What We Need From You
   

  

* BSc/BA in Accounting, Finance, or a relevant field; a professional accounting qualification (CA, CPA, ACCA, or CMA) is required.
* 6\+ years of progressive experience in finance, financial planning \& analysis, or a related field, ideally within fintech, banking, or financial services.
* Proven track record in budgeting, financial performance review, and cost management within a fast\-paced or growth\-stage business.
* Experience working with or alongside product teams to assess financial viability of new products or features is a strong advantage.
* Central Bank of Bahrain (CBB) regulatory reporting experience and exposure to ERP system integrations are strong advantages.


**Responsibilities**
* Financial Management \& Controls
* Manage all financial aspects of Bede, including budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, and reporting.
* Develop and implement financial policies, procedures, and controls to ensure proper financial management and compliance with regulatory requirements.
* Lead the annual and monthly budgeting process, working with the Director of Business and product/function leads to build realistic, achievable financial plans.
* Conduct regular business performance reviews, tracking actual results against budget across all products and functions, and reporting variances with clear commentary.
* Strategic Planning \& Commercial Insight
* Collaborate with the senior management team to develop and implement Bede’s financial strategies and long\-term financial plans.
* Provide financial insights and recommendations to support business decision\-making and drive the company’s growth and profitability.
* Provide financial forecasts and scenario analysis to support strategic decision\-making by the CEO and Zain Bahrain CFO.
* Product\-Level Financial Oversight
* Own the financial analysis and performance tracking of Bede’s product portfolio, including current products \- micro finance, credit cards, and remittances \- and future products as they launch, including insurance, investment options, wallet services, and other financial products.
* Build and maintain product\-level financial models to assess profitability, cost\-to\-serve, and revenue contribution for each product line.
* Work with the Director of Business and product teams to evaluate the financial viability of new product launches and enhancements before go\-to\-market.
* Regulatory Compliance
* Ensure compliance with all relevant laws, regulations, and guidelines set by the Central Bank of Bahrain.
* Stay updated on regulatory changes and communicate updates to the management team.
* Prepare and submit financial reports and statements to regulatory authorities as required.
* Financial Reporting
* Oversee the preparation and presentation of accurate and timely financial reports, including income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and other financial performance indicators.
* Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports for the Bede CEO and Zain Bahrain CFO, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and timeliness.
* Provide financial analysis and insights to support management decision\-making.
* Risk Management
* Identify and analyze financial risks and implement appropriate risk mitigation strategies.
* Develop and monitor key financial metrics and indicators to assess the company’s financial health and identify potential risks and opportunities.
* Expense Optimization \& Technology Investment Evaluation
* Review and analyze Bede’s operating expenses on an ongoing basis, identifying opportunities for cost optimization without compromising business growth or customer experience.
* Assess the financial business case for Bede app technology investments, including new features, infrastructure upgrades, and platform enhancements, with clear ROI tracking post\-implementation.
* Partner with department heads to instill financial discipline and ensure spending remains aligned with approved budgets.
* Data Analysis \& Financial Insight
* Use data analysis to identify trends, risks, and opportunities across Bede’s financial and operational performance.
* Develop financial dashboards and reporting tools that give management clear, timely visibility into business performance.
* Translate complex financial data into clear, actionable insights for non\-financial stakeholders across the business.
* Team Leadership
* Lead and manage the finance team as it is built out over time, including hiring, training, performance management, and professional development.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement within the finance function.
* Stakeholder Management
* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including the Central Bank of Bahrain, internal and external auditors, tax authorities, and other regulatory bodies.
* Act as the primary financial point of contact between Bede and the Zain Bahrain CFO’s office, ensuring alignment on reporting standards and financial governance.
* Represent the company in financial matters and participate in industry forums and events as required.


 Equal Employment Opportunity Statement
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including persons with disabilities and those who may require reasonable accommodations to perform their duties. We are committed to maintaining an inclusive workplace and to ensuring that all employees are supported to succeed.
   

  

**About Application Process**

* Resume/CV
* Passport\-size photograph
* Highest Education Qualification

data.jd_text:
Position: Director of Institute of Private Training
   

  

 Classification: Senior Administrative and Academic Leadership\- Director Level
   

  

 Reports To: VP for university engagements
   

  

**About The American International University**
 American International University (AIU) is a private institution in Kuwait, founded in 2019, offering undergraduate programs based on the American model of higher education. AIU provides degrees in Engineering, Architecture and Design, Business Administration, Arts and Sciences, and Education, with English as the language of instruction. The University is committed to fostering intellectual, cultural, and personal growth, preparing graduates for leadership roles in a global society.
   

  

 AIU is executing its RISE Strategy 2026–2030, a five\-year institutional transformation encompassing research development, international institutional accreditation, student success, and community engagement. A central strategic objective is establishing AIU's presence in international university rankings and benchmarking its performance against regional and global peers. The Director of Global Excellence and Benchmarking leads this agenda.
   

  

 For more information, visit: www.aiu.edu.kw
   

  

 Department Profile
   

  

 The Institute for Private Training (IPT) is responsible for designing, developing, and delivering executive education, professional development, customized corporate training, consultancy services, and workforce development programmes. IPT collaborates with government entities, private sector organizations, international institutions, and professional associations to deliver high\-quality learning solutions that address national priorities and industry needs.
   

  

 The Institute plays a strategic role in strengthening AIU's engagement with external stakeholders, diversifying institutional revenue, enhancing professional education, and supporting the University's contribution to national human capital development.
   

  

 Scope of Work
   

  

 The Director of the Institute for Private Training (IPT) provides strategic leadership for AIU's executive education, professional development, and workforce development initiatives. Reporting to the Vice President for University Engagements, the Director is responsible for developing and implementing the Institute's strategic vision, expanding its portfolio of professional training and executive education programmes, ensuring operational excellence, and driving sustainable business growth.
   

  

 Working in close collaboration with the Partnership Office under the Office of the Vice President for University Engagements, the Director will identify, establish, and strengthen strategic partnerships with government entities, private sector organizations, international universities, professional associations, and industry leaders. These partnerships will support the co\-development of executive education programmes, customized corporate training, professional certifications, consultancy services, applied research initiatives, and other collaborative activities that advance AIU's strategic objectives and contribute to Kuwait Vision 2035\.
   

  

 The Director will lead business development activities, identify emerging market opportunities, oversee programme quality and financial performance, promote innovation in executive education, and position IPT as a leading provider of professional training and lifelong learning within Kuwait and the GCC region.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop and implement the strategic plan for the Institute for Private Training in alignment with AIU's RISE Strategy and Kuwait Vision 2035\.
* Lead the growth and development of executive education, professional development, customized corporate training, consultancy services, and lifelong learning initiatives.
* Develop sustainable business strategies to increase institutional revenue through executive education, corporate training, professional certification programmes, and strategic partnerships.
* Work closely with the Partnership Office to establish and strengthen collaborations with government entities, private sector organizations, international universities, accreditation bodies, and professional organizations.
* Identify emerging workforce development needs and design innovative programmes that respond to market demand.
* Lead the development, implementation, quality assurance, and continuous improvement of executive education and professional training programmes.
* Expand AIU's portfolio of internationally recognized professional certifications and executive education offerings.
* Prepare annual business plans, operational plans, budgets, and key performance indicators to ensure sustainable institutional growth.
* Monitor programme quality, client satisfaction, financial performance, and operational effectiveness using measurable performance indicators.
* Promote innovation, digital learning, artificial intelligence applications, and emerging technologies within executive education and professional training.
* Represent AIU and IPT at national, regional, and international events, conferences, and professional forums to enhance institutional visibility and establish new strategic opportunities.
* Collaborate with AIU's academic schools, research centers, and administrative departments to develop interdisciplinary professional education programmes.
* Ensure compliance with all relevant University policies and applicable regulatory and quality assurance requirements


 Reporting Departments (If Applicable)
   

  

* Institute for Private Training (IPT) Coordinator


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in Education, Business Administration, Management, Information Systems, Data Science, Organizational Development, Strategic Management, or a related field.
* A Master's degree in one of the above disciplines is preferred.


**Experience**
* Minimum ten (10\) years of progressively responsible leadership experience in executive education, professional training, higher education, organizational development, workforce development, consulting, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience in strategic planning, business development, and institutional or organizational growth.
* Proven experience in establishing and managing partnerships with government entities, private sector organizations, international institutions, or professional associations.
* Experience in developing and delivering executive education, professional certification, customized training, or workforce development programmes.
* Demonstrated experience managing budgets, generating revenue, and achieving business growth objectives.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and working with senior executives, government officials, and external stakeholders.


 Technical Knowledge
   

  

* Strategic planning and institutional development.
* Executive education and professional training management.
* Business development and partnership management.
* Programme design and quality assurance.
* Budgeting and financial management.
* Digital learning platforms and emerging educational technologies.
* Performance management and KPI development.


 Skills and Competencies
   

  

* Proven leadership and people management skills with the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and foster a high\-performance culture.
* Excellent knowledge of private training, professional development, and continuing education best practices.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic language proficiency is an advantage.
* Knowledge of workforce development trends, professional certifications, and industry training requirements.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Education, Business Administration, Management, Information Systems, Data Science, Strategic Management, Organizational Development, or a related field.
* Experience working with higher education institutions, executive education centers, or professional training organizations.
* Experience establishing strategic partnerships with government entities, private sector organizations, international institutions, or professional associations.
* Demonstrated success in business development, revenue generation, and expanding professional training or executive education services.
* Experience developing customized corporate training, executive education, consultancy, or professional certification programmes.
* Knowledge of Kuwait's higher education sector, workforce development priorities, and Kuwait Vision 2035\.
* Experience managing international collaborations and cross\-sector partnerships.
* Experience integrating digital technologies, AI\-enabled solutions, or innovative learning approaches into professional training and executive education.
* Professional certifications in leadership, project management, quality management, executive education, or organizational development are considered an asset.


 How to Apply
   

  

 Interested candidates should visit the Job Opportunities section on the AIU website and submit a complete application comprising:
   

  

* A current curriculum vitae (CV)
* A cover letter (maximum 2 pages) explaining: (a) your experience submitting data to specific ranking agencies, name the agencies and describe your role; (b) a specific example of a benchmarking or ranking improvement you contributed to; and (c) why this role at AIU at this stage of its development is the right next step in your career
* Contact details for three professional referees at least one of whom supervised your ranking or institutional research work


 Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. The University reserves the right to close the search at any time. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
   

  

 Submit application via: https://aiu.edu.kw/careers/jobs
   

  

 The successful candidate is expected to commence employment at the earliest convenience, and no later than September 2026\.
   

  

 AIU is an equal opportunity employer committed to academic excellence, professional integrity, and the advancement of Kuwait as a regional center of knowledge and innovation.

data.jd_text:
Closing Date: 3 July 2026
   

  

 NATS is the UK’s leading air navigation service provider, handling over 2 million flights each year. It provides air traffic control services, as well as a wide range of commercial solutions in over 30 countries internationally. Our people are at the heart of our purpose to advance aviation and keep the skies safe.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 This role is accountable for the promotion and implementation of an Integrated Management System (IMS) within the operations directorate for the provision of independent oversight to provide assurance that Safety, Quality and Environmental accountabilities and standards are being met, maintained, and improved in relation to operational services.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Lead, develop and implement the strategy to provide independent Safety, Quality \& Environmental assurance oversight including investigations, advice, and escalation of potential issues to the Delivery Director.
* Ensure that safety, quality and environmental capabilities and leadership are developed across the operation. Promote continuous improvement by evolving the operation through lessons learned internally and adopting relevant industry best practices.
* Delivery of the required actions and plans to ensure that the safety, quality, and environmental requirements for certification from regulatory authorities are met. This includes preparation for ISO 9001, 10002 and 14001 certifications.
* Accountable for the provision of independent oversight and assurance across all Operational functions with relation to the IMS. This includes oversight and assurance of all aspects of Safety, Quality or Environmental Training.
* Provide independent oversight and leadership to ensure that the performance and effectiveness of the IMS throughout the Operation is appropriate to meet all regulatory requirements.
* Develop suitable performance indicators to measure and report on the performance of the IMS to the Delivery Director.
* Responsible for preparing reports on the performance of the IMS for external bodies such as customers and regulators as required.
* Facilitate Change Management processes to meet Operational requirements.
* Create workplace conditions that deliver a competent, energetic, engaged, and motivated workforce who are committed and aligned to the delivery outcomes.
* Work as an integral member of the on\-site NATS leadership team, providing mutual support as required to ensure positive teamwork and clear communications to all stakeholders.
* The ability to substitute on behalf of other members of the On\-site Leadership Team as required.


**Qualifications, Skills And Personal Attributes**
* Minimum of 10 years operational experience in a Safety leadership role.
* The role holder should ideally be educated to degree level/equivalent.
* An accomplished, credible, and respected leader. Proven leadership skills in a customer focussed, dynamic and changing environment. Comfortable leading and managing through uncertainty and ambiguity; adapting to varying requirements and flexible in approach to resolving challenges.
* Proven skills in all facets of strategy development, stakeholder management \& change management.
* Proactive and tenacious approach with the skills to cope with a range of situations that require facilitation, influencing, conflict handling and negotiation; able to take people with them. Ability to quickly form strong relationships across a wide cross section of stakeholders (internal and external); encourages open and honest debate with stakeholders even on difficult issues.
* Demonstrate a strong commitment to personal and team objectives, seeking to continuously improve the status quo. Ability to coach, motivate, build teams, and develop others to maximise their contribution and performance. Able to drive and exhibit strong collegiate behaviours across Operations – brings One Operation to life in everything that they say or do. Highly motivated and well organised with a proven record of accomplishment of delivery.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively deliver key messages and strategic vision. Proven skills in making the complex simple.
* Arabic speaker preferable.
* Extensive experience and understanding of an ATS (Air Traffic Service) operating environment and the role of people, process, airspace, and technology. Middle East experience preferable.
* A comprehensive understanding of operational safety within an Aviation Safety Management System including Safety Assurance, Risk Management, Safety Responsibility and Safety Promotion.
* A comprehensive understanding of Quality Management Systems, specifically managing the ISO 9001, ISO 10002 certification process.
* A comprehensive understanding of Environmental Management Systems and managing the ISO 14001 certification process.


**Additional Vacancy Information**
 Candidate is required to work flexibly across different time zones and working weeks. International travel as required.
   

  

 We are proud to offer a fantastic total reward package to help you thrive both personally and professionally. In addition to a competitive salary that's regularly reviewed, as a member of our international team, you'll also benefit from private healthcare and dental cover, generous leave entitlement with the option to purchase additional leave, wellness support and a comprehensive learning and development offering. For more information, please visit International \- NATS
   

  

 If you share our passion to advance aviation and keep the skies safe – we would like to hear from you whatever your age, sex, race, faith, visible or invisible disability. Individuals that bring different perspectives, skills, life experiences and backgrounds help us be at the forefront of our industry.

**About The American International University**

data.jd_text:
Position: Director of Global Excellence and Benchmarking
   

  

 Classification: Senior Administrative and Academic Leadership\- Director Level
   

  

 Reports To: President
   

  

**About The American International University**
 American International University (AIU) is a private institution in Kuwait, founded in 2019, offering undergraduate programs based on the American model of higher education. AIU provides degrees in Engineering, Architecture and Design, Business Administration, Arts and Sciences, and Education, with English as the language of instruction. The University is committed to fostering intellectual, cultural, and personal growth, preparing graduates for leadership roles in a global society.
   

  

 AIU is executing its RISE Strategy 2026–2030, a five\-year institutional transformation encompassing research development, international institutional accreditation, student success, and community engagement. A central strategic objective is establishing AIU's presence in international university rankings and benchmarking its performance against regional and global peers. The Director of Global Excellence and Benchmarking leads this agenda.
   

  

 For more information, visit: www.aiu.edu.kw
   

  

 Department Profile
   

  

 The Office of Global Excellence and Benchmarking is a newly established function reporting directly to the President. It serves as AIU's strategic intelligence unit, transforming institutional data into rankings entries, competitive intelligence into positioning decisions, and benchmarking evidence into actionable improvement plans. The Office works in close partnership with the Institutional Research (IR) Office, the Accreditation \& Institutional Effectiveness Office, the AVP Research \& Innovation, and the Vice President for Academic Affairs.
   

  

 This office is AIU's external face to the global higher education community, responsible for ensuring that AIU's institutional quality is visible, accurately measured, and credibly communicated to every ranking body, benchmark framework, and peer institution that matters to AIU's reputation and competitive position.
   

  

 Scope of Work:
   

  

 The Director of Global Excellence and Benchmarking is responsible for designing, implementing, and managing AIU's comprehensive strategy for international university rankings and institutional benchmarking. This is a hands\-on, data\-intensive, externally\-facing role that requires deep technical knowledge of ranking methodologies, the analytical rigor to translate raw institutional data into ranking submissions, and the strategic vision to identify where AIU can achieve measurable improvement across ranking indicators.
   

  

 The role encompasses three interconnected domains:
   

  

* Rankings Strategy \& Submission: Lead all data submissions to QS, THE, Webometrics, UI GreenMetric, and other ranking bodies, with full technical mastery of each agency's methodology, data definitions, and submission portals.
* Institutional Benchmarking: Systematically benchmark AIU's performance against Kuwait and regional peer institutions, and global aspirational peers, producing actionable competitive intelligence for the President.
* Reputation \& Visibility: Build AIU's academic reputation through strategic visibility, Scopus profile management, Webometrics optimisation, academic survey response coordination, and employer survey engagement for ranking systems reputation scores.


 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

 Rankings Strategy and Data Submission
   

  

* Develop and maintain AIU's annual Rankings Action Plan, a structured, data\-driven roadmap for improving position across all active and target ranking systems, updated each October for Board review
* Manage all data submissions to QS World University Rankings, QS Stars, Times Higher Education (THE) World and Impact Rankings, Webometrics Ranking of World Universities, and UI GreenMetric, ensuring submissions are complete, accurate, and filed before agency deadlines
* Maintain detailed, up\-to\-date knowledge of the methodology, data definitions, indicators, and weighting of every active ranking system in AIU's portfolio; monitor changes to methodology and adjust data strategy accordingly
* Build and maintain the AIU Rankings Data Repository, the single authoritative source of record for all data submitted to external ranking agencies, maintained in a format that enables year\-on\-year comparison and audit
* Coordinate with the Institutional Research Office, Registrar, Library, HR, and VP Academic Affairs to collect, verify, and validate all data elements required for ranking submissions
* Ensure that all data submitted to ranking agencies is accurate, reproducible, and consistent with data published on AIU's public website, no figure may be submitted to a ranking body that cannot be independently verified


 Institutional Benchmarking and Competitive Intelligence
   

  

* Design and implement an annual benchmarking programme comparing AIU's performance against defined peer groups across Kuwait, the GCC, and internationally, covering student outcomes, faculty productivity, research output, employability, and student\-to\-faculty ratios
* Produce the Annual Benchmarking Report for the President, a structured, visual, decision\-ready analysis showing AIU's relative position, trajectory, and priority improvement areas
* Monitor peer institution rankings, accreditation status, programme offerings, and strategic developments, providing the President with quarterly competitive intelligence briefs
* Identify the specific ranking indicators where AIU has the highest potential for near\-term improvement and develop targeted action plans in coordination with the relevant VP or Dean
* Represent AIU's position accurately in all external comparisons and marketing materials, ensuring no benchmarking claim is made without verified, methodologically sound data


 Academic Reputation and Visibility
   

  

* Lead AIU's response to the QS and THE academic reputation surveys, coordinating with the President, VPAA, and Deans to identify and engage Kuwaiti, GCC, and international academics who are familiar with AIU's work
* Lead AIU's response to the QS employer reputation survey, working with VP Engagement \& External Relations and Career Services to engage Kuwait and GCC employers who hire AIU graduates
* Manage and continuously improve AIU's Webometrics profile, overseeing institutional web presence, digital publication of research outputs, and online visibility of faculty and research activity
* Work with the AVP Research \& Innovation to ensure all AIU research publications are indexed in Scopus and Web of Science under the correct institutional affiliation, preventing data loss that would otherwise cost AIU citation metrics
* Manage AIU's institutional profiles on all ranking agency platforms, QS Top Universities, THE World University Rankings, Scopus Institutions, Google Scholar, keeping information current and complete


 Strategy Alignment and Internal Reporting
   

  

* Serve as the primary point of contact between AIU and all ranking agencies, maintaining professional relationships with QS, THE, and Webometrics account managers
* Present the Annual Rankings Progress Report to the Board of Trustees alongside the RISE Strategy KPI review, demonstrating measurable movement on ranking indicators
* Advise the President, VPAA, and Deans on the ranking implications of institutional decisions, including faculty hiring, research investment, program development, and student recruitment strategy
* Coordinate with the Accreditation Liaison Officer to ensure that ranking data submissions are consistent with WSCUC self\-study data, no gap or contradiction between accreditation and ranking evidence
* Contribute to the Annual Institutional Effectiveness Report the rankings and benchmarking.
* Train and brief faculty, administrators, and Deans on ranking methodologies, what each indicator measures, and what faculty behavior, particularly in research and publication directly affects AIU's ranking position


 Reporting Departments (If Applicable)
   

  

 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

 Education
   

  

* Terminal degree (PhD or equivalent doctorate) from an accredited institution, preferably in higher education management, educational measurement, data science, institutional research, information science, or a related field
* Master's degree holders with exceptional and directly relevant ranking agency experience may be considered at the discretion of the President


**Experience**
* Minimum five (5\) years of progressive experience in higher education, with a demonstrable track record in institutional research, rankings management, or data analytics in a university context
* Directly demonstrated experience submitting data to at least two of the following ranking agencies: QS World University Rankings, Times Higher Education Rankings, Webometrics, or UI GreenMetric, applications must specify which agencies and provide verifiable submission history
* Experience in competitive benchmarking and peer analysis in an academic or strategic planning context
* Experience working with senior academic leadership, President, Provost, or equivalent, and presenting data\-driven findings to Board\-level audiences


 Technical Knowledge
   

  

* Deep, current knowledge of QS, THE, Webometrics, and UI GreenMetric ranking methodologies, including indicator definitions, data sources, weighting systems, and common submission errors
* Proficiency with bibliometric and citation databases: Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar, ability to extract, verify, and analyse institutional publication and citation data
* Strong data analytics capability, experience with Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent tools; ability to build ranking dashboards and data visualisations for executive audiences
* Familiarity with Student Information Systems (SIS), LMS data extraction, and IPEDS\-equivalent international data standards
* Knowledge of WSCUC or equivalent regional accreditation standards and the relationship between accreditation evidence and ranking indicators is a significant advantage


 Skills and Competencies
   

  

* Exceptional data integrity standards, this role requires someone who treats accuracy as non\-negotiable: no figure submitted to a ranking body may be inaccurate, and no publicly stated benchmark may be unverified
* Excellent written and oral communication in English, ability to translate complex methodological data into clear, compelling narratives for Board members with no prior knowledge of ranking systems
* Strong project management capability, ability to manage multiple concurrent ranking submission timelines, each with fixed external deadlines
* Cultural awareness and professional sophistication appropriate to representing AIU to international ranking agencies and academic communities
* Arabic language proficiency is an advantage but is not required


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior experience in a GCC university in a rankings, institutional research, or strategic planning role, familiarity with Kuwait's higher education regulatory context is a significant advantage
* Experience with QS Stars institutional rating system, which AIU is targeting in the near term
* Experience developing an institutional rankings strategy from a baseline position, candidates who have built a rankings programme at a new or young institution are particularly sought
* Published research or professional presentations on university rankings methodology, higher education data quality, or institutional benchmarking
* Familiarity with Kuwait Vision 2035 and its implications for higher education quality and international competitiveness


 How to Apply
   

  

 Interested candidates should visit the Job Opportunities section on the AIU website and submit a complete application comprising:
   

  

* A current curriculum vitae (CV)
* A cover letter (maximum 2 pages) explaining: (a) your experience submitting data to specific ranking agencies, name the agencies and describe your role; (b) a specific example of a benchmarking or ranking improvement you contributed to; and (c) why this role at AIU at this stage of its development is the right next step in your career
* Contact details for three professional referees at least one of whom supervised your ranking or institutional research work


 Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. The University reserves the right to close the search at any time. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
   

  

 Submit application via: https://aiu.edu.kw/careers/jobs
   

  

 The successful candidate is expected to commence employment at the earliest convenience, and no later than September 2026\.
   

  

 AIU is an equal opportunity employer committed to academic excellence, professional integrity,
   

  

 and the advancement of Kuwait as a regional center of knowledge and innovation.

data.jd_text:
**Chief of Staff to the Founding Partners** 




  





 SV7 is a Kuwait\-based group operating across the GCC and internationally, originating and advising on opportunities at the intersection of infrastructure, strategic advisory, and digital commerce.
 



  





 We’re looking for a Chief of Staff to be a second mind to the founding partners — someone who sees around corners, owns problems end to end, and moves between financial analysis, strategy, business development, and operations in the course of a single day.
 



  





 This isn’t an administrative role. It’s a high\-trust, high\-autonomy seat for someone exceptional who wants proximity to the founding partners, real ownership, and exposure across industries.
 



  





**What you’ll do** 




  





 • Act as the founding partners’ right hand across all entities — turning high\-level direction into action, and exercising their judgment when they can’t be in the room.
 



 • Own strategic projects end to end: structuring deals, building financial models, drafting term sheets and proposals, and pressure\-testing decisions before they’re made.
 



 • Run point on business development — preparing briefs, managing partner and counterparty relationships, and keeping multi\-track initiatives moving.
 



 • Build the analysis behind major decisions — financial, commercial, and operational — with rigor and precision.
 



 • Work ten steps ahead, surfacing risks, opportunities, and decisions before they become urgent.
 



 • Represent the founding partners at a senior level, internally and externally, with discretion and polish.
 



  





**What we’re looking for** 




  





 • A sharp, strategic mind that thinks in systems, frameworks, and second\-order consequences.
 



 • Strong financial and commercial fluency — comfortable building models, reading deals, and reasoning about structure.
 



 • Exceptional written and verbal communication — able to move from a board\-level memo to a vendor negotiation without dropping the standard.
 



 • Thorough, detailed, and action\-oriented — you see things through from end to end.
 



 • Extreme ownership: when something lands on your desk, it’s handled.
 



 • Range across industries — a generalist who goes deep fast.
 



 • Sound judgment and total discretion; much of this work is sensitive.
 



 • Background in consulting, banking, private equity, or a founder’s office is a strong plus.
 



  





**Who you are** 




 Forward\-thinking, dependable, and unflappable. You want to be close to the decisions that matter, and you’re energized — not overwhelmed — by breadth and pace.
 



  





 📍 Based in Kuwait City · Full\-time, on\-site
 



 Interested — or know someone who'd be a great fit? Send your CV to info@sv\-7\.com or message me directly.

data.jd_text:
**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The incumbent will be responsible for leading the Country Audit team, and managing the provision of internal audit and related advisory services for the Branch’s activities. In this regard, the incumbent will develop the annual internal audit plan for the Branch for review by Group Internal Audit Division and subsequently ensure the timely implementation/ execution of the plan in line with applicable best practices, including but not limited to the Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (SPPIA).
   

  

 The responsibility includes also the follow\-up of issues raised by Group Internal Audit Division and preparation of status reports, review of Policies and Procedures and conduct investigations/special assignments as and when requested. The role will also extend to the secondary responsibilities assigned to the incumbent in terms of specific audit activities/ functions/ departments and special projects, as assigned by his superiors, in addition to his primary responsibility. The position requires sufficient expertise and knowledge to focus/ monitor a wide range of risks in their countries business.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Shareholder \& Financial:
* Ensure effectiveness of adopted policies/ procedures adherence to regulatory and statutory requirements, and safeguarding of the Branch’s assets.
* Add value to the functions/ activities performed by the Branch by identifying instances/ risks that could result in financial losses or regulatory non\-compliance, monetary penalties/ reputation damage through the audit and risk review process.
* Identify potential cost saving opportunities by highlighting process inefficiencies through the above processes.
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for the internal audit function and its roles.
* Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste, and optimise benefits for the bank.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated by the GIAD to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective staff and monitor exercise of the same.
* Demonstrate clear understanding of the important factors behind the bank's financial \& non\-financial performance.
* Customer (Internal \& External):
* Ensure adequate coverage of the Branch’s activities in the annual audit plan to provide assurance to the relevant executive management on the adequacy and effectiveness of the internal controls in place within the respective department/ function and add value to improve the functioning of the various activities performed by the referenced department/ function, as and where applicable.
* Act as primary Internal Audit subject matter expert in country, in order to ensure adherence to the full range of regulatory requirements (both local and Qatar regulators) including QNB Country Compliance manual; Group Compliance Policies and Procedures Financial Crime Risk, ESG, Fraud Risk Management, Regulatory reporting and Information Security etc.
* Provide timely feedback/ information to the VP \- International Support \& Oversight for Global Audit Activity on queries, reports and other correspondence received by Branch Management either directly from the external auditors or the applicable regulators in the respective jurisdictions, to enable the latter to respond to the same in a timely and efficient manner, that pertain to the incumbent’s area of responsibility.
* Execute and/or support in completion of any requirement, tasks or requests from local regulator or GIAD’s office specifically related to Internal Audit, including reviews of regulatory returns, and periodic certifications.
* Liaise with the relevant officials from Country Regulators as and when required and provide clarifications/ responses to queries/ reports/ other correspondence received.
* Liaise with the external auditors of the branch to ensure that they complement the efforts of the Internal Audit and avoid duplication of effort. This will involve meetings with the external auditors to discuss the planned audit work, the exchange of working papers, audit reports and management letters, and to ensure common understanding of audit techniques, methods and terminology.
* Manage the relationships with the Branch’s executive management and obtain their inputs/ concerns on the various functions/ activities pertaining to the Branch including significant developments therein, which could have an impact on the annual audit plan for the Branch.
* Support Internal Audit teams of other QNB international entities, as and where requested by GIAD.
* Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/units to achieve improvements in turn\-around time.
* Build and maintain strong/effective relationships with related departments/units to achieve the Group’s objectives.
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory):
* Conduct a risk assessment for branch individual functions/ processes/ products and related procedures on at least annual basis as an input to annual audit planning exercise.
* Prepare an annual audit for submission to the VP – International Support \& Oversight for Global Audit Activity for review/comments and approval, based on the risk assessment conducted for the Branch and in line with its overall strategy.
* Ensure timely implementation and execution of the approved annual audit plan. Also responsible for submitting periodic status reports on the progress to VP – International Support \& Oversight for Global Audit Activity and explaining the reasons for the delay in completion of individual assignments, if applicable.

**Job Description**
 As a Senior Program Specialist at Honeywell, you will play a crucial role in managing and executing complex Extra\-Low Voltage (ELV) programs that enhance operational efficiency and customer satisfaction. You will be the operational backbone for critical systems—including Security, BMS, FAS, and ICT—navigating the complete project lifecycle from pre\-sales engagement to final delivery. Your leadership will be vital in ensuring programs are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with Honeywell’s strategic objectives and quality standards.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Project Execution: Lead the overall execution of ELV projects, with a focus on mainly airport projects, following best\-in\-class methodologies.
* Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for day\-to\-day activities with all project stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and satisfaction.
* Financial Performance: Monitor monthly financial measures including revenue recognition, margins, invoicing, and cash collection to drive a positive P\&L.
* Project Planning: Develop and implement comprehensive Project Management Plans, including Scope, Execution, Quality, and Procurement plans.
* Risk \& Change Management: Identify risks and develop mitigation plans while managing scope changes through variation orders and contract alignment.
* Sales Collaboration: Engage early with Sales and Estimation teams during bidding stages and lead the formal hand\-over process.
* Performance Tracking: Monitor project performance against defined KPIs and utilize Honeywell’s operating systems, such as Cora PPM, for records management and forecasting.
* Health \& Safety: Manage all HSE\-related project activities in strict coordination with the HSE department to ensure a safe work environment


**Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Electrical, Electronics, or relevant field).
* Experience: 10\+ years of project management experience specifically with ELV Systems and Software Integrations.
* Language: Native or fluent proficiency in both Arabic and English.
* Technical Knowledge: Strong expertise in Security, BMS, and Fire Alarm Systems (FAS).
* Portfolio Management: Proven ability to manage a portfolio of projects concurrently while meeting tight deadlines under pressure.
* WE VALUE
* Certification: Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is highly preferred.
* Domain Expertise: Prior experience managing large\-scale projects in Airports, Smart Cities, or IoT domains.
* Contractual Acumen: Knowledge of contract types and the ability to effectively communicate with legal and contract teams.
* Leadership Skills: A proactive approach to problem\-solving, strong negotiation skills, and the ability to lead cross\-functional teams.
* Software Proficiency: Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., MS Office, Cora PPM) and SAP modules.


 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
   

  

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
   

  

**About Us**
 Honeywell helps organizations solve the world's most complex challenges in automation, the future of aviation and energy transition. As a trusted partner, we provide actionable solutions and innovation through our Aerospace Technologies, Building Automation, Energy and Sustainability Solutions, and Industrial Automation business segments – powered by our Honeywell Forge software – that help make the world smarter, safer and more sustainable.

Job description:
   

  

 Job Summary
 
 The Business Partner is the key and strategic interface between IT and the Business. Managing partners (both internal and external) to deliver quality IT projects on time and within budget is essential. The primary responsibility is to understand the key end\-to\-end business processes and digitize them with use of best in class technologies. 
 


 Job Responsibilities
 
 •Develop strategic IT plans in partnership with business.
   

 •Research and share new technology and bring industry best practices 
   

 •Prepare business IT budget in view of IT plans
   

 •Project Management to ensure desired objectives are achieved within defined timelines, cost and quality
   

 •Manage external vendors in terms of contracts, SLA, process alignment and payments
   

 •Work with IT to ensure that all incidents, service requests and change requests are managed within agreed service level agreements as per agreed quality standards.
   

 •Be a custodian of business processes with an objective to digitize the processes and eliminate manual work and inefficiencies
   

 •Work with the business and IT to improve Master Data Management (MDM). While primary ownership for MDM is with the business, IT must assist in the process by improving system configurations and controls, and providing timely and regular reports.
   

 •Ensure the roles and authorizations are aligned to standards. Work with finance, business team and COE for periodic review of roles and authorizations.
   

 •Maximize the use of system controls to reduce reliance on costly and inefficient manual controls.
   

 •Translate business unit plans into specific IT requirements and programs/projects. 
   

 •Ensure continuous business IT alignment by conducting periodic IT steering committee meetings, Follow up meetings, cost reviews, escalations, CAB meetings and periodic reporting.
   

 •Implement IT policies and guidelines in the business and work with audit to ensure proper implementation of IT policies and guidelines. 
   

 •Ensure licenses compliance for all applications used by business
   

 •Arrange users training to ensure optimum utilization of system
   

 •Accountable for change requests creation, BRD quality, approvals, UAT and solution delivery
   

 •Accountable for the coordination among different IT and vendor teams to ensure proper and timely solution delivery for the business
   

  
 


 Candidate Requirements
 
**Education**
 •Bachelor Degree in Computer Science or Business Administration
   

 •Master Degree or MBA, preferred
 



**Experience**
 •Delivered and managed complex IT projects.
   

 •Experience of managing stakeholder relationships
   

 •Experience of managing end to end IT delivery, including application support.
   

 •Experience of managing implementation partners (both Fixed Price and Time and Materials) to deliver quality with minimum change requests. 
   

 •Experience of getting to know and understand the business and to identify how IT can best contribute to its success including effective Change Management
 



**Knowledge**
 •Exposure to digital technologies
   

 •End\-to\-End business process understanding. 
   

 •Knowledge of the spectrum of possible IT interventions and experience of delivering improved business results.
 



**Abilities**
 •Team working skills
   

 •Strong customer focus and proven ability to build productive relationships at all levels of the organization.
   

 •Excellent communication skills
   

 •Ability to translate strategy into actionable items
   

 •Skilled at Organizational Change Management (OCM).

data.jd_text:
**Building on our past. Ready for the future**
 Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Construction Project Manager to join our team in Ahmadi, Kuwait, supporting the Kuwait Environmental Remediation Program (KERP).
   

  

 You will play a pivotal role in delivering large\-scale environmental restoration initiatives. With millions of square meters of contaminated land successfully remediated, this project represents a globally significant effort in sustainable environmental recovery.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to contribute to transforming impacted land into safe, productive ecosystems while leading complex engineering and construction operations.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Project Leadership \& Delivery**
* Lead the overall management, coordination, and supervision of assigned remediation projects.
* Oversee budget development, cost control, and quality assurance to ensure successful project delivery.

* Develop and implement the soil remediation strategy for assigned areas, including contracting and execution approaches.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management**

* Implement robust change control processes.
* Support claims mitigation and management strategies.


**Cost \& Value Management**
* Monitor project costs and forecast outcomes, taking proactive measures to prevent overruns.
* Promote Value Improving Practices (VIPs) to optimize capital efficiency.


**Quality Assurance**
* Ensure adherence to Worley systems, policies, and procedures.
* Maintain strong oversight of engineering deliverables and quality standards.


**Team Leadership**
* Lead and motivate multi\-disciplinary and global teams.
* Drive achievement of milestones and key project objectives.


**What You'll Have**
* Education: Full\-time Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering from an accredited university
* Experience:
+ Minimum 15 years total experience
+ Minimum 5 years in oil \& gas / refinery / petrochemical industries
+ Minimum 5 years in a similar Project Engineering / Construction Management role

* Proven experience:
+ Managing multi\-disciplinary construction projects
+ Acting as deputy to a Projects Manager
+ Delivering complex environmental/remediation projects

* Demonstrated expertise in:
+ Soil remediation technologies and execution strategies
+ Engineering and construction management across full project lifecycle


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in PMC (Project Management Consultancy) environments
* Middle East project experience (highly desirable)


**About You**
 You are a proactive and results\-driven leader with the ability to manage complex projects and diverse teams. You bring:
   

  

* Strong technical expertise and problem\-solving abilities
* Excellent stakeholder and client engagement skills
* A structured and strategic approach to project delivery
* Passion for sustainability and environmental restoration
* You will be recognized as a subject matter expert, capable of guiding teams, resolving complex challenges, and delivering high\-impact outcomes.


**Why Join Worley on KERP?**
* Work on one of the world’s largest environmental remediation programs
* Contribute to meaningful sustainability and environmental recovery initiatives
* Be part of a globally recognized engineering and project delivery organization
* Lead impactful, large\-scale projects with long\-term significance


**Moving forward together**
 We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can bring themselves, and are heard. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by law.
   

  

 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.
   

  

 Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

**Purpose**
 The Senior Professional Education Manager – MEA is responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive professional education strategy that advances the clinical adoption of the company’s products and solutions across the Middle East and Africa region.
   

  

 The role partners closely with Commercial, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Health Care Compliance, and external healthcare professionals to design, organize, and deliver high\-quality educational programs for surgeons, nurses, and allied healthcare professionals. Through innovative educational initiatives, the role ensures healthcare professionals have the knowledge, skills, and confidence to deliver optimal patient outcomes while supporting the organization’s strategic priorities and growth objectives.
   

  

**You Will Be Responsible For**
**Professional Education Strategy**
* Develop and execute the regional professional education strategy aligned with business priorities, clinical evidence, and customer needs.
* Translate commercial and clinical objectives into impactful educational programs that support product adoption and procedural excellence.
* Identify capability gaps and educational opportunities across markets, specialties, and customer segments.
* Establish annual education plans, budgets, and success metrics for the region.


**Program Development \& Execution**
* Design and deliver regional and local educational initiatives, including:
+ Surgeon training programs
+ Nursing and allied healthcare professional education
+ Clinical workshops and cadaveric training
+ Centers of Excellence programs
+ Fellowship and observership programs
+ Faculty development initiatives
+ Digital and virtual learning solutions

* Lead end\-to\-end planning and execution of educational events, ensuring excellence in customer experience and operational delivery.
* Develop innovative learning formats that enhance engagement and knowledge retention.


**Faculty \& Key Opinion Leader Engagement**

* Identify, recruit, and develop faculty members to support educational initiatives.
* Partner with clinical experts to ensure educational content remains evidence\-based, relevant, and clinically meaningful.
* Facilitate faculty meetings, advisory boards, and curriculum development sessions.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Partner with Marketing and Commercial teams to align educational activities with strategic business objectives.
* Collaborate with Medical Affairs to ensure scientific integrity and appropriate educational content.
* Work closely with Regulatory, Legal, and Healthcare Compliance teams to ensure all activities adhere to applicable policies and regulations.
* Coordinate with local market teams to ensure regional programs address country\-specific needs.


**Budget \& Resource Management**
* Manage the regional professional education budget and ensure effective allocation of resources.
* Evaluate educational investments and optimize return on investment.
* Oversee external vendors, agencies, event organizers, and training partners.


**Measurement \& Continuous Improvement**
* Establish KPIs and dashboards to measure the effectiveness of educational programs.
* Analyze participant feedback, learning outcomes, and business impact metrics.
* Implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance educational quality and effectiveness.
* Utilize data and insights to inform future educational strategies.


**Leadership \& Influence**
* Serve as a regional subject matter expert in healthcare professional education and adult learning methodologies.
* Provide leadership and guidance to country teams regarding educational best practices.
* Influence stakeholders across multiple functions and geographies to drive execution and alignment.
* Represent the organization at regional and international professional education forums.


**Qualifications / Requirements**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree required.
* Advanced degree preferred (MBA, Master’s in Education, Healthcare Management, Clinical Discipline, or related field).


**Experience**
* Minimum 8–10 years of experience in professional education, clinical education, marketing, medical affairs, or commercial roles within the healthcare, medical device, pharmaceutical, or life sciences industry.
* Demonstrated experience planning and executing large\-scale regional educational programs.
* Experience working with healthcare professionals, faculty members, and key opinion leaders.
* Experience managing complex projects across multiple countries and cultures.
* Previous experience within the Middle East and Africa region strongly preferred.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strategic thinking and execution excellence.
* Strong project and event management capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Strong presentation, facilitation, and communication skills.
* Budget management and financial acumen.
* Ability to work effectively in a matrix organization.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.

**Travel Requirements**

**Success Measures**

**3\. Driver \& Team Management**
